## 元数据

**项目名称**: 小鼠卵巢空间代谢组分析

**实验条件**: 小鼠卵巢切片(10μm);
冰冻卵巢样本采用DHB基质进行喷涂，使用MALDI-TOF-MS进行离子解离及质核比(m/z)分析;
质谱成像空间分辨率为20x20μm; 原始数据在SCiLS Lab软件中进行均方根(Root
Mean Square, RMS)标准化，得到不同m/z在每个空间位点的强度信息并转化为成像热图上的像素点。

**获取方式**: 根据武汉迈维代谢生物科技有限公司提供的链接进行下载:
[空间代谢组质谱成像文件](https://edisk.qiye.163.com/api/biz/attachment/download?identity=15fd191b367d453a9ff6cdf2af306169&title=%E3%80%90%E8%BF%88%E7%BB%B4%E4%BB%A3%E8%B0%A2-%E5%94%AE%E5%90%8E%E3%80%91MWY-24-640-a1%E4%B8%AA%E5%B0%8F%E9%BC%A0%E9%9D%9E%E9%9D%B6%E5%90%91%E7%A9%BA%E9%97%B4%E8%B4%A8%E8%B0%B1%E6%88%90%E5%83%8F%E6%A3%80%E6%B5%8B%E5%88%86%E6%9E%90):

# 样本处理
## 完全预处理的MSImagingExperiment对象
```{r,echo=TRUE}
rm(list=ls())
gc()

# 加载必要的库
library(Cardinal)
library(doParallel)
library(foreach)

# 设置工作目录
setwd('/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/')

# 列出所有 .imZML 文件
imzml_files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.imzML$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

# 设置并行计算的核心数
numCores <- detectCores() - 1  # 使用可用核心数减去1
cl <- makeCluster(numCores)
registerDoParallel(cl)


# 使用 foreach 并行处理每个文件
results <- foreach(file = imzml_files, .packages = 'Cardinal') %dopar% {
  # 读取 imZML 文件
  data <- readImzML(file)
  
  # 从文件名中提取第一个部分
  file_name <- basename(file)  # 获取文件名
  name_parts <- strsplit(file_name, "\\.")[[1]]  # 按 "." 分隔
  new_name <- name_parts[1]  # 取第一个部分
  
  # 执行数据处理
  continuous_data <- data |>
    summarizeFeatures(c(Mean = "mean")) |>
    summarizeFeatures(c(TIC = "sum")) 
  
  runNames(continuous_data) <- gsub('-','_',runNames(continuous_data))

  list(name = new_name, continuous_data = continuous_data)
}

# 停止并行计算
stopCluster(cl)

rm(cl)

# 将结果整理成命名列表并放入全局环境
for (result in results) {
  # 生成变量名
  mse_name <- paste0(result$name, "_mse")
  mse_name <- gsub("-", "_", mse_name)

  # 将数据赋值到全局环境
  assign(mse_name, result$continuous_data, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

saveRDS(results, 'Fully_Preprocessed_MSImagingExperiment.rds')
# results <- readRDS('Fully_Preprocessed_MSImagingExperiment.rds')

```
峰值占用12GB RAM, 2~3 mins


## 合并对象 @pixel not-merged
```{r,echo=TRUE}
# 合并对象 -----------------------------
library(Cardinal)

cbind_MSExperiment <- function(..., check_mz = TRUE) {
  objs <- list(...)
  if (check_mz && !all(sapply(objs[-1], function(x) identical(mz(x), mz(objs[[1]]))))) {
    stop("所有对象的 m/z 值必须完全相同")
  }
  Reduce(cbind, objs)  # 使用Reduce实现递归合并
}

mouse_14_ovary <- cbind_MSExperiment(y_1_mse, y_2_mse, y_3_mse, y_4_mse, y_5_mse, y_6_mse, y_7_mse, o_1_mse, o_2_mse, o_3_mse, o_4_mse, o_5_mse, o_6_mse, o_7_mse) 

pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$run <- factor(gsub("-", "_", pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$run))
pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$pixel_ID <- paste(
  pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$run, 
  rownames(pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)), 
  sep = "_"
  )

pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$ovary_ID <- pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$run



featureData(mouse_14_ovary)$Mean <- NULL
featureData(mouse_14_ovary)$Mean <- NULL
featureData(mouse_14_ovary)$TIC <- NULL
featureData(mouse_14_ovary)$TIC <- NULL

head(pixelData(mouse_14_ovary), 5)
head(featureData(mouse_14_ovary), 5)
image(mouse_14_ovary)

mouse_14_ovary

```

```{r,echo=TRUE,fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
ALL_sample_data$young_mean <- rowMeans(ALL_sample_data[, c("Y-1", "Y-2", "Y-3", "Y-4", "Y-5", "Y-6", "Y-7")], na.rm = TRUE)

# 计算指定列的行均值，并赋值给新列 young_mean
```

## 代谢物来源
```{r,echo=TRUE,fig.width=8}
# 代谢物来源 -------------------
setwd("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/")
ALL_sample_data <- read_excel("ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx")
new_table <- ALL_sample_data[, c("HMDB", "KEGG", "Compounds")]

# 重命名列
colnames(new_table) <- c("HMDBID", "KEGGID", "Name")

# 添加 Diff 列，并赋值为 1
new_table$Diff <- 1  # 仅为满足MetOrigin网站的数据格式要求

# 查看新的数据框
head(new_table)

# 保存为 CSV 文件
# write.csv(new_table, file = "all_mz_20250507.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 将all_mz_20250507.csv提交至MetOrigin，获取代谢物来源，得到 Metabolites_Origin_MetOrigin.csv

library(readr)
Metabolites_Origin_MetOrigin <- read_csv("Metabolites_Origin_MetOrigin.csv")

# 1. 检查行数是否一致（确保可合并）
stopifnot(nrow(ALL_sample_data) == nrow(Metabolites_Origin_MetOrigin))

# 2. 直接按列合并（要求行序完全一致）
ALL_sample_data_with_origin <- cbind(
  ALL_sample_data,
  Origin = Metabolites_Origin_MetOrigin$Origin
)

# 3. 检查结果
head(ALL_sample_data_with_origin)

# 代谢物来源 @UpSet图 ---------------------
library(UpSetR)
# 拆分分类字符串（按分号分隔）
origin_list <- strsplit(ALL_sample_data_with_origin$Origin, ";\\s*")

# 获取所有唯一分类标签
all_categories <- unique(unlist(origin_list))

# 创建二进制矩阵
binary_matrix <- sapply(all_categories, function(category) {
  as.integer(sapply(origin_list, function(x) category %in% x))
})

# 转换为数据框并统计频数
upset_data <- as.data.frame(binary_matrix)
rownames(upset_data) <- NULL  # 可选：移除行名

# 基本Upset图
Source_of_metabolites_Upset_plot <- upset(
  upset_data,
  sets = all_categories,                    # 使用所有分类
  nsets = length(all_categories),           # 显示全部分类
  nintersects = 20,                         # 显示前20个组合
  mb.ratio = c(0.6, 0.4),                   # 主条形图与下方矩阵图的比例
  main.bar.color = "gray23",                # 主条形颜色

  number.angles = 0,  # 右侧柱状图数字角度
```

## PCA @样本（行）×代谢物（列）
```{r PCA,echo=TRUE}
# pca_result <- prcomp(t(scale(intensity_df_14_ovaries)), center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)  # 先标准化样本（列），再转置
# 上述操作会对样本进行标准化（一般不符合代谢组学常规）


## scale()是对每一列进行标准化
## intensity_df_14_ovaries是代谢物（行）×样本（列），目标是标准化代谢物后再进行PCA，则以下两种写法等价

# 方法一
# set.seed(123)
# pca_result <- prcomp(scale(t(intensity_df_14_ovaries)), center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)  # 先转置，再标准化代谢物（列）

# 方法二
# set.seed(2025)
# pca_result <- prcomp(t(intensity_df_14_ovaries), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE) # 中心化和标准化

# 首先执行转置：t(intensity_df_14_ovaries)。intensity_df_14_ovaries 是常见的代谢物（行） × 样本（列） 矩阵（代谢组学常见格式）。转置后变为 样本（行） × 代谢物（列），这是 prcomp() 的默认要求（行为观测/样本，列为变量/代谢物）

# 然后执行中心化和归一化（标准化）。对输入数据的 每一列（即每个代谢物） 分别进行以下操作：
# 中心化（center=TRUE）：对每列减去该列的均值
# 归一化（`scale.=TRUE`）：对每列除以该列的标准差（标准差为1）
# 中心化和归一化是按列独立计算的（每个代谢物单独处理）

# 标准化后的数据矩阵会通过 SVD（奇异值分解）计算主成分，生成：
# $x: 主成分得分（样本在新坐标系的投影）。
# $rotation: 载荷矩阵（代谢物在主成分上的权重）。



set.seed(2025)
log_data <- log2(intensity_df_14_ovaries + 1)
pca_result <- prcomp(t(log_data), center=TRUE, scale.=TRUE)



# PCA的输入矩阵格式：必须是 样本（行） × 代谢物（列）
# 如果原始数据是 代谢物（行） × 样本（列），需先转置 t()
# 对代谢物进行标准化 → PCA计算变量（代谢物）的协方差矩阵。
# 如果错误标准化样本，PCA会基于错误方向计算方差，导致误导性结果。


library(ggsci)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)  # 用于避免标签重叠

# 计算主成分百分比
pca_var <- pca_result$sdev^2
pca_percent <- round(pca_var / sum(pca_var) * 100, 2)

# 定义分组
group <- ifelse(grepl("^y", gsub("_","",colnames(intensity_df))), "2M", "9M")

# 创建数据框
pca_data <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_result$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_result$x[, 2],
  Group = group,
  Label = gsub("_","",colnames(intensity_df))
)

# 绘制 PCA 图
PCA_14_ovaries <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group, label = Label)) +
  geom_point(size = 6) +  
  geom_text_repel(size = 6, box.padding = 0.5, max.overlaps = Inf, segment.color = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +  # 添加样本标签，禁用连接线
  stat_ellipse(aes(color = Group, group = Group), geom = "path", linetype = 2, level = 0.95, linewidth = 1, show.legend = FALSE  # 关键：禁止椭圆在图例中显示
               ) +  # 添加置信椭圆，明确指定 group
  scale_color_manual(values = c("2M" = "#00A087","9M" = "#7E6148")) +
  # ggsci::scale_color_npg() +  # 替换为 Nature 风格配色
  labs(title = "14 Mouse Ovaries",  
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pca_percent[1], "%)"),  
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pca_percent[2], "%)"),
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial") +  
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "plain"),  
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "plain"),  
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain"),  
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain"),  
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain"), 
    # legend.position = "none", # 隐藏所有图例
    legend.position = c(0.1, 0.9),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)) + 
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(label = "")))  

PCA_14_ovaries

ggsave("Fig_2C_14_Ovaries_PCA_plot.pdf", plot = PCA_14_ovaries, width = 6, height = 6, device = cairo_pdf, family = "Arial")


```
标准化对象：始终针对 代谢物（变量/列），而非样本。

数据结构：确保PCA输入为样本（行）×代谢物（列）。R中需t()转置原始代谢组矩阵。

代码选择：
推荐 prcomp(t(data), center=TRUE, scale.=TRUE)（让PCA自动处理标准化）。

或显式 prcomp(scale(t(data)),center=FALSE,scale.=FALSE)（手动标准化后禁用重复操作）。

在代谢组学分析中，OPLS-DA（Orthogonal Projections to Latent Structures Discriminant Analysis） 是一种监督式多变量统计方法，常用于组间差异分析。

格式：**行是样本samples，列是代谢物features/variables的矩阵或数据框；确保分组信息为因子型factor；Log变换@代谢物（整体）；标准化@代谢物（按列）**


对数变换（log）
目的：
1.解决右偏分布（多数代谢物浓度差异大，如少数极高值主导方差）。
2.满足多变量分析的正态性假设（OPLS-DA对非正态数据敏感度较低，但log可提升效果）。

标准化（scaling）
目的：
1.消除不同代谢物量纲差异（如浓度单位、检测灵敏度不同）。
2.避免高绝对值代谢物垄断模型权重。
标准化对象：对代谢物（变量/列）标准化（scale() 按列操作），而非样本！
原因：保留样本间生物学差异，仅统一代谢物的数值范围。

![OPLS-DA结果参数](/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/code/Image/oplsda_1.png)

输入数据：通常应为数值型矩阵或数据框;行rows为代谢物，列cols为样本。

按行标准化：对每一行（代谢物）独立进行 Z-score 标准化（均值为0，标准差为1）

输入数据推荐标准化：尤其是代谢物量纲不同时。




# 卵巢整体代谢物差异
```{r,echo=TRUE}
# 差异代谢物分析完整流程 --------------
library(ropls)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(extrafont)

### 1. 数据准备与预处理 ###
# 定义原始数据和log转换数据（全局变量）
raw_data <- intensity_df_14_ovaries  # 原始数据（未转换）
log_data <- log2(raw_data + 1)   # log2(x+1)转换后的数据（用于参数检验）

# 分组变量设置
group <- ifelse(grepl("^y", colnames(raw_data)), "2M", "9M") %>% 
  factor(levels = c("2M", "9M"))


### 2. OPLS-DA分析与VIP计算 ###
# 注意：VIP计算使用log转换+Pareto标准化后的数据
set.seed(2025)
oplsda_result <- opls(
  x = t(log_data),               # 输入log转换数据（样本×代谢物）
  y = group,                     # 使用统一的分组变量
  predI = 1,                     # 主成分数
  orthoI = 1,                    # 正交成分数
  log10L = FALSE,                # 已提前log转换，此处不再重复
  permI = 1000,                  # 置换检验次数
  scaleC = "pareto"              # Pareto标准化（VIP计算关键步骤）
)

# 提取VIP分数
vip_scores <- getVipVn(oplsda_result)

# 可视化OPLS-DA得分图
plot(oplsda_result,
     typeVc = "x-score",
     parAsColFcVn = group,
     parEllipsesL = TRUE,
     parPaletteVc = c("#00A087", "#3C5488")
)


### 3. 差异代谢物统计分析 ###
DEMs_14_ovaries <- raw_data %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    mz = round(as.numeric(rownames(.)), 4),  # m/z值，保留4位小数
    
    # 组均值（原始数据）
    young_mean = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., starts_with("y")), na.rm = TRUE),
    old_mean = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., !starts_with("y")), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # 变化倍数（原始数据计算后取log2）
    log2FC = log2(young_mean / old_mean),
    
    ### 基于log转换数据的统计检验 ###
    # Welch T检验（假设log转换后数据满足正态性）
    p_value_T = apply(log_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_8W <- x[group == "2M"]
      x_9M <- x[group == "9M"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_8W)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_9M)) < 2) return(NA)
      t.test(x_8W, x_9M, 
             alternative = "two.sided",
             var.equal = FALSE)$p.value  # Welch校正
    }),
    
    # FDR校正（BH方法）
    q_value_T = p.adjust(p_value_T, method = "BH"),
    
    ### 基于原始数据的非参数检验 ###
    # Mann-Whitney U检验（原始数据）
    p_value_Wilcox = apply(raw_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_8W <- x[group == "2M"]
      x_9M <- x[group == "9M"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_8W)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_9M)) < 2) return(NA)
      wilcox.test(x_8W, x_9M, 
                  alternative = "two.sided",
                  exact = FALSE)$p.value  # 大样本近似
    }),
    
    # FDR校正（BH方法）
    q_value_Wilcox = p.adjust(p_value_Wilcox, method = "BH"),
    
    ### VIP分数（来自OPLS-DA）###
    VIP = vip_scores
  )

### 4. 注释信息合并 ###
metware_data <- read_excel(
  "/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx"
) %>% 
  transmute(
    mz = round(as.numeric(`Precursor (Da)`), 4),
    Compounds, 物质, 
    `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG, Metlin, `PubChem CID`,
    `Class I`, 物质一级分类, `Class II`, 物质二级分类
  )

# 左连接合并注释
DEMs_14_ovaries <- DEMs_14_ovaries %>%
  left_join(metware_data, by = "mz")


### 5. 显著差异代谢物筛选 ###
Y2O_sig_DEMs_14_ovaries <- DEMs_14_ovaries %>%
  filter(
    VIP > 1 &                
    p_value_T < 0.05         
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%  # 按|log2FC|降序排列
  select(
    Compounds, VIP, p_value_T,log2FC, q_value_T
  )  %>% #  ,  Metabolite, young_mean, old_mean,物质, `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG, Metlin, `PubChem CID`, `Class I`, 物质一级分类, `Class II`, 物质二级分类
  dplyr::rename(p_val = p_value_T, FDR = q_value_T)

print(paste("显著差异代谢物数量:", nrow(Y2O_sig_DEMs_14_ovaries)))

Y2O_sig_DEMs_14_ovaries %>%
  select(Compounds, VIP, p_val) %>%
  writexl::write_xlsx("Table_S1_Global_DEMs_of_Ovaries(2M vs 9M).xlsx")

groups <- ifelse(grepl("^y", names(L_Carnitine_data)), "2M", "9M")

data <- data.frame(
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)  # 加载 ggrepel 包用于标签避让

# 1. 定义显著性分类
volcano_data <- DEMs_14_ovaries %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      p_value_T >= 0.05 ~ "Not sig",
      VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC < 0 ~ "9M-Up",
      VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC > 0 ~ "2M-Up",
      TRUE ~ "Not sig"
    )
  )

# 2. 计算每组的数量（用于图例标签）
count_sig <- volcano_data %>%
  group_by(significance) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      significance == "9M-Up" ~ paste0("9M-Up (n=", count, ")"),
      significance == "2M-Up" ~ paste0("2M-Up (n=", count, ")"),
      TRUE ~ paste0("Not sig (n=", count, ")")
    )
  )
```

## ROI区域划分 @UMAP+kmeans
```{r UMAP+kmeans,echo=TRUE, fig.height=6,fig.width=12}
# UMAP @余弦距离 ----------------------
library(Cardinal)
spectra_14_ovary <- as.matrix(t(intensity(mouse_14_ovary)))
colnames(spectra_14_ovary) <- mz(mouse_14_ovary)
rownames(spectra_14_ovary) <- pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$pixel_ID
dim(spectra_14_ovary)

# 1. 移除常数列（可选）
spectra_14_ovary <- spectra_14_ovary[, apply(spectra_14_ovary, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0]
dim(spectra_14_ovary)

# 2. Min-Max归一化
min_vals <- apply(spectra_14_ovary, 2, min, na.rm = TRUE)
max_vals <- apply(spectra_14_ovary, 2, max, na.rm = TRUE)
spectra_scaled <- sweep(sweep(spectra_14_ovary, 2, min_vals, `-`), 2, max_vals - min_vals, `/`)
spectra_scaled <- as.matrix(spectra_scaled)  # 确保为矩阵


# 3. UMAP降维（Python）
library(reticulate)
umap <- import("umap")
np <- import("numpy")

np$random$seed(2025L)
umap_result <- umap$UMAP(
    # metric = "euclidean",  # 默认值,欧几里得距离
    metric = "cosine",  # 余弦距离
    n_neighbors = 30L,        
    min_dist = 0.05,
    n_components = 2L,
    random_state = 2025L,  # 随机数种子（Random Seed）
    n_jobs = 1L,
    verbose = TRUE
)$fit_transform(spectra_scaled)

# 4. 转换为R格式（优化后的版本）
umap_matrix <- py_to_r(np$array(umap_result, dtype = np$float64))
umap_df <- data.frame(
    UMAP1 = umap_matrix[, 1],
    UMAP2 = umap_matrix[, 2],
    row.names = rownames(spectra_14_ovary)  # 保留样本名
)


# kmeans -----------------------
set.seed(2024)
kmeans_result <- kmeans(umap_df[, c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")], centers = 10) 

umap_df$kmeans_cluster <- as.factor(kmeans_result$cluster)
umap_df$ID <- pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$run
umap_df$x <- pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$x
umap_df$y <- pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$y
umap_df$pixel_ID <- pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$pixel_ID

# 检查 pixel_ID 是否一致
all(pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$pixel_ID == umap_df$pixel_ID)  # 应该返回 TRUE

# 如果一致，直接赋值
pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$kmeans_cluster <- umap_df$kmeans_cluster

# UMAP使用欧氏距离得到的聚类结果并不如余弦距离好（比如卵泡对应的聚类形状较分散，并非圆形或椭圆形）。这里用 UMAP余弦距离+Kmeans 可能并非最优方案。


# UMAP坐标图 ----------------------
# class(umap_df)
library(ggplot2)
Fig_S3A <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = kmeans_cluster)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.01, alpha = 0.7) +  # 使用点形状
    labs(# title = "UMAP Clustering of All Pixels", 
         x = "UMAP1", 
         y = "UMAP2") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values =  c("1" = "#3C5488",    # 深蓝色
                    "2" = "#00A087",    # 蓝绿色
```

1.  对行标准化（RMS）和对列标准化（特征标准化）解决的是不同的问题：

-   行标准化：使不同样本（像素）之间的总强度可比（消除样本间总强度的差异）。

-   列标准化：使不同特征（代谢物）的变异幅度可比（消除特征间量纲和变异幅度的差异）。

2.  在代谢组学中，常见的做法是：

-   首先进行样本（行）标准化（如RMS、TIC等）以消除技术误差（如样品厚度、电离效率等）。

-   然后进行特征（列）标准化（如z-score，或除以特征的标准差，或者使用其他方法如Pareto标准化等），以使得每个特征在后续的多变量分析（如PCA、聚类）中具有同等的权重。

```{r,echo=TRUE,fig.height=6,fig.width=12}
# 亚区合并----------------
library(Cardinal)
library(ggplot2)
setwd('/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/')

color_gradient1 <- colorRampPalette(c("black", "#000033", "#000066", "#0000FF", "#0077FF", "#00AAFF", "cyan","#66FF99", "green", "#AFFF00", "yellow","#FFCC00", "#FF9F00", "#FF6600", "red", "#CC0066", "purple"))(300)

# y_6间质，微调 -----------------------

             (pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$ovary_ID == "y_6")

# 2. 修改 ROI（确保 ROI 是字符型以避免因子问题）

    "stroma",
    as.character(pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$ROI)
)
```

```{r,echo=TRUE,fig.height=8,fig.width=24}
)(300)

library(Cardinal)
set.seed(2025)
mouse_14_ovary_ssc <- spatialShrunkenCentroids(mouse_14_ovary,
                                            y=pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$ROI,
                                       weights = "adaptive", 
                                       # BPPARAM = getCardinalBPPARAM(),
                                       verbose = getCardinalVerbose())
# calculating global centroid
# initializing clusters with spatial k-means
# Error in do_one(nmeth) : NA/NaN/Inf in foreign function call (arg 1)
# 如出现上述报错，除了检查数据是否含NA,NAN等，可以增大邻域半径r的数值

# spatialShrunkenCentroids() 的工作原理：
# 输入：
# y = pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$ROI → 像素属于哪个 感兴趣区域（ROI）（如 follicle等）。
# weights = "adaptive" → 自适应收缩权重（类似 惩罚似然估计）。
#
# 输出：
# statistic 列的 t 值 是基于 “空间收缩的均值差异”（spatial shrunken centroids）计算的 伪t统计量（类似 Welch's t-test，但结合了 空间权重和自适应收缩）。
# 更接近 单样本t检验，但考虑了 邻近像素的空间信息。

mouse_14_ovary_ssc
```

```{r,echo=TRUE,fig.width=10}
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)  # 关键：使用 ggh4x 强制分组排序

# === 1. 手动构建 dataframe（如果你的数据已经是这样，跳过这一步）===
plot_data <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    Group = "follicle",
    Class_I = c("GP", "Amino acid and Its metabolites", "GL", "Alcohol and amines", "FA", "Organic acid and Its derivatives", "Aldehyde,Ketones,Esters", "Carbohydrates and Its metabolites", "Hormones and hormone related compounds"),
    Count = c(25, 6, 5, 3, 3, 3, 1, 1, 1)
  ),
  tibble(
    Group = "corpus_luteum",
    Class_I = c("GP", "Amino acid and Its metabolites", "SL", "Aldehyde,Ketones,Esters", "GL", "Hormones and hormone related compounds", "Organic acid and Its derivatives", "CoEnzyme and vitamins"),
    Count = c(31, 7, 4, 3, 3, 2, 2, 1)
  ),
  tibble(
    Group = "stroma",
    Class_I = c("GP", "Aldehyde,Ketones,Esters", "GL", "Organic acid and Its derivatives", "Amino acid and Its metabolites", "SL", "Alcohol and amines", "FA", "Hormones and hormone related compounds"),
    Count = c(18, 5, 5, 5, 3, 3, 1, 1, 1)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("follicle", "stroma", "corpus_luteum")),
    Class_I = factor(Class_I)  # 重要：确保是 factor
  )

# === 2. 计算每组的 Class_I 排序 ===
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  mutate(
    Class_I_order = rank(-Count, ties.method = "first"),  # 按 Count 降序排序
    Class_I = reorder(Class_I, Class_I_order)  # 强制重新排序 Class_I
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# === 3. 绘图（核心修改）===
Fig_3E <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = Group,
    y = Count,
    fill = Class_I,  # 使用排序后的 Class_I
    group = Group    # 关键！告诉 ggplot2 按 Group 分组
  )
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "#E64B35",  # GP
      "#4DBBD5",  # Amino acid and Its metabolites
      "#00A087",  # GL
      "#3C5488",  # Alcohol and amines
      "#F39B7F",  # FA
      "#8491B4",  # Organic acid and Its derivatives
      "#91D1C2",  # Aldehyde,Ketones,Esters
      "#DC0000",  # Carbohydrates and Its metabolites
      "#7E6148",  # Hormones and hormone related compounds
      "#B09C85",  # SL
      "cyan"      # CoEnzyme and vitamins
    ),
    breaks = levels(plot_data$Class_I),  # 确保颜色顺序正确
    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 11)      # 分列显示图例
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of Metabolites", fill = "Class I") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Count),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 11))  # 分列显示图例（如果需要）


# === 4. 检查 Group 内排序 ===

# 按数量降序排列 OK ---------------------
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. 从原始数据框df生成plot_data (不自定义数据)
plot_data <- df %>% 
  count(Group, Class_I, name = "Count") %>%   # 自动统计频数
  mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = c("follicle", "stroma", "corpus_luteum"))) %>%  # 固定Group顺序
  group_by(Group) %>%
  mutate(
    Class_I_order = rank(-Count, ties.method = "first"),  # 记录降序排序序号
    Class_I = fct_reorder(Class_I, -Count)  # 按Count降序排列因子
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2. 检查排序结果 (验证每个Group内部的Class_I是否按Count降序)
plot_data %>%
  arrange(Group, Class_I_order) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# 3. 预定义颜色映射 (确保颜色一致性)
class_colors <- c(
  "#E64B35", "#4DBBD5", "#00A087", "#3C5488", "#F39B7F",
  "#8491B4", "#91D1C2", "#DC0000", "#7E6148", "#B09C85", "cyan"
)
names(class_colors) <- levels(plot_data$Class_I)  # 按排序后的因子水平命名颜色

# 4. 绘图 (确保堆叠顺序与图例顺序一致)
Fig_3E2 <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = Group,
    y = Count,
    fill = Class_I,           # 使用排序后的因子
    group = interaction(Group, Class_I_order)  # 确保堆叠顺序
  )
) +
  geom_col(position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +  # reverse=TRUE保持排序
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = class_colors,
    breaks = levels(plot_data$Class_I),  # 按因子水平排序图例
    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 11)
  ) +
  geom_text(

# 按比例降序排列 OK ----------------------
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)

# ====== 1. 从原始数据框 `df` 生成百分比数据
plot_data_percent <- df %>% 
  count(Group, Class_I, name = "Count") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = c("follicle", "stroma", "corpus_luteum"))) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>% 
  mutate(
    Percent = Count / sum(Count) * 100,  # 计算百分比
    Class_I = fct_reorder(Class_I, -Percent)  # 按占比降序排列因子
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ====== 2. 检查排序结果 (验证每个Group内的Class_I是否按Percent降序) 
plot_data_percent %>%
  arrange(Group, desc(Percent)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# spatialShrunkenCentroids @t统计量 @富集代谢物筛选 ----------------
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(Cardinal)

# set.seed(2025)
# mouse_14_ovary_ssc <- spatialShrunkenCentroids(mouse_14_ovary,y=pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$ROI,weights = "adaptive",verbose = getCardinalVerbose()) # BPPARAM = getCardinalBPPARAM(), 

merged_data <- topFeatures(mouse_14_ovary_ssc, sort.by = "statistic") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%               # 转换DataFrame为普通数据框
  mutate(
    mz = round(as.numeric(mz), digits = 4)
    # mz = sprintf("%.4f", as.numeric(mz))  # 强制4位小数，转为字符型（保留末尾0）
  ) %>%
  select(mz, class, statistic) %>%  # 只保留需要的列
  pivot_wider(                      # 长表变宽表：区域名作为列名
    names_from = class,             
    values_from = statistic
  ) %>% 
  filter(if_any(-mz, ~!is.na(.) & . != 0)) %>%  # 删除全NA/0的行
  column_to_rownames("mz")          # mz列变行名
  
# merged_data矩阵中的数据表示的是 statistic 值（每个 mz 在对应组织区域的统计量）


# 代谢物t统计量(行)标准化 @热图 ------------------------------------
# t统计量已经提供了标准化的比较,数据的行列无需再标准化
# 如需强调代谢物分布模式而非绝对值，可对行进行标准化
# 行标准化(代谢物)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

Enriched_meta_data <- merged_data[as.numeric(rownames(merged_data)) %in% df$Precursor_Da, ]

# 1. 数据标准化（按行Z-score）并转置
scaled_data <- t(scale(t(Enriched_meta_data[, c("stroma","follicle","corpus_luteum")])))  # "sprayed_matrix", 

# 2. 按组（follicle/corpus_luteum/matrix）排序，组内按 t-statistics 降序
row_order <- order(
  apply(scaled_data, 1, function(x) names(x)[which.max(x)]),  # 先分组
  apply(scaled_data, 1, max),                                 # 组内按最大值降序
  decreasing = TRUE
)

# 3. 热图绘制（行按手动排序，列固定顺序）
Fig_3D <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  scaled_data[row_order, ],  # 按排序后的行顺序
  col = colorRampPalette(c("#4DBBD5","white","#DC0000"))(50), 
  cluster_columns = FALSE,      # 列不聚类
  cluster_rows = FALSE,         # 行不聚类（手动排序已处理）
  column_names_rot = 45,        # 列名倾斜45度
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "t-statistics",     # 图例标题
    title_position = "topcenter"),
  column_title = "Spatially Enriched Metabolites", 
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 18),  # 主标题字体
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16),   # 列名字体
  width = unit(4, "inch"),  # 设置列宽
  show_row_names = F,
  show_column_names = TRUE
)

Fig_3D 

# image(mouse_14_ovary,'ROI',key=T,scale=F,superpose = FALSE,free="xy")

pdf("Fig_3D_t-statistics_of_Spatially_Enriched_Metabolites.pdf", 
    width = 6, 
    height = 6,
    family = "Arial")  # 设置全局字体
ComplexHeatmap::draw(Fig_3D)  # 显式调用 draw()
dev.off()


# 保存文件 ----------
Enriched_meta_data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "mz") %>%
  writexl::write_xlsx("Table_S2_Spatially_Enriched_Metabolites_After_Manual_Selection_with_Corresponding_t-Statistics.xlsx")
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
# 提取卵泡区域 ----------------------

# 提取卵泡区代谢物强度值 ------------------
library(Cardinal)

# 提取 mz 数据
extract_intensity <- function(obj) {
  intensity_data <- intensity(obj)
  intensity_data <- as.matrix(intensity_data)
  rowMeans(intensity_data, na.rm = TRUE)  # 计算每行的均值，忽略 NA 值
}

# 定义对象列表
objects <- list(y1_follicles, y2_follicles, y3_follicles, y4_follicles, y5_follicles, y6_follicles, y7_follicles, o1_follicles, o2_follicles, o3_follicles, o4_follicles, o5_follicles, o6_follicles, o7_follicles)

# 提取 mz 数据

# 对每个对象应用提取函数并合并结果
intensity_matrix <- sapply(objects, extract_intensity)

# 将 intensity_matrix 转换为数据框
intensity_df <- as.data.frame(intensity_matrix)


# 设置列名为对象的名称
# 单引号 ' 或 双引号 "（R 中两者等价）
colnames(intensity_df) <- c('y1_follicles', 'y2_follicles', 'y3_follicles', 'y4_follicles', 'y5_follicles', 'y6_follicles', 'y7_follicles',
  'o1_follicles', 'o2_follicles', 'o3_follicles', 'o4_follicles', 'o5_follicles', 'o6_follicles', 'o7_follicles')


# 保留 4 位小数
formatted_mz_data <- formatC(mz_data, format = "f", digits = 4)
rownames(intensity_df) <- formatted_mz_data # 将 mz 作为行名

intensity_14_follicles <- intensity_df

head(intensity_14_follicles)

# 差异代谢物分析完整流程 --------------
library(ropls)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)

### 1. 数据准备与预处理 ###
# 定义原始数据和log转换数据（全局变量）
raw_data <- intensity_14_follicles  # 原始数据（未转换）
log_data <- log2(raw_data + 1)   # log2(x+1)转换后的数据（用于参数检验）

# 分组变量设置
group <- ifelse(grepl("^y", colnames(raw_data)), "2M", "9M") %>% 
  factor(levels = c("2M", "9M"))


### 2. OPLS-DA分析与VIP计算 ###
# 注意：VIP计算使用log转换+Pareto标准化后的数据
set.seed(2025)
oplsda_result <- opls(
  x = t(log_data),               # 输入log转换数据（样本×代谢物）
  y = group,                     # 使用统一的分组变量
  predI = 1,                     # 主成分数
  orthoI = 1,                    # 正交成分数
  log10L = FALSE,                # 已提前log转换，此处不再重复
  permI = 1000,                  # 置换检验次数
  scaleC = "pareto"              # Pareto标准化（VIP计算关键步骤）
)

# 提取VIP分数
vip_scores <- getVipVn(oplsda_result)

# # 可视化OPLS-DA得分图
# pdf("Fig_4B_y2o_follicle_DEMs_OPLSDA_score_plot.pdf",
#     width = 8, height = 6, family = "Arial") 
# par(mfrow = c(1, 1)) 
# plot(oplsda_result, 
#      typeVc = "x-score",       # 绘制 X 得分图（样本得分）
#      parAsColFcVn = group,     # 按 group 着色样本点（要求为 factor）
#      parLabVc = rownames(t(raw_data)), # 样本标签
#      parCexN = 1.5,            # 调整点的大小
#      parEllipsesL = T,      # 关闭统计椭圆（可选）
#      parPaletteVc = c("#00A087", "#3C5488")
# )
# dev.off()


### 3. 差异代谢物统计分析 ###
DEMs_14_follicles <- raw_data %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    mz = round(as.numeric(rownames(.)), 4),  # m/z值，保留4位小数
    
    # 组均值（原始数据）
    young_mean = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("y")), na.rm = TRUE),
    old_mean = rowMeans(select(., !starts_with("y")), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # 变化倍数（原始数据计算后取log2）
    log2FC = log2(young_mean / old_mean),
    
    ### 基于log转换数据的统计检验 ###
    # Welch T检验（假设log转换后数据满足正态性）
    p_value_T = apply(log_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_8W <- x[group == "2M"]
      x_9M <- x[group == "9M"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_8W)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_9M)) < 2) return(NA)
      t.test(x_8W, x_9M, 
             alternative = "two.sided",
             var.equal = FALSE)$p.value  # Welch校正
    }),
    
    # FDR校正（BH方法）
    q_value_T = p.adjust(p_value_T, method = "BH"),
    
    ### 基于原始数据的非参数检验 ###
    # Mann-Whitney U检验（原始数据）
    p_value_Wilcox = apply(raw_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_8W <- x[group == "2M"]
      x_9M <- x[group == "9M"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_8W)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_9M)) < 2) return(NA)
      wilcox.test(x_8W, x_9M, 
                  alternative = "two.sided",
                  exact = FALSE)$p.value  # 大样本近似
    }),
    
    # FDR校正（BH方法）
    q_value_Wilcox = p.adjust(p_value_Wilcox, method = "BH"),
    
    ### VIP分数（来自OPLS-DA）###
    VIP = vip_scores
  )

### 4. 注释信息合并 ###
metware_data <- read_excel(
  "/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx"
) %>% 
  transmute(
    mz = round(as.numeric(`Precursor (Da)`), 4),
    Compounds, 物质, 
    `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG, Metlin, `PubChem CID`,
    `Class I`, 物质一级分类, `Class II`, 物质二级分类
  )  %>%
  mutate(`Class I` = case_when(
    `Class I` == "FA" ~ "Fatty Acids",
    `Class I` == "GL" ~ "Glycerolipids",
    `Class I` == "GP" ~ "Glycerophospholipids",
    `Class I` == "SL" ~ "Sphingolipids",
    `Class I` == "ST" ~ "Sterol Lipids",
    TRUE ~ `Class I` # 保持其他分类不变
  ))

# 左连接合并注释
DEMs_14_follicles <- DEMs_14_follicles %>%
  left_join(metware_data, by = "mz")


### 5. 显著差异代谢物筛选 ###
Y2O_sig_DEMs_14_follicles <- DEMs_14_follicles %>%
  filter(
    VIP > 1 &                # VIP阈值
    p_value_T < 0.05         # 显著性阈值
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%  # 按|log2FC|降序排列
  select(
    # 核心差异指标
    Compounds, 物质, mz, VIP, log2FC, 
    q_value_T, p_value_T, young_mean, old_mean,
    # 注释信息
    `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG, 
    Metlin, `PubChem CID`, `Class I`, 物质一级分类,
    `Class II`, 物质二级分类) %>%
  dplyr::rename(p_val = p_value_T, FDR = q_value_T)
# %>% select(Compounds,mz, VIP, log2FC,p_val,FDR, `Class I`, young_mean, old_mean) 

print(paste("Sig-DEMs of Follicles:",nrow(Y2O_sig_DEMs_14_follicles)))

Y2O_sig_DEMs_14_follicles %>%
  select(Compounds, VIP, p_val)  %>%
  writexl::write_xlsx("Table_S3_Follicle_DEMs(2M vs 9M).xlsx")


# OPLS-DA 图 ------------------
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# 提取 t1（预测主成分）和 to1（正交主成分）
oplsda_plot_data <- data.frame(
  t_pred = oplsda_result@scoreMN[, 1],  # predictive score (x-score 横轴)
  t_orth = oplsda_result@orthoScoreMN[, 1],  # orthogonal score (x-score 纵轴)
  group = as.factor(ifelse(grepl("^y", gsub("_","",colnames(intensity_14_follicles))), "2M", "9M")),
  sample_id = rownames(t(raw_data))  # 样本标签
)

model_stats <- oplsda_result@summaryDF
metrics <- c(
  R2X = model_stats$`R2X(cum)`,
  R2Y = model_stats$`R2Y(cum)`,
  Q2 = model_stats$`Q2(cum)`,
  RMSEE = model_stats$RMSEE,
  pre = model_stats$pre,
  ort = model_stats$ort
  # pR2Y = model_stats$pR2Y,
  # pQ2 = model_stats$pQ2
)

# 每列字符宽度
col_widths <- c(7, 7, 7, 8, 6, 6) # , 7, 6

# 生成对齐的两行文本
header <- sprintf("%-*s", col_widths, c("R2X", "R2Y", "Q2", "RMSEE", "pre", "ort")) # , "pR2Y", "pQ2"
values <- sprintf(paste0("%-", col_widths, ".3f"), metrics)  # 左对齐+3位小数

metrics_text <- paste0(
  paste(header, collapse = " "), "\n",  # 指标名行
  paste(values, collapse = " ")        # 数值行
)


Fig_4B <- ggplot(oplsda_plot_data, aes(x = t_pred, y = t_orth, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = sample_id),size = 6,
    box.padding = 0.3,max.overlaps = 20,show.legend = FALSE

  stat_ellipse(

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 3, color = "gray60") +

  scale_color_manual(values = c("2M" = "#00A087", "9M" = "#3C5488")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("2M" = "#00A087", "9M" = "#3C5488")) +
  labs(
    # x = paste0("t1 (", round(model_stats$`R2X(cum)`[1] * 100, 1), "%)"),
    x = "t1", y = "to1",
    title = "Follicles(2M vs 9M)",
    caption = metrics_text  
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16), 
    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"), # 图例符号大小
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA),  # 图例背景透明
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA),  # 图例键（符号背景）透明             
    legend.title = element_blank(),        
    plot.caption = element_text(

      size = 14,

  )

print(Fig_4B)

# PCA聚类 ----------------------------------
library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)  
# library(tidyverse)
set.seed(123)

pca_result <- 
  intensity_14_follicles %>% 
  t() %>%                     # 转置：1236 features × 14 → 14 × 1236
  scale() %>%                 # 中心化 + 标准化, 默认 center=TRUE, scale=TRUE
  prcomp(center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)  # PCA（因数据已标准化）


# 计算前两个主成分的解释百分比
explained_variance <- summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100
pc1_label <- paste0("PC1 (", round(explained_variance[1], 2), "%)")
pc2_label <- paste0("PC2 (", round(explained_variance[2], 2), "%)")

# 提取前两个主成分
pca_data <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x[, 1:2])
colnames(pca_data) <- c("PC1", "PC2")

# 根据列名中的 y 和 o 分组
# pca_data$Group_ID <- sub("_(.*)", "", rownames(transposed_data))  # 提取前缀部分
pca_data$Group_ID <- sub("^([a-z])([0-9]+)_.*", "\\1\\2", colnames(intensity_14_follicles))
pca_data$Group_Age <- ifelse(grepl("y", pca_data$Group_ID), "2M",  # (y 分组)
                             ifelse(grepl("o", pca_data$Group_ID), "9M", NA))  # (o 分组)
pca_data$Group_Name <- colnames(intensity_14_follicles)

# PCA 结果可视化
library(ggplot2)
Fig_4A <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group_Age)) +
    geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.7) +  # 添加点，设置点的大小和透明度
    geom_text(aes(label = Group_ID), # Group_ID
              vjust = -1,  # 调整文本位置，避免与点重叠
              size = 4,    # 设置文本大小
              check_overlap = F,  # 重叠
              show.legend = FALSE) +  # 文本不进入图例
    stat_ellipse(level = 0.95, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +  # 添加置信椭圆
    scale_color_manual(values = c("2M" = "#00A087","9M" = "#7E6148")) +
    labs(title = "Follicles(2M vs 9M)", 
         x = pc1_label,  # 设置 X 轴标题
         y = pc2_label,  # 设置 Y 轴标题
         color = NULL) +  # 设置图例标题
    theme_minimal() +  # 使用简约主题
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20),  
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),   
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),  # X轴标题大小
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),  # Y轴标题大小
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),   # X轴刻度数字大小
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),   # Y轴刻度数字大小
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16),  # 图例标题大小
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14),    # 图例文本大小
        # legend.position = "none", # 隐藏所有图例
        legend.position = c(0.1, 0.9),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)  # 添加坐标轴边框
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(label = "")))

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)  # 加载 ggrepel 包用于标签避让

# 1. 定义显著性分类
volcano_data <- DEMs_14_follicles %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      p_value_T >= 0.05 ~ "Not sig",
      VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC < 0 ~ "9M-Up",
      VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC > 0 ~ "2M-Up",
      TRUE ~ "Not sig"
    )
  )

# 2. 计算每组的数量（用于图例标签）
count_sig <- volcano_data %>%
  group_by(significance) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      significance == "9M-Up" ~ paste0("9M-Up (n=", count, ")"),
      significance == "2M-Up" ~ paste0("2M-Up (n=", count, ")"),
      TRUE ~ paste0("Not sig (n=", count, ")")
    )
  )


Fig_4C <- ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(p_value_T), color = significance)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("9M-Up" = "#E64B35", "2M-Up" = "#4DBBD5", "Not sig" = "gray80"),
    labels = c(
      "9M-Up" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "9M-Up"],
      "2M-Up" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "2M-Up"],
      "Not sig" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "Not sig"]
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Follicle DEMs(2M vs 9M)",
    x = expression(log[2]("Fold Change")),
    y = expression(-log[10]("p-value"))
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14,
    base_family = "Arial"  # 全局设置字体为 Arial，不加粗
  ) +
  xlim(-1, 1) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "plain"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 16, face = "plain"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 18, face = "plain"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain"),
    # legend.position = c(0.12, 0.9),   # 图例位置 (x, y)
    # legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"), # 图例符号大小
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA),  # 图例背景透明
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA),  # 图例键（符号背景）透明
    legend.position = "top"
  )

# 年龄差异@箱形图 ---------------------
library(ggpubr)
intensity_combined <- intensity_14_follicles
group_age <- ifelse(grepl("^y", colnames(intensity_combined,)), "2M", "9M")
group_age <- factor(group_age, levels = c("2M", "9M"))

age_mz_comparison <- function(mz, intensity_combined, group_age, mse_obj) {
  # 加载必要库
  if (!requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("readxl")
  }
  library(readxl)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  
  # 读取数据并转换类型
  ALL_sample_data <- read_excel("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx")
  
  # 转换Precursor列为数值型
  ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` <- suppressWarnings(
    round(as.numeric(ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)`), 4)
  )
  
  # 处理输入mz
  mz <- round(as.numeric(mz), 4)
  
  # 精确匹配行查找
  matched_data <- ALL_sample_data[ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` == mz, ]
  
  # 构建多行标题 
  title_lines <- c(
    # 第一行: m/z + 化合物名称
    paste0("m/z: ", sprintf("%.4f", mz), 
           if(nrow(matched_data) > 0) paste0("; ", matched_data$Compounds[1]) else "; Unmatched"),
    
    # 第二行: Class I (如果存在)
    if(nrow(matched_data) > 0 && !is.na(matched_data$`Class I`[1])) {
      paste0("Class I: ", matched_data$`Class I`[1])
    } else NULL,
    
    # 第三行: Class II (如果存在)
    if(nrow(matched_data) > 0 && !is.na(matched_data$`Class II`[1])) {
      paste0("Class II: ", matched_data$`Class II`[1])
    } else NULL
  )
  
  # 移除NULL行并组合为换行文本
  title_text <- paste(title_lines[!sapply(title_lines, is.null)], collapse = "\n")
  
  # 数据验证
  target_mz <- sprintf("%.4f", round(as.numeric(mz), 4))
  if (!target_mz %in% rownames(intensity_combined)) {
    stop(sprintf("Intensity data not found for m/z %s", target_mz))
  }
  
  # 准备绘图数据
  data <- data.frame(
    Expression = as.numeric(intensity_combined[target_mz, ]),
    Group = factor(group_age, levels = c("2M", "9M"))
  )
  
  # 绘图
  p <- ggboxplot(
    data,
    x = "Group",
    y = "Expression",
    color = "Group",
    # palette = "npg",
    palette = c("#4DBBD5", "#E64B35"),
    add = "jitter",
    width = 0.5,
    size = 0.8,
    add.params = list(size = 3)
  ) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = list(c("2M", "9M")),
      method = "t.test",
      label = "p.format",
      label.y = max(data$Expression) * 1.1,
      size = 4
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "Group",
      y = "Intensity"
    ) +
    ylim(NA, max(data$Expression) * 1.2) +  # 设置图形上边界
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold", 
        hjust = 0.5, 
        size = 16,
        lineheight = 1.2  # 调整行间距
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      panel.background = element_blank()
    )
  
  print(p)
}
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
# 差异代谢物分析完整流程 --------------
library(ropls)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)

### 1. 数据准备与预处理 ###
# 定义原始数据和log转换数据（全局变量）
raw_data <- intensity_14_stroma  # 原始数据（未转换）
log_data <- log2(raw_data + 1)   # log2(x+1)转换后的数据（用于参数检验）

# 分组变量设置
group <- ifelse(grepl("^y", colnames(raw_data)), "2M", "9M") %>% 
  factor(levels = c("2M", "9M"))


### 2. OPLS-DA分析与VIP计算 ###
# 注意：VIP计算使用log转换+Pareto标准化后的数据
set.seed(2025)
oplsda_result <- opls(
  x = t(log_data),               # 输入log转换数据（样本×代谢物）
  y = group,                     # 使用统一的分组变量
  predI = 1,                     # 主成分数
  orthoI = 1,                    # 正交成分数
  log10L = FALSE,                # 已提前log转换，此处不再重复
  permI = 1000,                  # 置换检验次数
  scaleC = "pareto"              # Pareto标准化（VIP计算关键步骤）
)

# 提取VIP分数
vip_scores <- getVipVn(oplsda_result)

# pdf("Fig_4E_y2o_stromal_DEMs_OPLSDA_score_plot.pdf",
#     width = 8, height = 6, family = "Arial") 
# par(mfrow = c(1, 1)) 
# plot(oplsda_result, 
#      typeVc = "x-score",       # 绘制 X 得分图（样本得分）
#      parAsColFcVn = group,     # 按 group 着色样本点（要求为 factor）
#      parLabVc = rownames(t(raw_data)), # 样本标签
#      parCexN = 1.5,            # 调整点的大小
#      parEllipsesL = T,      # 关闭统计椭圆（可选）
#      parPaletteVc = c("#00A087", "#3C5488")
# )
# dev.off()



### 3. 差异代谢物统计分析 ###
DEMs_14_stroma <- raw_data %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    mz = round(as.numeric(rownames(.)), 4),  # m/z值，保留4位小数
    
    # 组均值（原始数据）
    young_mean = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("y")), na.rm = TRUE),
    old_mean = rowMeans(select(., !starts_with("y")), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # 变化倍数（原始数据计算后取log2）
    log2FC = log2(young_mean / old_mean),
    
    ### 基于log转换数据的统计检验 ###
    # Welch T检验（假设log转换后数据满足正态性）
    p_value_T = apply(log_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_8W <- x[group == "2M"]
      x_9M <- x[group == "9M"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_8W)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_9M)) < 2) return(NA)
      t.test(x_8W, x_9M, 
             alternative = "two.sided",
             var.equal = FALSE)$p.value  # Welch校正
    }),
    
    # FDR校正（BH方法）
    q_value_T = p.adjust(p_value_T, method = "BH"),
    
    ### 基于原始数据的非参数检验 ###
    # Mann-Whitney U检验（原始数据）
    p_value_Wilcox = apply(raw_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_8W <- x[group == "2M"]
      x_9M <- x[group == "9M"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_8W)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_9M)) < 2) return(NA)
      wilcox.test(x_8W, x_9M, 
                  alternative = "two.sided",
                  exact = FALSE)$p.value  # 大样本近似
    }),
    
    # FDR校正（BH方法）
    q_value_Wilcox = p.adjust(p_value_Wilcox, method = "BH"),
    
    ### VIP分数（来自OPLS-DA）###
    VIP = vip_scores
  )

### 4. 注释信息合并 ###
metware_data <- read_excel(
  "/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx"
) %>% 
  transmute(
    mz = round(as.numeric(`Precursor (Da)`), 4),
    Compounds, 物质, 
    `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG, Metlin, `PubChem CID`,
    `Class I`, 物质一级分类, `Class II`, 物质二级分类
  ) %>%
  mutate(`Class I` = case_when(
    `Class I` == "FA" ~ "Fatty Acids",
    `Class I` == "GL" ~ "Glycerolipids",
    `Class I` == "GP" ~ "Glycerophospholipids",
    `Class I` == "SL" ~ "Sphingolipids",
    `Class I` == "ST" ~ "Sterol Lipids",
    TRUE ~ `Class I` # 保持其他分类不变
  ))

# 左连接合并注释
DEMs_14_stroma <- DEMs_14_stroma %>%
  left_join(metware_data, by = "mz")


### 5. 显著差异代谢物筛选 ###
Y2O_sig_DEMs_14_stroma <- DEMs_14_stroma %>%
  filter(
    VIP > 1 &                # VIP阈值
    p_value_T < 0.05         # 显著性阈值
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%  # 按|log2FC|降序排列
  select(
    # 核心差异指标
    Compounds, 物质, mz, VIP, log2FC, 
    q_value_T, p_value_T, young_mean, old_mean,
    # 注释信息
    `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG, 
    Metlin, `PubChem CID`, `Class I`, 物质一级分类,
    `Class II`, 物质二级分类
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(p_val = p_value_T, FDR = q_value_T) 
  # %>% select(Compounds,mz, VIP, log2FC,p_val,FDR, `Class I`, young_mean, old_mean) 

# 输出筛选结果维度
print(paste("Sig-DEMs of Stroma:",nrow(Y2O_sig_DEMs_14_stroma)))

### 6. 结果输出 ###
Y2O_sig_DEMs_14_stroma %>%
  select(Compounds, VIP, p_val) %>%
  writexl::write_xlsx("Table_S4_Stroma_DEMs(2M vs 9M).xlsx")

# 分组差异代谢物火山图 -----------------------
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)  # 加载 ggrepel 包用于标签避让

# 1. 定义显著性分类
volcano_data <- DEMs_14_stroma %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      p_value_T >= 0.05 ~ "Not sig",
      VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC < 0 ~ "9M-Up",
      VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC > 0 ~ "2M-Up",
      TRUE ~ "Not sig"
    )
  )

# 2. 计算每组的数量（用于图例标签）
count_sig <- volcano_data %>%
  group_by(significance) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      significance == "9M-Up" ~ paste0("9M-Up (n=", count, ")"),
      significance == "2M-Up" ~ paste0("2M-Up (n=", count, ")"),
      TRUE ~ paste0("Not sig (n=", count, ")")
    )
  )

Fig_4F <- ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(p_value_T), color = significance)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("9M-Up" = "#E64B35", "2M-Up" = "#4DBBD5", "Not sig" = "gray80"),
    labels = c(
      "9M-Up" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "9M-Up"],
      "2M-Up" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "2M-Up"],
      "Not sig" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "Not sig"]
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Stromal DEMs(2M vs 9M)",
    x = expression(log[2]("Fold Change")),
    y = expression(-log[10]("p-value"))
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 16,
    base_family = "Arial"
  ) +
  xlim(-1, 1) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "plain"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 16, face = "plain"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 18, face = "plain"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain"),
    # legend.position = c(0.12, 0.9),   # 图例位置 (x, y)
    # legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"), # 图例符号大小
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA),  # 图例背景透明
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA),  # 图例键（符号背景）透明
    legend.position = "top"

library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)

intensity_14_stroma_sig <- intensity_14_stroma %>%
  filter(as.numeric(rownames(intensity_14_stroma)) %in% Y2O_sig_DEMs_14_stroma$mz)

nrow(intensity_14_stroma_sig)

intensity_combined <- intensity_14_stroma
group_age <- ifelse(grepl("^y", colnames(intensity_combined,)), "2M", "9M")
group_age <- factor(group_age, levels = c("2M", "9M"))

age_mz_comparison <- function(mz, intensity_combined, group_age, mse_obj) {
  # 加载必要库
  if (!requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("readxl")
  }
  library(readxl)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  
  # 读取数据并转换类型
  ALL_sample_data <- read_excel("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx")
  
  # 转换Precursor列为数值型
  ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` <- suppressWarnings(
    round(as.numeric(ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)`), 4)
  )
  
  # 处理输入mz
  mz <- round(as.numeric(mz), 4)
  
  # 精确匹配行查找
  matched_data <- ALL_sample_data[ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` == mz, ]
  
  # 构建多行标题 
  title_lines <- c(
    # 第一行: m/z + 化合物名称
    paste0("m/z: ", sprintf("%.4f", mz), 
           if(nrow(matched_data) > 0) paste0("; ", matched_data$Compounds[1]) else "; Unmatched"),
    
    # 第二行: Class I (如果存在)
    if(nrow(matched_data) > 0 && !is.na(matched_data$`Class I`[1])) {
      paste0("Class I: ", matched_data$`Class I`[1])
    } else NULL,
    
    # 第三行: Class II (如果存在)
    if(nrow(matched_data) > 0 && !is.na(matched_data$`Class II`[1])) {
      paste0("Class II: ", matched_data$`Class II`[1])
    } else NULL
  )
  
  # 移除NULL行并组合为换行文本
  title_text <- paste(title_lines[!sapply(title_lines, is.null)], collapse = "\n")
 
  # 数据验证
  target_mz <- sprintf("%.4f", round(as.numeric(mz), 4))
  if (!target_mz %in% rownames(intensity_combined)) {
    stop(sprintf("Intensity data not found for m/z %s", target_mz))
  }
  
  # 准备绘图数据
  data <- data.frame(
    Expression = as.numeric(intensity_combined[target_mz, ]),
    Group = factor(group_age, levels = c("2M", "9M"))
  )
  
  # 绘图
  p <- ggboxplot(
    data,
    x = "Group",
    y = "Expression",
    color = "Group",
    # palette = "npg",
    palette = c("#4DBBD5", "#E64B35"),
    add = "jitter",
    width = 0.5,
    size = 0.8,
    add.params = list(size = 3)
  ) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = list(c("2M", "9M")),
      method = "t.test",
      label = "p.format",
      label.y = max(data$Expression) * 1.1,
      size = 4
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "Group",
      y = "Intensity"
    ) +
    ylim(NA, max(data$Expression) * 1.2) +  # 设置图形上边界
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold", 
        hjust = 0.5, 
        size = 16,
        lineheight = 1.2  # 调整行间距
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),

}
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
# 差异代谢物分析完整流程 --------------
library(ropls)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)

### 1. 数据准备与预处理 ###
# 定义原始数据和log转换数据（全局变量）
raw_data <- intensity_14_CL  # 原始数据（未转换）
log_data <- log2(raw_data + 1)   # log2(x+1)转换后的数据（用于参数检验）

# 分组变量设置
group <- ifelse(grepl("^y", colnames(raw_data)), "2M", "9M") %>% 
  factor(levels = c("2M", "9M"))


### 2. OPLS-DA分析与VIP计算 ###
# 注意：VIP计算使用log转换+Pareto标准化后的数据
set.seed(2025)
oplsda_result <- opls(
  x = t(log_data),               # 输入log转换数据（样本×代谢物）
  y = group,                     # 使用统一的分组变量
  predI = 1,                     # 主成分数
  orthoI = 1,                    # 正交成分数
  log10L = FALSE,                # 已提前log转换，此处不再重复
  permI = 1000,                  # 置换检验次数
  scaleC = "pareto"              # Pareto标准化（VIP计算关键步骤）
)

# 提取VIP分数
vip_scores <- getVipVn(oplsda_result)


# pdf("Fig_4H_y2o_CL_DEMs_OPLSDA_score_plot.pdf",
#     width = 8, height = 6, family = "Arial") 
# par(mfrow = c(1, 1)) 
# plot(oplsda_result, 
#      typeVc = "x-score",       # 绘制 X 得分图（样本得分）
#      parAsColFcVn = group,     # 按 group 着色样本点（要求为 factor）
#      parLabVc = rownames(t(raw_data)), # 样本标签
#      parCexN = 0.8,            # 调整点的大小
#      parEllipsesL = T,      # 关闭统计椭圆（可选）
#      parPaletteVc = c("#00A087", "#3C5488")
# )
# dev.off()



### 3. 差异代谢物统计分析 ###
DEMs_14_CL <- raw_data %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    mz = round(as.numeric(rownames(.)), 4),  # m/z值，保留4位小数
    
    # 组均值（原始数据）
    young_mean = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("y")), na.rm = TRUE),
    old_mean = rowMeans(select(., !starts_with("y")), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # 变化倍数（原始数据计算后取log2）
    log2FC = log2(young_mean / old_mean),
    
    ### 基于log转换数据的统计检验 ###
    # Welch T检验（假设log转换后数据满足正态性）
    p_value_T = apply(log_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_8W <- x[group == "2M"]
      x_9M <- x[group == "9M"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_8W)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_9M)) < 2) return(NA)
      t.test(x_8W, x_9M, 
             alternative = "two.sided",
             var.equal = FALSE)$p.value  # Welch校正
    }),
    
    # FDR校正（BH方法）
    q_value_T = p.adjust(p_value_T, method = "BH"),
    
    ### 基于原始数据的非参数检验 ###
    # Mann-Whitney U检验（原始数据）
    p_value_Wilcox = apply(raw_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_8W <- x[group == "2M"]
      x_9M <- x[group == "9M"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_8W)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_9M)) < 2) return(NA)
      wilcox.test(x_8W, x_9M, 
                  alternative = "two.sided",
                  exact = FALSE)$p.value  # 大样本近似
    }),
    
    # FDR校正（BH方法）
    q_value_Wilcox = p.adjust(p_value_Wilcox, method = "BH"),
    
    ### VIP分数（来自OPLS-DA）###
    VIP = vip_scores
  )

### 4. 注释信息合并 ###
metware_data <- read_excel(
  "/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx"
) %>% 
  transmute(
    mz = round(as.numeric(`Precursor (Da)`), 4),
    Compounds, 物质, 
    `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG, Metlin, `PubChem CID`,
    `Class I`, 物质一级分类, `Class II`, 物质二级分类
  ) %>%
  mutate(`Class I` = case_when(
    `Class I` == "FA" ~ "Fatty Acids",
    `Class I` == "GL" ~ "Glycerolipids",
    `Class I` == "GP" ~ "Glycerophospholipids",
    `Class I` == "SL" ~ "Sphingolipids",
    `Class I` == "ST" ~ "Sterol Lipids",
    TRUE ~ `Class I` # 保持其他分类不变
  ))

# 左连接合并注释
DEMs_14_CL <- DEMs_14_CL %>%
  left_join(metware_data, by = "mz")


### 5. 显著差异代谢物筛选 ###
Y2O_sig_DEMs_14_CL <- DEMs_14_CL %>%
  filter(
    VIP > 1 &                # VIP阈值
    p_value_T < 0.05         # 显著性阈值
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%  # 按|log2FC|降序排列
  select(
    # 核心差异指标
    Compounds, 物质, mz, VIP, log2FC, 
    q_value_T, p_value_T, young_mean, old_mean,
    # 注释信息
    `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG, 
    Metlin, `PubChem CID`, `Class I`, 物质一级分类,
    `Class II`, 物质二级分类
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(p_val = p_value_T, FDR = q_value_T)
  # %>% select(Compounds,mz, VIP, log2FC,p_val,FDR, `Class I`, young_mean, old_mean) 

# 输出筛选结果维度
print(paste("Sig-DEMs of Corpus Luteum:", nrow(Y2O_sig_DEMs_14_CL)))

### 6. 结果输出 ###
Y2O_sig_DEMs_14_CL %>%
  select(Compounds, VIP, p_val) %>%
  writexl::write_xlsx("Table_S5_Corpus_Luteum_DEMs(2M vs 9M).xlsx")

    significance = case_when(
      p_value_T >= 0.05 ~ "Not sig",
      VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC < 0 ~ "9M-Up",
      VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC > 0 ~ "2M-Up",
      TRUE ~ "Not sig"
    )
  )

      significance == "9M-Up" ~ paste0("9M-Up (n=", count, ")"),
      significance == "2M-Up" ~ paste0("2M-Up (n=", count, ")"),
      TRUE ~ paste0("Not sig (n=", count, ")")
    )
  )

  filter(as.numeric(rownames(intensity_14_CL)) %in% Y2O_sig_DEMs_14_CL$mz)

nrow(intensity_14_CL_sig)

intensity_combined <- intensity_14_CL
group_age <- ifelse(grepl("^y", colnames(intensity_14_CL,)), "2M", "9M")

age_mz_comparison <- function(mz, intensity_combined, group_age, mse_obj) {
  # 加载必要库
  if (!requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("readxl")
  }
  library(readxl)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  
  # 读取数据并转换类型
  ALL_sample_data <- read_excel("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx")
  
  # 转换Precursor列为数值型
  ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` <- suppressWarnings(
    round(as.numeric(ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)`), 4)
  )
  
  # 处理输入mz
  mz <- round(as.numeric(mz), 4)
  
  # 精确匹配行查找
  matched_data <- ALL_sample_data[ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` == mz, ]
  
  # 构建多行标题 
  title_lines <- c(
    # 第一行: m/z + 化合物名称
    paste0("m/z: ", sprintf("%.4f", mz), 
           if(nrow(matched_data) > 0) paste0("; ", matched_data$Compounds[1]) else "; Unmatched"),
    
    # 第二行: Class I (如果存在)
    if(nrow(matched_data) > 0 && !is.na(matched_data$`Class I`[1])) {
      paste0("Class I: ", matched_data$`Class I`[1])
    } else NULL,
    
    # 第三行: Class II (如果存在)
    if(nrow(matched_data) > 0 && !is.na(matched_data$`Class II`[1])) {
      paste0("Class II: ", matched_data$`Class II`[1])
    } else NULL
  )
  
  # 移除NULL行并组合为换行文本
  title_text <- paste(title_lines[!sapply(title_lines, is.null)], collapse = "\n")
  
  # 数据验证
  target_mz <- sprintf("%.4f", round(as.numeric(mz), 4))
  if (!target_mz %in% rownames(intensity_combined)) {
    stop(sprintf("Intensity data not found for m/z %s", target_mz))
  }
  
  # 准备绘图数据
  data <- data.frame(
    Expression = as.numeric(intensity_combined[target_mz, ]),
    Group = factor(group_age, levels = c("2M", "9M"))
  )
  
  # 绘图
  p <- ggboxplot(
    data,
    x = "Group",
    y = "Expression",
    color = "Group",
    # palette = "npg",
    palette = c("#4DBBD5", "#E64B35"),
    add = "jitter",
    width = 0.5,
    size = 0.8,
    add.params = list(size = 3)
  ) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = list(c("2M", "9M")),
      method = "t.test",
      label = "p.format",
      label.y = max(data$Expression) * 1.1,
      size = 4
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "Group",
      y = "Intensity"
    ) +
    ylim(NA, max(data$Expression) * 1.2) +  # 设置图形上边界
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold", 
        hjust = 0.5, 
        size = 16,
        lineheight = 1.2  # 调整行间距
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      panel.background = element_blank()
    )
  
  print(p)
}
```

```{r,eval=FALSE,fig.width=12,fig.height=24,fig.align='center'}
mat <- as.matrix(data[, 1:14])

# Z-score 标准化（按行）

# 设置分组（列：Young/Old；行：Class I）

# 2. 按数目降序提取类名

# 显示均值 ---------------
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(tibble)

# ===== 1. 数据预处理
setwd('/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/')

# 通用数据处理函数
prepare_data <- function(df, region_label) {
  df %>%
    filter(VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%
    select(Compounds, mz, young_mean, old_mean, `Class I`) %>%
    mutate(Region = region_label)  # 改为Region
}

# 处理三个数据集并合并
combined_data <- bind_rows(
  prepare_data(DEMs_14_follicles, "Follicle"),
  prepare_data(DEMs_14_stroma, "Stroma"),
  prepare_data(DEMs_14_CL, "CL")
)

# ===== 2. 矩阵标准化
mat_scaled <- combined_data %>% 
  select(young_mean, old_mean) %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  `rownames<-`(combined_data$Compounds) %>% 
  t() %>% 
  scale() %>% 
  t()

# ===== 3. 构建分组数据
df_group <- combined_data %>%
  select(Compound = Compounds, Region, Class_I = `Class I`) %>%  # 改为Class_I
  group_by(Region, Class_I) %>%
  mutate(Count = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Region, -Count)  # 按Region排序

# 按df_group的顺序重新排列矩阵
mat_ordered <- mat_scaled[df_group$Compound, , drop = FALSE]

# ===== 4. 颜色定义
# (1) Z-score颜色
col_zscore <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("blue", "white", "red"))

# (2) Region颜色
col_region <- c(
  Follicle = "#1F77B4", 
  Stroma = "#FF7F0E", 
  CL = "#2CA02C"
)

# (3) 化合物类别颜色
unique_classes <- unique(df_group$Class_I)
class_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))(length(unique_classes)),
  unique_classes
)

# ===== 5. 绘制热图
ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_ordered,
  name = "Z-score",
  col = col_zscore,
  
  # 列设置
  column_split = factor(c("2M", "9M"), levels = c("2M", "9M")),
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,  # 隐藏列名
  
  # 行设置
  row_split = df_group$Region,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  row_title = NULL,          # 完全隐藏左侧行标题
  
  # 右侧注释
  right_annotation = rowAnnotation(
    Region = df_group$Region,
    Class_I = df_group$Class_I,  # 改为Class_I
    col = list(
      Region = col_region,
      Class_I = class_colors
    ),
    show_annotation_name = TRUE,
    annotation_name_side = "top",
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
  ),
  
  # 顶部年龄注释
  top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
    Age = c("2M", "9M"),
    col = list(Age = c("2M" = "#FFA500", "9M" = "#800080")),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    show_legend = FALSE
  ),
  
  # 图形参数
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Z-score",
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
  ),
  border = FALSE
)

# 调整图例位置
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right")

  row_names_max_width = unit(16, "cm"),  # 控制化合物显示区域的宽度
  
  # 边框设置 🟡 控制单元格 + Region 分割
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.3), # 每个单元格边框（细黑线）
  border = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1),    # 整个热图外边框
  
  # 调整 Region 分割的间距 ✅ 使用 `gap` 而非 `row_split_gap`
  gap = unit(1, "mm"),        # 控制不同 Region 之间的间隔（默认为 1mm）
  
  # 右侧注释
  right_annotation = rowAnnotation(
    Region = df_group$Region,
    Class_I = df_group$Class_I,
    col = list(
      Region = col_region,
      Class_I = class_colors
    ),
    show_annotation_name = TRUE,
    annotation_name_side = "top",
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    gap = unit(2, "mm")       # 控制右侧注释之间的间隔
  ),
  
  # 顶部年龄注释（带边框）
  top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
    Age = c("2M", "9M"),
    col = list(Age = c("2M" = "#FFA500", "9M" = "#800080")),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    show_legend = FALSE,
    border = F      # 顶部注释添加边框
  ),
  
  # 图例（带边框）
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Z-score",  
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    grid_border = "black"  # 图例边框
  )
)


draw(ht, 
     heatmap_legend_side = "right",
     padding = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "mm"),  # 调整边距 (上右下左)
     align_heatmap_legend = "global_center",  # 热图与图例一起居中
     newpage = TRUE)

# draw(ht)
# dev.off()


library(extrafont)
pdf("DEMs_heatmap.pdf", width = 12, height = 24, family = "Arial")  # 单位：英寸

     padding = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "mm"),  # 调整边距 (上右下左)
     align_heatmap_legend = "global_center",  # 热图与图例一起居中

# 代码合并版 @显示均值+边框 -------------------
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(tibble)

# ===== 1. 数据预处理
setwd('/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/')

prepare_data <- function(df, region_label) {
  df %>%
    filter(VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%
    select(Compounds, mz, young_mean, old_mean, `Class I`) %>%
    mutate(Region = region_label)  # 改为Region
}

# library(readxl)
# DEMs_14_follicles <- read_excel("Table_S3_Follicle_DEMs(2M vs 9M).xlsx")
# DEMs_14_stroma <- read_excel("Table_S4_Stroma_DEMs(2M vs 9M).xlsx")
# DEMs_14_CL <- read_excel("Table_S5_Corpus_Luteum_DEMs(2M vs 9M).xlsx")
# 
# # 通用数据处理函数
# prepare_data <- function(df, region_label) {
#   df %>%
#     filter(VIP > 1 & p_val < 0.05) %>%
#     arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%
#     select(Compounds, mz, young_mean, old_mean, `Class I`) %>%
#     mutate(Region = region_label)  # 改为Region
# }

# 处理三个数据集并合并
combined_data <- bind_rows(
  prepare_data(DEMs_14_follicles, "Follicle"),
  prepare_data(DEMs_14_stroma, "Stroma"),
  prepare_data(DEMs_14_CL, "CL")
)

# ===== 2. 矩阵标准化
mat_scaled <- combined_data %>% 
  select(young_mean, old_mean) %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  `rownames<-`(combined_data$Compounds) %>% 
  t() %>% 
  scale() %>% 
  t()

# ===== 3. 构建分组数据
df_group <- combined_data %>%
  select(Compound = Compounds, Region, Class_I = `Class I`) %>%  # 改为Class_I
  group_by(Region, Class_I) %>%
  mutate(Count = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Region, -Count)  # 按Region排序

# 按df_group的顺序重新排列矩阵
mat_ordered <- mat_scaled[df_group$Compound, , drop = FALSE]

# ===== 4. 颜色定义
# (1) Z-score颜色
# col_zscore <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#4DBBD5","white","#DC0000"))
col_zscore <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("blue", "white", "red"))


# (2) Region颜色
col_region <- c(
  Follicle = "#2CA02C", 
  Stroma = "#7E6148", 
  CL = "#E64B35"
)

# (3) 化合物类别颜色
unique_classes <- unique(df_group$Class_I)
# class_colors <- setNames(
#   colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))(length(unique_classes)),
#   unique_classes
# )

class_colors <- setNames(c(
  "#DC0000", "#4DBBD5", "#91D1C2", "#B09C85", "#8491B4",
  "#3C5488", "#E64B35", "#00A087", "#7E6148", "#F39B7F",
  "#2196F3", "#FFC107", "#9C27B0", "#4CAF50"), unique_classes)


ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_ordered,
  name = "Z-score",
  col = col_zscore,
  
  # 列设置
  column_split = factor(c("2M", "9M"), levels = c("2M", "9M")),
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,  # 隐藏列名
  
  # 行设置
  row_split = df_group$Region,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,      # 显示行名
  row_names_side = "left",    # 行名显示在左侧
  row_title = NULL,           # 隐藏行标题
  
  # 尺寸调整
  width = unit(2, "cm"),      # 控制热图主图的宽度
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),  # 调整行名字体大小
  row_names_max_width = unit(16, "cm"),  # 控制化合物显示区域的宽度
  
  # 边框设置: 控制单元格 + Region 分割
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.3), # 每个单元格边框（细黑线）
  border = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1),    # 整个热图外边框
  
  # 调整 Region 分割的间距 ✅ 使用 `gap` 而非 `row_split_gap`
  gap = unit(1, "mm"),        # 控制不同 Region 之间的间隔（默认为 1mm）
  
  # 右侧注释
  right_annotation = rowAnnotation(
    Region = df_group$Region,
    Class_I = df_group$Class_I,
    col = list(
      Region = col_region,
      Class_I = class_colors
    ),
    show_annotation_name = TRUE,
    annotation_name_side = "top",
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    gap = unit(2, "mm")       # 控制右侧注释之间的间隔
  ),
  
  # 顶部年龄注释（带边框）
  top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
    Age = c("2M", "9M"),
    col = list(Age = c("2M" = "#00A087", "9M" = "#DC0000")),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    show_legend = FALSE,
    border = F      # 顶部注释添加边框
  ),
  
  # 图例（带边框）
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Z-score",  
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    grid_border = "black"  # 图例边框
  )
)


draw(ht, 
     heatmap_legend_side = "right",
     padding = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "mm"),  # 调整边距 (上右下左)
     align_heatmap_legend = "global_center",  # 热图与图例一起居中
     newpage = TRUE)


# png("heatmap.png", width = 1000, height = 1800, res = 300)  # 高分辨率
# draw(ht)
# dev.off()


library(extrafont)
pdf("DEMs_heatmap.pdf", width = 12, height = 24, family = "Arial")  # 单位：英寸

draw(ht, 
     heatmap_legend_side = "right",
     padding = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "mm"),  # 调整边距 (上右下左)
     align_heatmap_legend = "global_center",  # 热图与图例一起居中
     newpage = TRUE)

dev.off()

# ===== 1. 数据预处理

prepare_data <- function(df, region_label) {
  df %>%
    filter(VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%
    select(Compounds, mz, young_mean, old_mean, `Class I`) %>%
    mutate(Region = region_label)  # 改为Region
}

# library(readxl)

combined_data <- bind_rows(
  prepare_data(DEMs_14_follicles, "Follicle"),

  prepare_data(DEMs_14_CL, "CL")
)

# ===== 2. 矩阵标准化
mat_scaled <- combined_data %>% 
  select(young_mean, old_mean) %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  `rownames<-`(combined_data$Compounds) %>% 
  t() %>% 
  scale() %>% 
  t()

# ===== 3. 构建分组数据
df_group <- combined_data %>%
  select(Compound = Compounds, Region, Class_I = `Class I`) %>%
  # Step 1: 计算每个 Region 内每个 Class_I 的频次
  group_by(Region, Class_I) %>%
  mutate(Count = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Step 2: 按 Region 分组，再按 Count 降序排列
  # 确保相同 Class_I 的行连续排列
  arrange(Region, -Count, Class_I) %>%
  # （可选）移除临时计算的频次列
  select(-Count)


# 按df_group的顺序重新排列矩阵
mat_ordered <- mat_scaled[df_group$Compound, , drop = FALSE]

# ===== 4. 颜色定义
# (1) Z-score颜色
# col_zscore <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#4DBBD5","white","#DC0000"))
col_zscore <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("blue", "white", "red"))

  "#2196F3", "#FFC107", "#9C27B0", "#4CAF50"), unique_classes)


ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_ordered,
  name = "Z-score",
  col = col_zscore,
  
  # 列设置
  column_split = factor(c("2M", "9M"), levels = c("2M", "9M")),
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,  # 隐藏列名
  
  # 行设置
  row_split = df_group$Region,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,      # 显示行名
  row_names_side = "left",    # 行名显示在左侧
  row_title = NULL,           # 隐藏行标题
  
  # 尺寸调整
  width = unit(2, "cm"),      # 控制热图主图的宽度
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),  # 调整行名字体大小
  row_names_max_width = unit(16, "cm"),  # 控制化合物显示区域的宽度
  
  # 边框设置: 控制单元格 + Region 分割
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.3), # 每个单元格边框（细黑线）
  border = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1),    # 整个热图外边框
  
  # 调整 Region 分割的间距 ✅ 使用 `gap` 而非 `row_split_gap`
  gap = unit(1, "mm"),        # 控制不同 Region 之间的间隔（默认为 1mm）
  
  # 右侧注释
  right_annotation = rowAnnotation(
    Region = df_group$Region,
    Class_I = df_group$Class_I,
    col = list(
      Region = col_region,
      Class_I = class_colors
    ),
    show_annotation_name = TRUE,
    annotation_name_side = "top",
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    gap = unit(2, "mm")       # 控制右侧注释之间的间隔
  ),
  
  # 顶部年龄注释（带边框）
  top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
    Age = c("2M", "9M"),
    col = list(Age = c("2M" = "#00A087", "9M" = "#DC0000")),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    show_legend = FALSE,
    border = F      # 顶部注释添加边框
  ),
  
  # 图例（带边框）
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Z-score",  
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    grid_border = "black"  # 图例边框
  )
)


draw(ht, 
     heatmap_legend_side = "right",
     padding = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "mm"),  # 调整边距 (上右下左)
     align_heatmap_legend = "global_center",  # 热图与图例一起居中
     newpage = TRUE)

pdf("DEMs_heatmap.pdf", width = 12, height = 24, family = "Arial")  # 单位：英寸

     align_heatmap_legend = "global_center",  # 热图与图例一起居中
     newpage = TRUE)

dev.off()

# 02 代谢物Z-score标准化 + 取均值 -----------------
library(dplyr)
preprocess_data <- function(df, sample_cols, region_name) {
  
  # 提取样本列（用于标准化）
  sample_data <- df %>% select(all_of(sample_cols))
  
  # 执行按行标准化
  scaled_data <- sample_data %>%
    as.matrix() %>%
    t() %>%              # 转置: 行为样本，列为代谢物
    scale() %>%          # 按列(原行)标准化
    t() %>%              # 转置回原始方向
    as.data.frame() %>%
    setNames(sample_cols)
  
  # 组合完整处理流程
  df %>%
    # 选择必要列并添加元数据
    select(mz, Compounds, `Class I`, log2FC, VIP, p_value_T, q_value_T) %>%
    bind_cols(scaled_data) %>%
    mutate(Region = region_name, Class_I = `Class I`) %>%
    
    # 筛选显著代谢物
    filter(VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05) %>%
    
    # 计算分组均值
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      `2M_mean` = mean(c_across(all_of(sample_cols[grepl("^y", sample_cols)]))),
      `9M_mean` = mean(c_across(all_of(sample_cols[grepl("^o", sample_cols)])))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    
    # 排序和计数
    arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%
    group_by(Class_I) %>%
    mutate(Metabolite_Count = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # arrange(desc(Metabolite_Count), desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%
    arrange(Region, -Metabolite_Count, Class_I) %>%
    
    # 整理输出格式
    select(Compounds, Class_I, Region, `2M_mean`, `9M_mean`, Metabolite_Count) %>%
    as.data.frame()
}


# 定义不同区域的样本列名
sample_cols_follicle <- paste0(c(rep("y",7), rep("o",7)), 1:7, "_follicles")
sample_cols_stroma <- paste0(c(rep("y",7), rep("o",7)), 1:7, "_stroma")
sample_cols_CL <- c(paste0("y", c(1:5,7), "_CL"), paste0("o", 1:6, "_CL"))

# 并行处理（速度更快）
Follicle_data <- preprocess_data(DEMs_14_follicles, sample_cols_follicle, "Follicle")
Stroma_data <- preprocess_data(DEMs_14_stroma, sample_cols_stroma, "Stroma")
CL_data <- preprocess_data(DEMs_14_CL, sample_cols_CL, "CL")

# 合并（保留所有行）
combined_data <- do.call(rbind, list(Follicle_data, Stroma_data, CL_data))
nrow(combined_data)



library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(extrafont)

class_colors <- c(
  "Amino acid and Its metabolites" = "#91D1C2",
  "Organic acid and Its derivatives" = "#4DBBD5",
  "GP" = "#DC0000", 
  "Alcohol and amines" = "#B09C85",
  "GL" = "#8491B4",
  "Aldehyde" = "#3C5488",
  "Ketones" = "#E64B35", 
  "Esters" = "#00A087",
  "Aldehyde,Ketones,Esters" = "#FF6B6B",  # 例如浅红色
  "FA" = "#7E6148",
  "SL" = "#F39B7F",
  "Nucleotide and Its metabolites" = "#2196F3",
  "Benzene and substituted derivatives" = "#FFD700",  # 金色
  "Carbohydrates and Its metabolites" = "#FFA500",    # 橙色
  "Hormones and hormone related compounds" = "#9400D3", # 紫色
  "Tryptamines,Cholines,Pigments" = "#FF00CC",        # 紫红色
  "Heterocyclic compounds" = "#4682B4"                # 钢蓝色
)

region_colors <- c("Follicle" = "#2CA02C", "Stroma" = "#7E6148", "CL" = "#E64B35")

# 直接生成热图数据
data_matrix <- as.matrix(combined_data[, c("2M_mean", "9M_mean")]) %>% 
  apply(2, as.numeric)
rownames(data_matrix) <- combined_data$Compounds

# 创建注释对象
annotations <- list(
  col_annot = HeatmapAnnotation(
    Group = c("2M_mean", "9M_mean"),
    col = list(Group = c("2M_mean" = "#1E88E5", "9M_mean" = "#D81B60")),
    annotation_name_side = "left"
  ),
  
  row_annot = rowAnnotation(
    Region = combined_data$Region,
    Class_I = combined_data$Class_I,
    col = list(Region = region_colors, Class_I = class_colors)
  )
)

ordered_index <- 1:nrow(combined_data)  # 获取排好序的索引


heatmap_obj <- Heatmap(
  matrix = data_matrix[ordered_index, ],
  name = "Z-score",
  col = heatmap_colors,
  right_annotation = annotations$row_annot,
  bottom_annotation = annotations$col_annot,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_names = T,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),  
  column_title = "Metabolic Intensity",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20, fontface = "bold", just = "right"),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    legend_width = unit(2, "cm"),
    legend_direction = "horizontal",
    title_position = "topcenter"
  ),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  row_names_max_width = unit(14, "cm"),
  gap = unit(3, "mm")
)

draw(heatmap_obj, heatmap_legend_side = "right") 

# 绘制并导出热图
library(extrafont)
pdf("DEMs_heatmap2.pdf", width = 12, height = 24, family = "Arial")
draw(heatmap_obj, heatmap_legend_side = "right") 
dev.off()

# 03 代谢物Z-score标准化 @分区域 @分年龄 @代谢物分类 ------------------------------
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

# 定义预处理函数
preprocess_data <- function(df, region_name) {
  target_cols <- c("Compounds", "Class I", "VIP", "p_value_T", 
                   grep("^y|^o", colnames(df), value = TRUE))
  
  df %>%
    select(all_of(target_cols)) %>%
    mutate(Region = region_name, Class_I = `Class I`) %>%
    filter(VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05) %>%
    select(-`Class I`) %>%
    arrange(desc(VIP)) %>%
    group_by(Class_I) %>%
    mutate(Metabolite_Count = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(Region, desc(Metabolite_Count), desc(VIP)) %>%
    select(Region, Compounds, Class_I, everything()) %>%
    select(-Metabolite_Count, -VIP, -p_value_T, -young_mean, -old_mean)
}

# 定义提取函数
extract_target_data <- function(raw_df, keep_compounds) {
  raw_df %>%
    filter(Compounds %in% keep_compounds) %>%
    distinct(Compounds, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(Compounds, `Class I`, matches("^y|^o")) %>%
    rename(Class_I = `Class I`) %>%
    select(-young_mean, -old_mean)
}

# 预处理数据
DEMs_all <- unique(c(
  preprocess_data(DEMs_14_follicles, "Follicle")$Compounds,
  preprocess_data(DEMs_14_stroma, "Stroma")$Compounds,
  preprocess_data(DEMs_14_CL, "CL")$Compounds
))

# 合并数据
merged_data <- extract_target_data(DEMs_14_follicles, DEMs_all) %>%
  inner_join(extract_target_data(DEMs_14_stroma, DEMs_all), 
             by = c("Compounds", "Class_I"), 
             suffix = c("_F", "_S")) %>%
  inner_join(extract_target_data(DEMs_14_CL, DEMs_all), 
             by = c("Compounds", "Class_I"))

# 标准化数据
z_data <- merged_data %>%
  select(-Compounds, -Class_I) %>%
  t() %>%
  scale() %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(Compounds = merged_data$Compounds,
         Class_I = merged_data$Class_I)

# 数据整形
wide_means <- z_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(Compounds, Class_I), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "z_score") %>%
  mutate(Age = ifelse(str_starts(Sample, "y"), "2M", "9M"),
         Region = case_when(
           str_detect(Sample, "follicles") ~ "Follicle",
           str_detect(Sample, "stroma") ~ "Stroma",
           str_detect(Sample, "_CL") ~ "CL"
         )) %>%
  group_by(Compounds, Class_I, Age, Region) %>%
  summarise(mean_z = mean(z_score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  unite("Group", Age, Region, sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>%
  select(Compounds, Class_I, Group, mean_z) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = mean_z)

# 准备热图数据
class_counts <- table(wide_means$Class_I)
class_order <- names(sort(class_counts, decreasing = TRUE))
wide_means$Class_I <- factor(wide_means$Class_I, levels = class_order)
wide_means <- wide_means[order(wide_means$Class_I), ]
mat_data <- as.matrix(wide_means[, !names(wide_means) %in% c("Compounds", "Class_I")])
rownames(mat_data) <- wide_means$Compounds

# 颜色定义
class_colors <- c(
  "Amino acid and Its metabolites" = "#91D1C2",
  "Organic acid and Its derivatives" = "#4DBBD5",
  "GP" = "#DC0000", 
  "Alcohol and amines" = "#B09C85",
  "GL" = "#8491B4",
  "Aldehyde" = "#3C5488",
  "Ketones" = "#E64B35", 
  "Esters" = "#00A087",
  "Aldehyde,Ketones,Esters" = "#FF6B6B",
  "FA" = "#7E6148",
  "SL" = "#F39B7F",
  "Nucleotide and Its metabolites" = "#2196F3",
  "Benzene and substituted derivatives" = "#FFD700",
  "Carbohydrates and Its metabolites" = "#FFA500",
  "Hormones and hormone related compounds" = "#9400D3",
  "Tryptamines,Cholines,Pigments" = "#FF00CC",
  "Heterocyclic compounds" = "#4682B4"
)

# 创建热图对象
ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_data,
  name = "Z-score",
  col = colorRamp2(breaks = c(-2, 0, 2), colors = c("blue", "white", "red")),
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_side = "left",
  row_names_max_width = unit(20, "cm"),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  width = unit(3, "cm"),
  height = unit(nrow(mat_data) * 0.4, "cm"),
  row_split = wide_means$Class_I,
  row_title = NULL,
  row_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "gray90", lwd = 0.5),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Z-score",
    legend_direction = "vertical",
    legend_height = unit(3, "cm")
  ),
  right_annotation = rowAnnotation(
    Class = wide_means$Class_I,
    col = list(Class = class_colors),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      Class = list(
        title = "Metabolite Class", 
        title_position = "topcenter",
        grid_height = unit(4, "mm"),
        legend_direction = "vertical"
      )
    )
  )
)


draw(ht, 
     heatmap_legend_side = "right",
     annotation_legend_side = "right",
     merge_legends = TRUE,
     padding = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm"))


pdf("DEMs_heatmap3.pdf", width = 20, height = 30)
draw(ht, 
     heatmap_legend_side = "right",
     annotation_legend_side = "right",
     merge_legends = TRUE,
     padding = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm"))
dev.off()
```
