## DEMs @分组均值热图 @先Z-score再取scale后的均值
```{r,echo=TRUE,fig.width=12,fig.height=24,fig.align='center'}
# 02 代谢物Z-score标准化 + 取均值 -----------------
library(dplyr)
preprocess_data <- function(df, sample_cols, region_name) {
  
  # 提取样本列（用于标准化）
  sample_data <- df %>% select(all_of(sample_cols))
  
  # 执行按行标准化
  scaled_data <- sample_data %>%
    as.matrix() %>%
    t() %>%              # 转置: 行为样本，列为代谢物
    scale() %>%          # 按列(原行)标准化
    t() %>%              # 转置回原始方向
    as.data.frame() %>%
    setNames(sample_cols)
  
  # 组合完整处理流程
  df %>%
    # 选择必要列并添加元数据
    select(mz, Compounds, `Class I`, log2FC, VIP, p_value_T, q_value_T) %>%
    bind_cols(scaled_data) %>%
    mutate(Region = region_name, Class_I = `Class I`) %>%
    
    # 筛选显著代谢物
    filter(VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05) %>%
    
    # 计算分组均值
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      `2M_mean` = mean(c_across(all_of(sample_cols[grepl("^y", sample_cols)]))),
      `9M_mean` = mean(c_across(all_of(sample_cols[grepl("^o", sample_cols)])))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    
    # 排序和计数
    arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%
    group_by(Class_I) %>%
    mutate(Metabolite_Count = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # arrange(desc(Metabolite_Count), desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%
    arrange(Region, -Metabolite_Count, Class_I) %>%
    
    # 整理输出格式
    select(Compounds, Class_I, Region, `2M_mean`, `9M_mean`, Metabolite_Count) %>%
    as.data.frame()
}


# 定义不同区域的样本列名
sample_cols_follicle <- paste0(c(rep("y",7), rep("o",7)), 1:7, "_follicles")
sample_cols_stroma <- paste0(c(rep("y",7), rep("o",7)), 1:7, "_stroma")
sample_cols_CL <- c(paste0("y", c(1:5,7), "_CL"), paste0("o", 1:6, "_CL"))

# 并行处理（速度更快）
Follicle_data <- preprocess_data(DEMs_14_follicles, sample_cols_follicle, "Follicle")
Stroma_data <- preprocess_data(DEMs_14_stroma, sample_cols_stroma, "Stroma")
CL_data <- preprocess_data(DEMs_14_CL, sample_cols_CL, "CL")

# 合并（保留所有行）
combined_data <- do.call(rbind, list(Follicle_data, Stroma_data, CL_data))
nrow(combined_data)

  "Amino acid and Its metabolites" = "#91D1C2",

  "Alcohol and amines" = "#B09C85",
  "GL" = "#8491B4",
  "Aldehyde" = "#3C5488",
  "Ketones" = "#E64B35", 
  "Esters" = "#00A087",
  "Aldehyde,Ketones,Esters" = "#FF6B6B",  # 例如浅红色
  "FA" = "#7E6148",
  "SL" = "#F39B7F",
  "Nucleotide and Its metabolites" = "#2196F3",
  "Benzene and substituted derivatives" = "#FFD700",  # 金色
  "Carbohydrates and Its metabolites" = "#FFA500",    # 橙色
  "Hormones and hormone related compounds" = "#9400D3", # 紫色
  "Tryptamines,Cholines,Pigments" = "#FF00CC",        # 紫红色
  "Heterocyclic compounds" = "#4682B4"                # 钢蓝色
)

region_colors <- c("Follicle" = "#2CA02C", "Stroma" = "#7E6148", "CL" = "#E64B35")

# 直接生成热图数据
data_matrix <- as.matrix(combined_data[, c("2M_mean", "9M_mean")]) %>%

# 创建注释对象
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
# 多组柱状图 ----------------
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. 数据处理 + 强制Group为因子
follicle <- Y2O_sig_DEMs_14_follicles %>%
  mutate(Group = factor("Follicle", levels = c("CL", "Stroma", "Follicle"))) %>%  # 直接定义为因子
  count(`Class I`, Group, name = "Count")

stroma <- Y2O_sig_DEMs_14_stroma %>%
  mutate(Group = factor("Stroma", levels = c("CL", "Stroma", "Follicle"))) %>%
  count(`Class I`, Group, name = "Count")

cl <- Y2O_sig_DEMs_14_CL %>%
  mutate(Group = factor("CL", levels = c("CL", "Stroma", "Follicle"))) %>%
  count(`Class I`, Group, name = "Count")

# 合并数据（自动保留因子顺序）
combined_data <- bind_rows(follicle, stroma, cl) %>%
  complete(`Class I`, Group, fill = list(Count = 0))

# 验证Group是否为因子且顺序正确
levels(combined_data$Group)

top5_classes <- combined_data %>%
  filter(Group == "CL") %>%
  arrange(desc(Count)) %>%

# 3. 绘图（x轴按Follicle的Count降序排列）

  x = factor(`Class I`, levels = top5_classes),

  fill = Group
)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CL" = "#6495ED", "Stroma" = "#4ECDC4", "Follicle" = "#FF6B6B")) +
  labs(title = "Top 5 Aging-Related DEMs", x = "Class I", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),

    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),  
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
  )
```

## 代谢通路 @MetOrigin
```{r,eval=FALSE,fig.height=6,fig.width=8}
# 代谢通路合并 @卵泡 @髓质 @黄体 ------------------
# 将前面得到的各区域的差异代谢物提交至MetOrigin,进行代谢通路注释。将结果整理到同一个表格中，对代谢通路进行可视化。补充Region列（Follicle, CL等）和代谢物来源Scorce列(Host, Co-Metabolism等)
setwd('/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/')

library(readxl)
Pathway_from_MetOrigin <- read_excel("Pathway_from_MetOrigin(2M vs 9M).xlsx")

head(Pathway_from_MetOrigin)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 筛选P值显著的通路 (Pvalue < 0.05)
filtered_data <- Pathway_from_MetOrigin %>%
  filter(Pvalue < 0.05) %>%
  select(Region, Source, Name, Pvalue)  # 保留关键列

# 查看筛选后的数据
head(filtered_data)

ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = reorder(Name, -Pvalue), y = -log10(Pvalue), fill = Source)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_grid(Region ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free") +  # 按Region分面
  coord_flip() +  # 横向条形图
  labs(x = "Pathway", y = "-log10(Pvalue)", fill = "Source") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")  # 分面标题加粗
  )


ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = Source, y = reorder(Name, Pvalue), size = -log10(Pvalue), color = Region)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ Region, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Source", y = "Pathway", size = "-log10(Pvalue)", color = "Region") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# 通路 @气泡图 ---------------
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)  # 用于添加自动换行

# 数据预处理：确保按 -log10(Pvalue) 排序
filtered_data <- Pathway_from_MetOrigin %>%
  filter(Pvalue < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    significance = -log10(Pvalue),
    scaled_size = scales::rescale(significance, to = c(1, 10)),
    
    Name = str_wrap(Name, width = 50), # 关键修改：自动换行（每行最多20个字符）
    
    Name_wrapped = factor(Name, levels = unique(Name[order(-significance)]))  # 按 -log10(Pvalue) 排序
  )

# 绘图
ggplot(filtered_data, 
       aes(
         x = Region,
         y = Name_wrapped,  # 使用换行后的名称
         size = significance,
         color = Region
       )) +
  geom_point(alpha = 1, shape = 16) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "-log10(Pvalue)",
    range = c(1, 10),
    breaks = seq(1, 3, by = 0.5)
  ) +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Region") +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Region",
    y = "Metabolic Pathway"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )


```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
  match_idx <- match(pixelData(mouse_14_ovary_independent)$pixel_ID, pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$pixel_ID)

  pixelData(mouse_14_ovary_independent)$ROI <- pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$ROI[match_idx]
```

```{r,eval=FALSE}
library(Cardinal)
extract_single_follicle <- function(Follicle_name, follicle_data) {
  # 获取该卵泡的元数据
  fol <- subset(follicle_data, Follicle_name == Follicle_name)
  
  # 确定所属样本数据集（例如：o1_f1 -> o_1_mse）
  sample_id <- strsplit(Follicle_name, "_")[[1]][1]  # 提取"o1"或"y2"等
  dataset_name <- paste0(
    tolower(substr(sample_id, 1, 1)),  # 首字母转小写（O->o, Y->y）
    "_",
    substr(sample_id, 2, 2),           # 提取数字部分
    "_mse"
  )
  
  # 检查数据集是否存在
  if (!exists(dataset_name)) {
    stop(paste("Dataset not found:", dataset_name))
  }
  
  # 提取对应的MSE数据
  ovary_data <- get(dataset_name)
  
  # 计算像素到卵泡中心的距离
  distance <- sqrt((ovary_data$x - fol$X)^2 + (ovary_data$y - fol$Y)^2)
  
  # 提取圆形区域内的像素
  follicular_pixels <- subsetPixels(ovary_data, distance <= fol$Radius)
  
  # 返回结果
  return(follicular_pixels)
}


Follicle_name <- follicle_data$Follicle_name  

# 提取所有卵泡（使用lapply提高效率）
all_follicles <- lapply(Follicle_name, function(name) {
  cat("Processing:", name, "\n")
  extract_single_follicle(name, follicle_data)
})
names(all_follicles) <- Follicle_name  # 命名列表

list2env(all_follicles, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# 合并卵泡 ---------------
library(Cardinal)

cbind_MSExperiment <- function(..., check_mz = TRUE) {
  objs <- list(...)
  if (check_mz && !all(sapply(objs[-1], function(x) identical(mz(x), mz(objs[[1]]))))) {
    stop("所有对象的 m/z 值必须完全相同")
  }
  Reduce(cbind, objs)  # 使用Reduce实现递归合并
}
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
# 差异代谢物分析完整流程 --------------
library(ropls)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)

### 1. 数据准备与预处理 ###
# 定义原始数据和log转换数据（全局变量）
raw_data <- intensity_of_Secondary_follicles  # 原始数据（未转换）
log_data <- log2(raw_data + 1)   # log2(x+1)转换后的数据（用于参数检验）

# 分组变量设置
group <- ifelse(grepl("^y", colnames(raw_data)), "2M", "9M") %>% 
  factor(levels = c("2M", "9M"))


### 2. OPLS-DA分析与VIP计算 ###
# 注意：VIP计算使用log转换+Pareto标准化后的数据
set.seed(2025)
oplsda_result <- opls(
  x = t(log_data),               # 输入log转换数据（样本×代谢物）
  y = group,                     # 使用统一的分组变量
  predI = 1,                     # 主成分数
  orthoI = 1,                    # 正交成分数
  log10L = FALSE,                # 已提前log转换，此处不再重复
  permI = 1000,                  # 置换检验次数
  scaleC = "pareto"              # Pareto标准化（VIP计算关键步骤）
)

# 提取VIP分数
vip_scores <- getVipVn(oplsda_result)

# 可视化OPLS-DA得分图
# pdf("Fig_5B_y2o_DEMs_of_Secondary_follicle_OPLSDA_score_plot.pdf",
#     width = 8, height = 6, family = "Arial") 
# par(mfrow = c(1, 1)) 
# plot(oplsda_result, 
#      typeVc = "x-score",       # 绘制 X 得分图（样本得分）
#      parAsColFcVn = group,     # 按 group 着色样本点（要求为 factor）
#      parLabVc = rownames(t(raw_data)), # 样本标签
#      parCexN = 0.8,            # 调整点的大小
#      parEllipsesL = T,      # 关闭统计椭圆（可选）
#      parPaletteVc = c("#00A087", "#3C5488")
# )
# dev.off()


### 3. 差异代谢物统计分析 ###
DEMs_Secondary <- raw_data %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mz = round(as.numeric(rownames(.)), 4),  # m/z值，保留4位小数
    
    # 组均值（原始数据）
    young_mean = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., starts_with("y")), na.rm = TRUE),
    old_mean = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., !starts_with("y")), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # 变化倍数（原始数据计算后取log2）
    log2FC = log2(young_mean / old_mean),
    
    ### 基于log转换数据的统计检验 ###
    # Welch T检验（假设log转换后数据满足正态性）
    p_value_T = apply(log_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_8W <- x[group == "2M"]
      x_9M <- x[group == "9M"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_8W)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_9M)) < 2) return(NA)
      t.test(x_8W, x_9M, 
             alternative = "two.sided",
             var.equal = FALSE)$p.value  # Welch校正
    }),
    
    # FDR校正（BH方法）
    q_value_T = p.adjust(p_value_T, method = "BH"),
    
    ### 基于原始数据的非参数检验 ###
    # Mann-Whitney U检验（原始数据）
    p_value_Wilcox = apply(raw_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_8W <- x[group == "2M"]
      x_9M <- x[group == "9M"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_8W)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_9M)) < 2) return(NA)
      wilcox.test(x_8W, x_9M, 
                  alternative = "two.sided",
                  exact = FALSE)$p.value  # 大样本近似
    }),
    
    # FDR校正（BH方法）
    q_value_Wilcox = p.adjust(p_value_Wilcox, method = "BH"),
    
    ### VIP分数（来自OPLS-DA）###
    VIP = vip_scores
  )

### 4. 注释信息合并 ###
metware_data <- read_excel(
  "/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx"
) %>% 
  transmute(
    mz = round(as.numeric(`Precursor (Da)`), 4),
    Compounds, 物质, 
    `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG, Metlin, `PubChem CID`,
    `Class I`, 物质一级分类, `Class II`, 物质二级分类
  ) %>%
  mutate(`Class I` = case_when(
    `Class I` == "FA" ~ "Fatty Acids",
    `Class I` == "GL" ~ "Glycerolipids",
    `Class I` == "GP" ~ "Glycerophospholipids",
    `Class I` == "SL" ~ "Sphingolipids",
    `Class I` == "ST" ~ "Sterol Lipids",
    TRUE ~ `Class I` # 保持其他分类不变
  ))


# 左连接合并注释
DEMs_Secondary <- DEMs_Secondary %>%
  left_join(metware_data, by = "mz")


### 5. 显著差异代谢物筛选 ###
Y2O_sig_DEMs_Secondary <- DEMs_Secondary %>%
  filter(
    VIP > 1 &                # VIP阈值
    p_value_T < 0.05         # 显著性阈值
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%  # 按|log2FC|降序排列
  dplyr::select(
    # 核心差异指标
    Compounds, 物质, mz, VIP, log2FC, 
    q_value_T, p_value_T, young_mean, old_mean,
    # 注释信息
    `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG, 
    Metlin, `PubChem CID`, `Class I`, 物质一级分类,
    `Class II`, 物质二级分类
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(p_val = p_value_T, FDR = q_value_T) 
  # %>% select(Compounds,mz, VIP, log2FC,p_val,FDR)

# 输出筛选结果维度
print(paste("Sig-DEMs of Secondary Follicle:", nrow(Y2O_sig_DEMs_Secondary)))

### 6. 结果输出 ###
Y2O_sig_DEMs_Secondary %>%
  select(Compounds, VIP, p_val) %>%
  writexl::write_xlsx("Table_S7_Secondary_Follicle_DEMs(2M vs 9M).xlsx")

# 提取 t1（预测主成分）和 to1（正交主成分）
oplsda_plot_data <- data.frame(
  t_pred = oplsda_result@scoreMN[, 1],  # predictive score (x-score 横轴)
  t_orth = oplsda_result@orthoScoreMN[, 1],  # orthogonal score (x-score 纵轴)
  group = as.factor(ifelse(grepl("^y", gsub("_","",colnames(intensity_of_Secondary_follicles))), "2M", "9M")),

)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)  # 加载 ggrepel 包用于标签避让

# 1. 定义显著性分类
volcano_data <- DEMs_Secondary %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      p_value_T >= 0.05 ~ "Not sig",
      VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC < 0 ~ "9M-Up",
      VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC > 0 ~ "2M-Up",
      TRUE ~ "Not sig"
    )
  )

# 2. 计算每组的数量（用于图例标签）
count_sig <- volcano_data %>%
  group_by(significance) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      significance == "9M-Up" ~ paste0("9M-Up (n=", count, ")"),
      significance == "2M-Up" ~ paste0("2M-Up (n=", count, ")"),
      TRUE ~ paste0("Not sig (n=", count, ")")
    )
  )

Fig_5C <- ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(p_value_T), color = significance)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("9M-Up" = "#E64B35", "2M-Up" = "#4DBBD5", "Not sig" = "gray80"),
    labels = c(
      "9M-Up" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "9M-Up"],
      "2M-Up" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "2M-Up"],
      "Not sig" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "Not sig"]
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Secondary Follicle DEMs(2M vs 9M)",
    x = expression(log[2]("Fold Change")),
    y = expression(-log[10]("p-value"))
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 16,
    base_family = "Arial"  # 全局设置字体为 Arial，非加粗
  ) +
  xlim(-1, 1) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "plain"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 18, face = "plain"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 16, face = "plain"),

age_mz_comparison <- function(mz, intensity_combined, group_age, mse_obj) {
  # 加载必要库
  if (!requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("readxl")
  }
  library(readxl)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  
  # 读取数据并转换类型
  ALL_sample_data <- read_excel("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(`Class I` = case_when(
    `Class I` == "FA" ~ "Fatty Acids",
    `Class I` == "GL" ~ "Glycerolipids",
    `Class I` == "GP" ~ "Glycerophospholipids",
    `Class I` == "SL" ~ "Sphingolipids",
    `Class I` == "ST" ~ "Sterol Lipids",
    TRUE ~ `Class I` # 保持其他分类不变
  ))
  
  # 转换Precursor列为数值型
  ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` <- suppressWarnings(
    round(as.numeric(ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)`), 4)
  )
  
  # 处理输入mz
  mz <- round(as.numeric(mz), 4)
  
  # 精确匹配行查找
  matched_data <- ALL_sample_data[ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` == mz, ]

  
  # 构建多行标题
  # title_lines <- c(
  #   # 第一行: m/z + 化合物名称
  #   paste0("m/z: ", sprintf("%.4f", mz), 
  #          if(nrow(matched_data) > 0) paste0("; ", matched_data$Compounds[1]) else "; Unmatched"),
  #   
  #   # 第二行: Class I (如果存在)
  #   if(nrow(matched_data) > 0 && !is.na(matched_data$`Class I`[1])) {
  #     paste0("Class I: ", matched_data$`Class I`[1])
  #   } else NULL,
  #   
  #   # 第三行: Class II (如果存在)
  #   if(nrow(matched_data) > 0 && !is.na(matched_data$`Class II`[1])) {
  #     paste0("Class II: ", matched_data$`Class II`[1])
  #   } else NULL
  # )
  
  
  title_lines <- c(
  # 第一行: 仅显示m/z值
  paste0("m/z: ", sprintf("%.4f", mz)),
  
  # 第二行: 化合物名称（如果有匹配数据）
  if(nrow(matched_data) > 0) {
    paste0("Compound: ", matched_data$Compounds[1]) 
  } else "Compound: Unmatched",
  
  # 第三行: Class I（如果存在且非NA）
  if(nrow(matched_data) > 0 && !is.na(matched_data$`Class I`[1])) {
    paste0("Class I: ", matched_data$`Class I`[1])
  } else NULL,
  
  # 第四行: Class II（如果存在且非NA）
  if(nrow(matched_data) > 0 && !is.na(matched_data$`Class II`[1])) {
    paste0("Class II: ", matched_data$`Class II`[1])
  } else NULL
)
  
  # 移除NULL行并组合为换行文本
  title_text <- paste(title_lines[!sapply(title_lines, is.null)], collapse = "\n")
  
  # 统一行名为标准浮点格式（保留4位小数）
  rownames(intensity_combined) <- sprintf("%.4f", 
    as.numeric(rownames(intensity_combined)))
  
  # 数据验证
  # target_mz <- as.character(mz)
  # if (!target_mz %in% rownames(intensity_combined)) {
  #   stop(sprintf("Intensity data not found for m/z %.4f", mz))
  # }
  
  target_mz <- sprintf("%.4f", round(as.numeric(mz), 4))
  if (!target_mz %in% rownames(intensity_combined)) {
    stop(sprintf("Intensity data not found for m/z %s", target_mz))
  }
  
  
  
  # 准备绘图数据
  data <- data.frame(
    Expression = as.numeric(intensity_combined[target_mz, ]),
    Group = factor(group_age, levels = c("2M_Secondary", "9M_Secondary"))
  )
  
  # 绘图
  p <- ggboxplot(
    data,
    x = "Group",
    y = "Expression",
    color = "Group",
    # palette = "npg",
    palette = c("#4DBBD5", "#E64B35"),
    add = "jitter",
    width = 0.5,
    size = 0.8,
    add.params = list(size = 3)
  ) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = list(c("2M_Secondary", "9M_Secondary")),
      method = "t.test",
      label = "p.format",
      label.y = max(data$Expression) * 1.1,
      size = 6
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = NULL, # "Group",
      y = "Intensity"
    ) +
    ylim(NA, max(data$Expression) * 1.2) +  # 设置图形上边界
    theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold", 
        hjust = 0.5, 
        size = 20,
        lineheight = 1.2  # 调整行间距
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 20),
      # axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 20),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 20),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 18),
      # legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
      # legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      panel.background = element_blank()
    )
  
  print(p)
}
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
# 差异代谢物分析完整流程 --------------
library(ropls)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)

### 1. 数据准备与预处理 ###
# 定义原始数据和log转换数据（全局变量）
raw_data <- intensity_of_Antral_follicles  # 原始数据（未转换）
log_data <- log2(raw_data + 1)   # log2(x+1)转换后的数据（用于参数检验）

# 分组变量设置
group <- ifelse(grepl("^y", colnames(raw_data)), "2M", "9M") %>% 
  factor(levels = c("2M", "9M"))


### 2. OPLS-DA分析与VIP计算 ###
# 注意：VIP计算使用log转换+Pareto标准化后的数据
set.seed(2025)
oplsda_result <- opls(
  x = t(log_data),               # 输入log转换数据（样本×代谢物）
  y = group,                     # 使用统一的分组变量
  predI = 1,                     # 主成分数
  orthoI = 1,                    # 正交成分数
  log10L = FALSE,                # 已提前log转换，此处不再重复
  permI = 1000,                  # 置换检验次数
  scaleC = "pareto"              # Pareto标准化（VIP计算关键步骤）
)

# 提取VIP分数
vip_scores <- getVipVn(oplsda_result)

# 可视化OPLS-DA得分图
# pdf("Fig_5D_y2o_DEMs_of_Antral_follicle_OPLSDA_score_plot.pdf",
#     width = 8, height = 6, family = "Arial") 
# par(mfrow = c(1, 1)) 
# plot(oplsda_result, 
#      typeVc = "x-score",       # 绘制 X 得分图（样本得分）
#      parAsColFcVn = group,     # 按 group 着色样本点（要求为 factor）
#      parLabVc = rownames(t(raw_data)), # 样本标签
#      parCexN = 0.8,            # 调整点的大小
#      parEllipsesL = T,      # 关闭统计椭圆（可选）
#      parPaletteVc = c("#00A087", "#3C5488")
# )
# dev.off()


### 3. 差异代谢物统计分析 ###
DEMs_Antral <- raw_data %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    mz = round(as.numeric(rownames(.)), 4),  # m/z值，保留4位小数
    
    # 组均值（原始数据）
    young_mean = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("y")), na.rm = TRUE),
    old_mean = rowMeans(select(., !starts_with("y")), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # 变化倍数（原始数据计算后取log2）
    log2FC = log2(young_mean / old_mean),
    
    ### 基于log转换数据的统计检验 ###
    # Welch T检验（假设log转换后数据满足正态性）
    p_value_T = apply(log_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_8W <- x[group == "2M"]
      x_9M <- x[group == "9M"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_8W)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_9M)) < 2) return(NA)
      t.test(x_8W, x_9M, 
             alternative = "two.sided",
             var.equal = FALSE)$p.value  # Welch校正
    }),
    
    # FDR校正（BH方法）
    q_value_T = p.adjust(p_value_T, method = "BH"),
    
    ### 基于原始数据的非参数检验 ###
    # Mann-Whitney U检验（原始数据）
    p_value_Wilcox = apply(raw_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_8W <- x[group == "2M"]
      x_9M <- x[group == "9M"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_8W)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_9M)) < 2) return(NA)
      wilcox.test(x_8W, x_9M, 
                  alternative = "two.sided",
                  exact = FALSE)$p.value  # 大样本近似
    }),
    
    # FDR校正（BH方法）
    q_value_Wilcox = p.adjust(p_value_Wilcox, method = "BH"),
    
    ### VIP分数（来自OPLS-DA）###
    VIP = vip_scores
  )

### 4. 注释信息合并 ###
metware_data <- read_excel(
  "/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx"
) %>% 
  transmute(
    mz = round(as.numeric(`Precursor (Da)`), 4),
    Compounds, 物质, 
    `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG, Metlin, `PubChem CID`,
    `Class I`, 物质一级分类, `Class II`, 物质二级分类
  ) %>%
  mutate(`Class I` = case_when(
    `Class I` == "FA" ~ "Fatty Acids",
    `Class I` == "GL" ~ "Glycerolipids",
    `Class I` == "GP" ~ "Glycerophospholipids",
    `Class I` == "SL" ~ "Sphingolipids",
    `Class I` == "ST" ~ "Sterol Lipids",
    TRUE ~ `Class I` # 保持其他分类不变
  ))


# 左连接合并注释
DEMs_Antral <- DEMs_Antral %>%
  left_join(metware_data, by = "mz")


### 5. 显著差异代谢物筛选 ###
Y2O_sig_DEMs_Antral <- DEMs_Antral %>%
  filter(
    VIP > 1 &                # VIP阈值
    p_value_T < 0.05         # 显著性阈值
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%  # 按|log2FC|降序排列
  select(
    # 核心差异指标
    Compounds, 物质, mz, VIP, log2FC, 
    q_value_T, p_value_T, young_mean, old_mean,
    # 注释信息
    `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG, 
    Metlin, `PubChem CID`, `Class I`, 物质一级分类,
    `Class II`, 物质二级分类
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(p_val = p_value_T, FDR = q_value_T) 
  # %>% select(Compounds,mz, VIP, log2FC,p_val,FDR)

# 输出筛选结果维度
print(paste("Sig-DEMs of Antral Follicles:", nrow(Y2O_sig_DEMs_Antral)))

### 6. 结果输出 ###
Y2O_sig_DEMs_Antral %>%
  select(Compounds, VIP, p_val) %>%
  writexl::write_xlsx("Table_S7-2_Antral_DEMs(2M vs 9M).xlsx")

library(ggplot2)

# 统计并处理数据（按数量降序排列）

library(dplyr)
set.seed(123)
pca_result <- prcomp(scale(t(intensity_of_Antral_follicles)), center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)


# 4. 计算前两个主成分的解释百分比
explained_variance <- summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100
pc1_label <- paste0("PC1 (", round(explained_variance[1], 2), "%)")
pc2_label <- paste0("PC2 (", round(explained_variance[2], 2), "%)")

# 5. 提取前两个主成分
pca_data <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x[, 1:2])
colnames(pca_data) <- c("PC1", "PC2")

# 6. 根据列名中的 y 和 o 分组
pca_data$Group_ID <- sub("_(.*)", "", colnames(intensity_of_Antral_follicles))  
pca_data$Group_Name <- colnames(intensity_of_Antral_follicles)

    colnames(intensity_of_Antral_follicles) %in% c(

# 分组差异代谢物火山图 -----------------------
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)  # 加载 ggrepel 包用于标签避让

# 1. 定义显著性分类
volcano_data <- DEMs_Antral %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      p_value_T >= 0.05 ~ "Not sig",
      VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC < 0 ~ "9M-Up",
      VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC > 0 ~ "2M-Up",
      TRUE ~ "Not sig"
    )
  )

# 2. 计算每组的数量（用于图例标签）
count_sig <- volcano_data %>%
  group_by(significance) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      significance == "9M-Up" ~ paste0("9M-Up (n=", count, ")"),
      significance == "2M-Up" ~ paste0("2M-Up (n=", count, ")"),
      TRUE ~ paste0("Not sig (n=", count, ")")
    )
  )

Fig_5F <- ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(p_value_T), color = significance)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("9M-Up" = "#E64B35", "2M-Up" = "#4DBBD5", "Not sig" = "gray80"),
    labels = c(
      "9M-Up" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "9M-Up"],
      "2M-Up" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "2M-Up"],
      "Not sig" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "Not sig"]
    ),
    name = "Group"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Antral Follicle DEMs(2M vs 9M)",
    x = expression(log[2]("Fold Change")),
    y = expression(-log[10]("p-value"))
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 16,
    base_family = "Arial"  # 全局设置字体为 Arial，非加粗
  ) +
  xlim(-1, 1) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "plain"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 18, face = "plain"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 16, face = "plain"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain"),
    # legend.position = c(0.12, 0.9),   # 图例位置 (x, y)
    # legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"), # 图例符号大小
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA),  # 图例背景透明
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA),  # 图例键（符号背景）透明
    legend.position = "top"
  )

Fig_5F

ggsave("Fig_5F_Antral_Follicle_DEMs(2M vs 9M)_Volcano_plot.pdf", plot = Fig_5F, width = 6, height = 6, device = cairo_pdf, family = "Arial")

    title = "Antral Follicle DEMs (2M vs 9M)",

    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain"),

age_mz_comparison <- function(mz, intensity_combined, group_age, mse_obj) {
  # 加载必要库
  if (!requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("readxl")
  }
  library(readxl)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  
  # 读取数据并转换类型
  ALL_sample_data <- read_excel("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx")
  
  # 转换Precursor列为数值型
  ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` <- suppressWarnings(
    round(as.numeric(ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)`), 4)
  )
  
  # 处理输入mz
  mz <- round(as.numeric(mz), 4)
  
  # 精确匹配行查找
  matched_data <- ALL_sample_data[ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` == mz, ]
  
  # 构建多行标题 
  title_lines <- c(
    # 第一行: m/z + 化合物名称
    paste0("m/z: ", sprintf("%.4f", mz), 
           if(nrow(matched_data) > 0) paste0("; ", matched_data$Compounds[1]) else "; Unmatched"),
    
    # 第二行: Class I (如果存在)
    if(nrow(matched_data) > 0 && !is.na(matched_data$`Class I`[1])) {
      paste0("Class I: ", matched_data$`Class I`[1])
    } else NULL,
    
    # 第三行: Class II (如果存在)
    if(nrow(matched_data) > 0 && !is.na(matched_data$`Class II`[1])) {
      paste0("Class II: ", matched_data$`Class II`[1])
    } else NULL
  )
  
  # 移除NULL行并组合为换行文本
  title_text <- paste(title_lines[!sapply(title_lines, is.null)], collapse = "\n")
  
  # 数据验证
  # target_mz <- as.character(mz)
  # if (!target_mz %in% rownames(intensity_combined)) {
  #   stop(sprintf("Intensity data not found for m/z %.4f", mz))
  # }
  
  target_mz <- sprintf("%.4f", round(as.numeric(mz), 4))
  if (!target_mz %in% rownames(intensity_combined)) {
    stop(sprintf("Intensity data not found for m/z %s", target_mz))
  }
  
  # 准备绘图数据
  data <- data.frame(
    Expression = as.numeric(intensity_combined[target_mz, ]),
    Group = factor(group_age, levels = c("2M_Antral", "9M_Antral"))
  )
  
  # 绘图
  p <- ggboxplot(
    data,
    x = "Group",
    y = "Expression",
    color = "Group",
    # palette = "npg",
    palette = c("#4DBBD5", "#E64B35"),
    add = "jitter",
    width = 0.5,
    size = 0.8,
    add.params = list(size = 3)
  ) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = list(c("2M_Antral", "9M_Antral")),
      method = "t.test",
      label = "p.format",
      label.y = max(data$Expression) * 1.1,
      size = 4
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = NULL, #"Group",
      y = "Intensity"
    ) +
    ylim(NA, max(data$Expression) * 1.2) +  # 设置图形上边界
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold", 
        hjust = 0.5, 
        size = 16,
        lineheight = 1.2  # 调整行间距
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 16),
      # legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
      # legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      panel.background = element_blank()
    )
  
  print(p)
}

age_mz_comparison(778.4775, intensity_of_Antral_follicles_sig, group_age, mouse_14_ovary)
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
  ifelse(colnames(raw_data) %in% c('y2_f3','y2_f4','y3_f1','y3_f3','y3_f5','y3_f6','y3_f7','y4_f6','y5_f1','y6_f1','y6_f2','y6_f5','y7_f8','y7_f9'), "Secondary", # n=14
         ifelse(colnames(raw_data) %in% c('y1_f1','y1_f3','y1_f4','y1_f9','y1_f10','y1_f11','y2_f5','y3_f9','y4_f1','y4_f2','y4_f8','y5_f5','y7_f3','y7_f5','y7_f6'), "Antral", NA)), # n=15
  levels = c("Secondary", "Antral")
)


### 2. OPLS-DA分析与VIP计算 ###
# 注意：VIP计算使用log转换+Pareto标准化后的数据
set.seed(2025)
oplsda_result <- opls(
  x = t(log_data),               # 输入log转换数据（样本×代谢物）
  y = group,                     # 使用统一的分组变量
  predI = 1,                     # 主成分数
  orthoI = 1,                    # 正交成分数
  log10L = FALSE,                # 已提前log转换，此处不再重复
  permI = 1000,                  # 置换检验次数
  scaleC = "pareto"              # Pareto标准化（VIP计算关键步骤）
)

# 提取VIP分数
vip_scores <- getVipVn(oplsda_result)

# 可视化OPLS-DA得分图
# pdf("Fig_5H_s2a_DEMs_of_8W_follicle_OPLSDA_score_plot.pdf",
#     width = 8, height = 6, family = "Arial") 
# par(mfrow = c(1, 1)) 
# plot(oplsda_result, 
#      typeVc = "x-score",       # 绘制 X 得分图（样本得分）
#      parAsColFcVn = group,     # 按 group 着色样本点（要求为 factor）
#      parLabVc = rownames(t(raw_data)), # 样本标签
#      parCexN = 1.5,            # 调整点的大小
#      parEllipsesL = T,      # 关闭统计椭圆（可选）
#      parPaletteVc = c("#00A087", "#3C5488")
# )
# dev.off()




### 3. 差异代谢物统计分析 ###
DEMs_s2a_young <- raw_data %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    # 代谢物m/z值
    mz = round(as.numeric(rownames(.)), 4),
    
    # 组均值计算（原始数据） - 根据新分组调整
    Secondary_mean = rowMeans(select(., c('y2_f3','y2_f4','y3_f1','y3_f3','y3_f5','y3_f6','y3_f7','y4_f6','y5_f1','y6_f1','y6_f2','y6_f5','y7_f8','y7_f9')), 
                              na.rm = TRUE),
    Antral_mean = rowMeans(select(., c('y1_f1','y1_f3','y1_f4','y1_f9','y1_f10','y1_f11','y2_f5','y3_f9','y4_f1','y4_f2','y4_f8','y5_f5','y7_f3','y7_f5','y7_f6')), 
                           na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # 变化倍数（Secondary vs Antral）
    log2FC = log2(Secondary_mean / Antral_mean),
    
    # Welch T检验（使用log转换数据）
    p_value_T = apply(log_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_Secondary <- x[group == "Secondary"]
      x_Antral <- x[group == "Antral"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_Secondary)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_Antral)) < 2) return(NA)
      t.test(x_Secondary, x_Antral, 
             alternative = "two.sided",
             var.equal = FALSE)$p.value
    }),
    
    # FDR校正
    q_value_T = p.adjust(p_value_T, method = "BH"),
    
    # Mann-Whitney U检验（使用原始数据）
    p_value_Wilcox = apply(raw_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_Secondary <- x[group == "Secondary"]
      x_Antral <- x[group == "Antral"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_Secondary)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_Antral)) < 2) return(NA)
      wilcox.test(x_Secondary, x_Antral,
                  alternative = "two.sided",
                  exact = FALSE)$p.value
    }),
    
    # FDR校正
    q_value_Wilcox = p.adjust(p_value_Wilcox, method = "BH"),
    
    # VIP分数
    VIP = vip_scores
  )


### 4. 注释信息合并 ###
metware_data <- read_excel(
  "/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx"
) %>% 
  transmute(
    mz = round(as.numeric(`Precursor (Da)`), 4),
    Compounds, 物质, 
    `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG, Metlin, `PubChem CID`,
    `Class I`, 物质一级分类, `Class II`, 物质二级分类
  ) %>%
  mutate(`Class I` = case_when(
    `Class I` == "FA" ~ "Fatty Acids",
    `Class I` == "GL" ~ "Glycerolipids",
    `Class I` == "GP" ~ "Glycerophospholipids",
    `Class I` == "SL" ~ "Sphingolipids",
    `Class I` == "ST" ~ "Sterol Lipids",
    TRUE ~ `Class I` # 保持其他分类不变
  ))


# 左连接合并注释
DEMs_s2a_young <- DEMs_s2a_young %>%
  left_join(metware_data, by = "mz")


### 5. 显著差异代谢物筛选 ###
s2a_young_sig_DEMs <- DEMs_s2a_young %>%
  filter(
    VIP > 1 &                # VIP阈值
    p_value_T < 0.05         # 显著性阈值
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%  # 按|log2FC|降序排列
  select(
    # 核心差异指标
    Compounds, 物质, mz, VIP, log2FC, 
    q_value_T, p_value_T, Secondary_mean, Antral_mean,
    # 注释信息
    `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG, 
    Metlin, `PubChem CID`, `Class I`, 物质一级分类,
    `Class II`, 物质二级分类
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(p_val = p_value_T, FDR = q_value_T) 
  # %>% select(Compounds,mz, VIP, log2FC,p_val,FDR)

# 输出筛选结果维度
print(paste("Sig-DEMs of 2M Follicles:", nrow(s2a_young_sig_DEMs)))

### 6. 结果输出 ###
s2a_young_sig_DEMs %>%
  select(Compounds, VIP, p_val) %>%
  writexl::write_xlsx("Table_S8_2M_Follicle_DEMs(Secondary vs Antral).xlsx")

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)  # 加载 ggrepel 包用于标签避让

# 1. 定义显著性分类
volcano_data <- DEMs_s2a_young %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      p_value_T >= 0.05 ~ "Not sig",
      VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC < 0 ~ "Antral-Up",
      VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC > 0 ~ "Secondary-Up",
      TRUE ~ "Not sig"
    )
  )

# 2. 计算每组的数量（用于图例标签）
count_sig <- volcano_data %>%
  group_by(significance) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      significance == "Antral-Up" ~ paste0("Antral-Up (n=", count, ")"),
      significance == "Secondary-Up" ~ paste0("Secondary-Up (n=", count, ")"),
      TRUE ~ paste0("Not sig (n=", count, ")")
    )
  )


Fig_5I <- ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(p_value_T), color = significance)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Antral-Up" = "#E64B35", "Secondary-Up" = "#4DBBD5", "Not sig" = "gray80"),
    labels = c(
      "Antral-Up" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "Antral-Up"],
      "Secondary-Up" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "Secondary-Up"],
      "Not sig" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "Not sig"]
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "2M Follicle DEMs(Secondary vs Antral)",
    x = expression(log[2]("Fold Change")),
    y = expression(-log[10]("p-value"))
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 16,
    base_family = "Arial"  # 全局设置字体为 Arial，非加粗
  ) +
  xlim(-1, 1) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "plain"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 18, face = "plain"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 16, face = "plain"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain"),
    # legend.position = c(0.12, 0.9),   # 图例位置 (x, y)
    # legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"), # 图例符号大小
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA),  # 图例背景透明
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA),  # 图例键（符号背景）透明

    ),
    "Secondary",           
    ifelse(
        colnames(intensity_of_Secondary_and_Antral_follicles_young) %in% c(
          # Antral follicle
          'y1_f1','y1_f3','y1_f4','y1_f9','y1_f10','y1_f11',
          'y2_f5',
          'y3_f9',
          'y4_f1','y4_f2','y4_f8',
          'y5_f5',
          'y7_f3','y7_f5','y7_f6'
        ),
        "Antral",          
        NA                          # 其他情况为 NA
    )
)

# 将分组转换为因子，并设置顺序
group_stage <- factor(group_stage, levels = c("Secondary", "Antral"))



stage_mz_comparison <- function(mz, intensity_combined, group_stage, mse_obj) {
  # 加载必要库
  if (!requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("readxl")
  }
  library(readxl)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  
  # 读取数据并转换类型
  ALL_sample_data <- read_excel("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx")
  
  # 转换Precursor列为数值型
  ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` <- suppressWarnings(
    round(as.numeric(ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)`), 4)
  )
  
  # 处理输入mz
  mz <- round(as.numeric(mz), 4)
  
  # 精确匹配行查找
  matched_data <- ALL_sample_data[ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` == mz, ]
  
  # 构建多行标题 
  title_lines <- c(
    # 第一行: m/z + 化合物名称
    paste0("m/z: ", sprintf("%.4f", mz), 
           if(nrow(matched_data) > 0) paste0("; ", matched_data$Compounds[1]) else "; Unmatched"),
    
    # 第二行: Class I (如果存在)
    if(nrow(matched_data) > 0 && !is.na(matched_data$`Class I`[1])) {
      paste0("Class I: ", matched_data$`Class I`[1])
    } else NULL,
    
    # 第三行: Class II (如果存在)
    if(nrow(matched_data) > 0 && !is.na(matched_data$`Class II`[1])) {
      paste0("Class II: ", matched_data$`Class II`[1])
    } else NULL
  )
  
  # 移除NULL行并组合为换行文本
  title_text <- paste(title_lines[!sapply(title_lines, is.null)], collapse = "\n")
  
  # 数据验证
  target_mz <- sprintf("%.4f", round(as.numeric(mz), 4))
  if (!target_mz %in% rownames(intensity_combined)) {
    stop(sprintf("Intensity data not found for m/z %s", target_mz))
  }
  
  # 准备绘图数据
  data <- data.frame(
    Expression = as.numeric(intensity_combined[target_mz, ]),
    Group = factor(group_stage, levels = c("Secondary", "Antral"))
  )
  
  # 绘图
  p <- ggboxplot(
    data,
    x = "Group",
    y = "Expression",
    color = "Group",
    # palette = "npg",
    palette = c("#4DBBD5", "#E64B35"),
    add = "jitter",
    width = 0.5,
    size = 0.8,
    add.params = list(size = 3)
  ) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = list(c("Secondary", "Antral")),
      method = "t.test",
      label = "p.format",
      label.y = max(data$Expression) * 1.1,
      size = 4
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = NULL, #"Group",
      y = "Intensity"
    ) +
    ylim(NA, max(data$Expression) * 1.2) +  # 设置图形上边界
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold", 
        hjust = 0.5, 
        size = 16,
        lineheight = 1.2  # 调整行间距
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 16),
      # legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
      # legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      panel.background = element_blank()
    )
  
  print(p)
}


stage_mz_comparison(152.1074, intensity_of_Secondary_and_Antral_follicles_young, group_stage, mouse_14_ovary)
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
# 提取intensity -----------------------
library(Cardinal)

}

# 定义对象列表
objects <- list(

# 查看结果
head(intensity_of_Secondary_and_Antral_follicles_old)


# 差异代谢物分析完整流程 --------------
library(ropls)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)

### 1. 数据准备与预处理 ###
# 定义原始数据和log转换数据（全局变量）
raw_data <- intensity_of_Secondary_and_Antral_follicles_old  # 原始数据（未转换）
log_data <- log2(raw_data + 1)   # log2(x+1)转换后的数据（用于参数检验）

# 分组变量设置
group <- factor(
  ifelse(colnames(raw_data) %in% c("o1_f4", "o1_f5", "o1_f6","o2_f2", "o2_f6","o3_f2","o4_f2","o5_f3", "o5_f5","o6_f3"), "Secondary", # 次级卵泡 n=10
         ifelse(colnames(raw_data) %in% c("o1_f7","o2_f1", "o2_f7", "o2_f8","o3_f3","o3_f4","o3_f5","o4_f8","o6_f4","o7_f1"), "Antral", NA)), # 窦卵泡 n=10 "o5_f1", "o5_f4", "o5_f7",
  levels = c("Secondary", "Antral")
)


### 2. OPLS-DA分析与VIP计算 ###
# 注意：VIP计算使用log转换+Pareto标准化后的数据
set.seed(2025)
oplsda_result <- opls(
  x = t(log_data),               # 输入log转换数据（样本×代谢物）
  y = group,                     # 使用统一的分组变量
  predI = 1,                     # 主成分数
  orthoI = 1,                    # 正交成分数
  log10L = FALSE,                # 已提前log转换，此处不再重复
  permI = 1000,                  # 置换检验次数
  scaleC = "pareto"              # Pareto标准化（VIP计算关键步骤）
)

# 提取VIP分数
vip_scores <- getVipVn(oplsda_result)

# 可视化OPLS-DA得分图
# pdf("Fig_5K_s2a_DEMs_of_9M_follicle_OPLSDA_score_plot.pdf",
#     width = 8, height = 6, family = "Arial") 
# par(mfrow = c(1, 1)) 
# plot(oplsda_result, 
#      typeVc = "x-score",       # 绘制 X 得分图（样本得分）
#      parAsColFcVn = group,     # 按 group 着色样本点（要求为 factor）
#      parLabVc = rownames(t(raw_data)), # 样本标签
#      parCexN = 0.8,            # 调整点的大小
#      parEllipsesL = T,      # 关闭统计椭圆（可选）
#      parPaletteVc = c("#00A087", "#3C5488")
# )
# dev.off()



### 3. 差异代谢物统计分析 ###
DEMs_s2a_old <- raw_data %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    # 代谢物m/z值
    mz = round(as.numeric(rownames(.)), 4),
    
    # 组均值计算（原始数据） - 根据新分组调整
    Secondary_mean = rowMeans(select(., c("o1_f4", "o1_f5", "o1_f6","o2_f2", "o2_f6","o3_f2","o4_f2","o5_f3", "o5_f5","o6_f3")),na.rm = TRUE),
    Antral_mean = rowMeans(select(., c("o1_f7","o2_f1", "o2_f7", "o2_f8","o3_f3","o3_f4","o3_f5","o4_f8","o6_f4","o7_f1")),na.rm = TRUE), # "o5_f1", "o5_f4", "o5_f7",
    
    # 变化倍数（Secondary vs Antral）
    log2FC = log2(Secondary_mean / Antral_mean),
    
    # Welch T检验（使用log转换数据）
    p_value_T = apply(log_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_Secondary <- x[group == "Secondary"]
      x_Antral <- x[group == "Antral"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_Secondary)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_Antral)) < 2) return(NA)
      t.test(x_Secondary, x_Antral, 
             alternative = "two.sided",
             var.equal = FALSE)$p.value
    }),
    
    # FDR校正
    q_value_T = p.adjust(p_value_T, method = "BH"),
    
    # Mann-Whitney U检验（使用原始数据）
    p_value_Wilcox = apply(raw_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_Secondary <- x[group == "Secondary"]
      x_Antral <- x[group == "Antral"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_Secondary)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_Antral)) < 2) return(NA)
      wilcox.test(x_Secondary, x_Antral,
                  alternative = "two.sided",
                  exact = FALSE)$p.value
    }),
    
    # FDR校正
    q_value_Wilcox = p.adjust(p_value_Wilcox, method = "BH"),
    
    # VIP分数
    VIP = vip_scores
  )


### 4. 注释信息合并 ###
metware_data <- read_excel(
  "/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx"
) %>% 
  transmute(
    mz = round(as.numeric(`Precursor (Da)`), 4),
    Compounds, 物质, 
    `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG, Metlin, `PubChem CID`,
    `Class I`, 物质一级分类, `Class II`, 物质二级分类
  ) %>%
  mutate(`Class I` = case_when(
    `Class I` == "FA" ~ "Fatty Acids",
    `Class I` == "GL" ~ "Glycerolipids",
    `Class I` == "GP" ~ "Glycerophospholipids",
    `Class I` == "SL" ~ "Sphingolipids",
    `Class I` == "ST" ~ "Sterol Lipids",
    TRUE ~ `Class I` # 保持其他分类不变
  ))


# 左连接合并注释
DEMs_s2a_old <- DEMs_s2a_old %>%
  left_join(metware_data, by = "mz")


### 5. 显著差异代谢物筛选 ###
s2a_old_sig_DEMs <- DEMs_s2a_old %>%
  filter(
    VIP > 1 &                # VIP阈值
    p_value_T < 0.05         # 显著性阈值
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%  # 按|log2FC|降序排列
  select(
    # 核心差异指标
    Compounds, 物质, mz, VIP, log2FC, 
    q_value_T, p_value_T, Secondary_mean, Antral_mean,
    # 注释信息
    `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG, 
    Metlin, `PubChem CID`, `Class I`, 物质一级分类,
    `Class II`, 物质二级分类
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(p_val = p_value_T, FDR = q_value_T) 
  # %>% select(Compounds,mz, VIP, log2FC,p_val,FDR)

# 输出筛选结果维度
print(paste("Sig-DEMs of 9M Follicles:", nrow(s2a_old_sig_DEMs)))

### 6. 结果输出 ###
s2a_old_sig_DEMs %>%
  select(Compounds, VIP, p_val) %>%
  writexl::write_xlsx("Table_S9_9M_Follicle_DEMs(Secondary vs Antral).xlsx")


# OPLS-DA 图 ------------------
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# 提取 t1（预测主成分）和 to1（正交主成分）
oplsda_plot_data <- data.frame(
  t_pred = oplsda_result@scoreMN[, 1],  # predictive score (x-score 横轴)
  t_orth = oplsda_result@orthoScoreMN[, 1],  # orthogonal score (x-score 纵轴)
  group = factor(
  ifelse(colnames(raw_data) %in% c("o1_f4", "o1_f5", "o1_f6","o2_f2", "o2_f6","o3_f2","o4_f2","o5_f3", "o5_f5","o6_f3"), "Secondary", # 次级卵泡 n=10
         ifelse(colnames(raw_data) %in% c("o1_f7","o2_f1", "o2_f7", "o2_f8","o3_f3","o3_f4","o3_f5","o4_f8","o6_f4","o7_f1"), "Antral", NA)), # 窦卵泡 n=10 "o5_f1", "o5_f4", "o5_f7",
  levels = c("Secondary", "Antral")
),
  sample_id = rownames(t(raw_data))  # 样本标签
)

metrics <- c(

    # x = paste0("t1 (", round(model_stats$`R2X(cum)`[1] * 100, 1), "%)"),

# PCA聚类 ----------------------------------
library(dplyr)
set.seed(123)
pca_result <- prcomp(scale(t(intensity_of_Secondary_and_Antral_follicles_old)), center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)


# 4. 计算前两个主成分的解释百分比
explained_variance <- summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100
pc1_label <- paste0("PC1 (", round(explained_variance[1], 2), "%)")
pc2_label <- paste0("PC2 (", round(explained_variance[2], 2), "%)")

# 5. 提取前两个主成分
pca_data <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x[, 1:2])
colnames(pca_data) <- c("PC1", "PC2")

# 6. 根据列名中的 y 和 o 分组
pca_data$Group_ID <- sub("_(.*)", "", colnames(intensity_of_Secondary_and_Antral_follicles_old))  # 提取前缀部分

#                              ifelse(grepl("o", pca_data$Group_ID), "Old", NA))  # (o 分组)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)  # 加载 ggrepel 包用于标签避让

# 1. 定义显著性分类
volcano_data <- DEMs_s2a_old %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      p_value_T >= 0.05 ~ "Not sig",
      VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC < 0 ~ "Antral-Up",
      VIP > 1 & p_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC > 0 ~ "Secondary-Up",
      TRUE ~ "Not sig"
    )
  )

# 2. 计算每组的数量（用于图例标签）
count_sig <- volcano_data %>%
  group_by(significance) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      significance == "Antral-Up" ~ paste0("Antral-Up (n=", count, ")"),
      significance == "Secondary-Up" ~ paste0("Secondary-Up (n=", count, ")"),
      TRUE ~ paste0("Not sig (n=", count, ")")
    )
  )

Fig_5L <- ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(p_value_T), color = significance)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Antral-Up" = "#E64B35", "Secondary-Up" = "#4DBBD5", "Not sig" = "gray80"),
    labels = c(
      "Antral-Up" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "Antral-Up"],
      "Secondary-Up" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "Secondary-Up"],
      "Not sig" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "Not sig"]
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "9M Follicle DEMs(Secondary vs Antral)",
    x = expression(log[2]("Fold Change")),
    y = expression(-log[10]("p-value"))
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 16,
    base_family = "Arial"  # 全局设置字体为 Arial，非加粗
  ) +
  xlim(-1, 1) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "plain"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 18, face = "plain"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 16, face = "plain"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain"),
    # legend.position = c(0.12, 0.9),   # 图例位置 (x, y)
    # legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"), # 图例符号大小
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA),  # 图例背景透明
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA),  # 图例键（符号背景）透明
    legend.position = "top"
  )

Fig_5L

ggsave("Fig_5L_9M_Follicle_DEMs(Secondary vs Antral)_Volcano_plot.pdf", plot = Fig_5L, width = 8, height = 6, device = cairo_pdf, family = "Arial")

stage_mz_comparison <- function(mz, intensity_combined, group_stage, mse_obj) {
  # 加载必要库
  if (!requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("readxl")
  }
  library(readxl)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  
  # 读取数据并转换类型
  ALL_sample_data <- read_excel("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx")
  
  # 转换Precursor列为数值型
  ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` <- suppressWarnings(
    round(as.numeric(ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)`), 4)
  )
  
  # 处理输入mz
  mz <- round(as.numeric(mz), 4)
  
  # 精确匹配行查找
  matched_data <- ALL_sample_data[ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` == mz, ]
  
  # 构建多行标题
  title_lines <- c(
    # 第一行: m/z + 化合物名称
    paste0("m/z: ", sprintf("%.4f", mz), 
           if(nrow(matched_data) > 0) paste0("; ", matched_data$Compounds[1]) else "; Unmatched"),
    
    # 第二行: Class I (如果存在)
    if(nrow(matched_data) > 0 && !is.na(matched_data$`Class I`[1])) {
      paste0("Class I: ", matched_data$`Class I`[1])
    } else NULL,
    
    # 第三行: Class II (如果存在)
    if(nrow(matched_data) > 0 && !is.na(matched_data$`Class II`[1])) {
      paste0("Class II: ", matched_data$`Class II`[1])
    } else NULL
  )
  
  # 移除NULL行并组合为换行文本
  title_text <- paste(title_lines[!sapply(title_lines, is.null)], collapse = "\n")
  
  # 数据验证
  target_mz <- sprintf("%.4f", round(as.numeric(mz), 4))
  if (!target_mz %in% rownames(intensity_combined)) {
    stop(sprintf("Intensity data not found for m/z %s", target_mz))
  }
  
  # 准备绘图数据
  data <- data.frame(
    Expression = as.numeric(intensity_combined[target_mz, ]),
    Group = factor(group_stage, levels = c("Secondary", "Antral"))
  )
  
  # 绘图
  p <- ggboxplot(
    data,
    x = "Group",
    y = "Expression",
    color = "Group",
    # palette = "npg",
    palette = c("#4DBBD5", "#E64B35"),
    add = "jitter",
    width = 0.5,
    size = 0.8,
    add.params = list(size = 3)
  ) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = list(c("Secondary", "Antral")),
      method = "t.test",
      label = "p.format",
      label.y = max(data$Expression) * 1.1,
      size = 4
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = NULL, #"Group",
      y = "Intensity"
    ) +
    ylim(NA, max(data$Expression) * 1.2) +  # 设置图形上边界
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold", 
        hjust = 0.5, 
        size = 16,
        lineheight = 1.2  # 调整行间距
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 16),
      # legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
      # legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      panel.background = element_blank()
    )
  
  print(p)
}

stage_mz_comparison(842.6022, intensity_of_Secondary_and_Antral_follicles_old, group_stage, mouse_14_ovary)
```

```{r,echo=TRUE,fig.height=6,fig.width=8}
setwd('/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/')

library(readxl)
Pathway_from_MetOrigin <- read_excel("Pathway_Secondary_Follicles(2M vs 9M).xlsx")
head(Pathway_from_MetOrigin)


library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(extrafont)  # 用于加载系统字体（确保Arial可用）

# 加载Arial字体（首次运行需要安装）

#   font_import(prompt = FALSE)  # 导入系统字体
#   loadfonts(device = "win")    # 在Windows加载
# }

# 数据预处理
filtered_data <- Pathway_from_MetOrigin %>%
  filter(Pvalue < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    significance = -log10(Pvalue),
    Name_wrapped = str_wrap(Name, width = 50),  # 自动换行
    Name_wrapped = factor(Name_wrapped, levels = unique(Name_wrapped[order(-significance)]))  # 按显著性排序
  )

# 绘制条形图
Fig_5M <- ggplot(filtered_data, 
       aes(
         x = significance,
         y = reorder(Name_wrapped, significance),  # 按显著性排序
         fill = Region
       )) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Region") +
  # scale_fill_discrete(name = "Region") +
  labs(
    title = "Secondary Follicle (2M VS 9M)",
    x = expression(-log[10]("Pvalue")), 
    y = NULL # "Metabolic Pathway"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial") +  
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "plain"),  
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain"),  
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    scale_x_continuous(
      expand = c(0, 0),
      limits = c(0, max(-log10(filtered_data$Pvalue)) * 1.1))  # X轴扩展10%
  )

# 输出图形
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
        "o1_f4", "o1_f5", "o1_f6", "o2_f2", "o2_f6", "o3_f2",
        "o4_f2", "o5_f3", "o5_f5", "o6_f3"

# 单个代谢物的组间比较 -----------------
color_gradient1 <- colorRampPalette(c("black", "#000033", "#000066", "#0000FF", "#0077FF", "#00AAFF", "cyan", "#66FF99", "green", "#AFFF00", "yellow", "#FFCC00", "#FF9F00", "#FF6600", "red", "#CC0066", "purple"))(300)


# 在 ggpubr 包中，stat_compare_means() 函数默认使用
# 独立样本 t 检验（Independent Samples t-test），用于比较两组之间的均值差异。method = "t.test"
# Wilcoxon 秩和检验（非参数检验）：method = "wilcox.test"。
# ANOVA（多组比较）：method = "anova"。
# label = "p.format" 显示原始 p 值;  label = "p.signif" 显示显著性符号。

library(ggpubr)
plot_mz_comparison <- function(mz, intensity_combined, group_combined, mse_obj) {
    # 确保 mz 是字符类型
    mz <- as.numeric(mz)
    
    # 提取特定代谢物的数据
    specific_data <- intensity_combined[rownames(intensity_combined) %in% mz, ]
    
    # 准备数据
    data <- data.frame(
        Expression = as.numeric(specific_data),
        Group = group_combined
    )
    
    # 定义比较组
    my_comparisons <- list(
        c("2M Secondary follicle", "2M Antral follicle"),
        c("9M Secondary follicle", "9M Antral follicle"),
        c("2M Secondary follicle", "9M Secondary follicle"),
        c("2M Antral follicle", "9M Antral follicle")
    )
    
    # 绘制箱线图
    p <- ggboxplot(data, x = "Group", y = "Expression", color = "Group", 
                   xlab = "Group", ylab = "Mean intensity", legend.title = "Group",
                   add = "jitter") + 
        stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons, method = "t.test", label = "p.format") +
        ggtitle(paste0("m/z = ", mz)) +  # 动态添加标题
        theme(
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),  # 标题居中，字体大小14
            axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),  # X轴标签字体大小12
            axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),  # Y轴标签字体大小12
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),  # X轴文字倾斜45度
            legend.position = "none"
        )
    
    print(p)
    
    # # 绘制图像
    # color_gradient1 <- colorRampPalette(c("black", "#000033", "#000066", "#0000FF", "#0077FF", "#00AAFF", "cyan", "#66FF99", "green", "#AFFF00", "yellow", "#FFCC00", "#FF9F00", "#FF6600", "red", "#CC0066", "purple"))(300)
    # 
    # image(mse_obj, 
    #       mz = mz,
    #       col = color_gradient1,
    #       scale = T,
    #       key = T,
    #       #layout = c(2,7),
    #       smooth = 'gaussian',
    #       enhance = 'hist')
    
    # 返回箱线图
    # return(p)
}
```

```{r,eval=FALSE,fig.height=4,fig.width=12}
# mz考虑浮点精度匹配
plot_mz_comparison <- function(mz, intensity_combined, group_age, mse_obj) {
  library(readr)
  ALL_sample_data <- read_excel("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx")

  # 转换Precursor列为数值型并保留4位小数
  ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` <- round(as.numeric(ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)`), 4)

  # 确保输入mz是数值型
  mz <- round(as.numeric(mz), 4)
  
  # 在样本数据中查找匹配行（考虑浮点数精度）
  matched_row <- ALL_sample_data[
    abs(as.numeric(ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)`) - mz) < 1e-6, 
    c("Precursor (Da)", "Compounds")
  ]
  
  # 动态生成标题
  if (nrow(matched_row) > 0) {
    title_text <- sprintf("m/z = %.4f ; %s", 
                         matched_row$`Precursor (Da)`[1],
                         matched_row$Compounds[1])
  } else {
    title_text <- sprintf("m/z = %.4f (No compound matched)", mz)
    warning(paste("No exact match found for m/z =", mz))
  }
  
  # 提取特定代谢物的数据（考虑浮点数匹配）
  matching_mz <- rownames(intensity_combined)[
    abs(as.numeric(rownames(intensity_combined)) - mz) < 1e-6
  ]
  
  if (length(matching_mz) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No intensity data found for m/z =", mz))
  }
  
  specific_data <- intensity_combined[matching_mz[1], , drop = FALSE]
  
  # 准备绘图数据
  data <- data.frame(
    Expression = as.numeric(specific_data),
    Group = group_age
  )
  
  # 定义比较组
  my_comparisons <- list(c("8W", "9M"))
  
  # 绘制箱线图
  p <- ggpubr::ggboxplot(
    data, 
    x = "Group", 
    y = "Expression", 
    color = "Group", 
    xlab = "Group", 
    ylab = "Mean intensity", 
    legend.title = "Group",
    add = "jitter"
  ) + 
    ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = my_comparisons, 
      method = "t.test", 
      # p.adjust.method = "BH",   # 使用 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正
      label = "p.format"
    ) +
    ggtitle(title_text) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  print(p)
  
  # 质谱图像部分（根据需要取消注释）
  # color_gradient1 <- colorRampPalette(c("black", "#000033", "#000066", "#0000FF", 
  #                                      "#0077FF", "#00AAFF", "cyan", "#66FF99", 
  #                                      "green", "#AFFF00", "yellow", "#FFCC00", 
  #                                      "#FF9F00", "#FF6600", "red", "#CC0066", 
  #                                      "purple"))(300)
  # 
  # image(mse_obj, 
  #       mz = mz,
  #       col = color_gradient1,
  #       scale = T,
  #       key = T,
  #       smooth = 'gaussian',
  #       enhanced = 'hist')
}

# 图片标题包含mz+名称+分类
age_mz_comparison <- function(mz, intensity_combined, group_age, mse_obj) {
  # 加载必要库
  if (!requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("readxl")
  }
  library(readxl)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  
  # 读取数据并转换类型
  ALL_sample_data <- read_excel("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx")
  
  # 转换Precursor列为数值型
  ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` <- suppressWarnings(
    round(as.numeric(ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)`), 4)
  )
  
  # 处理输入mz
  mz <- round(as.numeric(mz), 4)
  
  # 精确匹配行查找
  matched_data <- ALL_sample_data[ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` == mz, ]
  
  # 构建动态标题
  title_parts <- c(
    paste0("m/z: ", sprintf("%.4f", mz)),  # 添加前缀 "m/z: "
    if (nrow(matched_data) > 0) matched_data$Compounds[1] else "Unmatched",
    if (nrow(matched_data) > 0) matched_data$`Class I`[1] else NULL,
    if (nrow(matched_data) > 0) matched_data$`Class II`[1] else NULL
  )
  title_text <- paste(title_parts[!sapply(title_parts, is.null)], collapse = "; ")

  
  # 数据验证
  target_mz <- as.character(mz)
  if (!target_mz %in% rownames(intensity_combined)) {
    stop(sprintf("Intensity data not found for m/z %.4f", mz))
  }
  
  # 准备绘图数据
  data <- data.frame(
    Expression = as.numeric(intensity_combined[target_mz, ]),
    Group = factor(group_age, levels = c("8W", "9M"))
  )
  
  # 绘图
  p <- ggboxplot(
    data,
    x = "Group",
    y = "Expression",
    color = "Group",
    palette = "npg",
    add = "jitter",
    width = 0.5,
    size = 0.8,          # 箱线图边框粗细
    add.params = list(size = 3)  # 散点大小调整
  ) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = list(c("8W", "9M")),
      method = "t.test",
      label = "p.format",
      label.y = max(data$Expression) * 1.1,
      size = 4           # P值标签字体大小
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      # caption = paste("m/z:", target_mz),
      x = "Group",
      y = "Intensity"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +  # 基础字体大小设为14
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),  # 主标题加大
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),      # 坐标轴标题大小
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),       # 坐标轴刻度文本
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),  # X轴特殊旋转调整
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 10),    # 底部标注文字
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),    # 图例标题
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),     # 图例文本
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8), # 边框加粗
      panel.background = element_blank()
    )

  
  print(p)
}
# 标题换行显示
age_mz_comparison <- function(mz, intensity_combined, group_age, mse_obj) {
  # 加载必要库
  if (!requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("readxl")
  }
  library(readxl)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  
  # 读取数据并转换类型
  ALL_sample_data <- read_excel("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx")
  
  # 转换Precursor列为数值型
  ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` <- suppressWarnings(
    round(as.numeric(ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)`), 4)
  )
  
  # 处理输入mz
  mz <- round(as.numeric(mz), 4)
  
  # 精确匹配行查找
  matched_data <- ALL_sample_data[ALL_sample_data$`Precursor (Da)` == mz, ]
  
  # 构建多行标题
  title_lines <- c(
    # 第一行: m/z + 化合物名称
    paste0("m/z: ", sprintf("%.4f", mz), 
           if(nrow(matched_data) > 0) paste0("; ", matched_data$Compounds[1]) else "; Unmatched"),
    
    # 第二行: Class I (如果存在)
    if(nrow(matched_data) > 0 && !is.na(matched_data$`Class I`[1])) {
      paste0("Class I: ", matched_data$`Class I`[1])
    } else NULL,
    
    # 第三行: Class II (如果存在)
    if(nrow(matched_data) > 0 && !is.na(matched_data$`Class II`[1])) {
      paste0("Class II: ", matched_data$`Class II`[1])
    } else NULL
  )
  
  # 移除NULL行并组合为换行文本
  title_text <- paste(title_lines[!sapply(title_lines, is.null)], collapse = "\n")
  
  # 数据验证
  target_mz <- as.character(mz)
  if (!target_mz %in% rownames(intensity_combined)) {
    stop(sprintf("Intensity data not found for m/z %.4f", mz))
  }
  
  # 准备绘图数据
  data <- data.frame(
    Expression = as.numeric(intensity_combined[target_mz, ]),
    Group = factor(group_age, levels = c("8W", "9M"))
  )
  
  # 绘图
  p <- ggboxplot(
    data,
    x = "Group",
    y = "Expression",
    color = "Group",
    palette = "npg",
    add = "jitter",
    width = 0.5,
    size = 0.8,
    add.params = list(size = 3)
  ) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = list(c("8W", "9M")),
      method = "t.test",
      label = "p.format",
      label.y = max(data$Expression) * 1.1,
      size = 4
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "Group",
      y = "Intensity"
    ) +
    ylim(NA, max(data$Expression) * 1.2) +  # 设置图形上边界
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold", 
        hjust = 0.5, 
        size = 16,
        lineheight = 1.2  # 调整行间距
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      panel.background = element_blank()
    )
  
  print(p)
}
```

# C57BL/6J小鼠卵泡液
```{r,echo=T,fig.width=8,fig.height=6}
# 小鼠卵泡液差异代谢物筛选 ---------
setwd("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/Human_Follicular_Fluid")

library(readxl)
mouse_follicular_fluid <- read_excel("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/Mouse_Follicular_Fluid/ALL_sample_data-小鼠卵泡液非靶向代谢组.xlsx")

library(ropls)
library(dplyr)

### 1. 数据准备与预处理 ###
# 定义原始数据和log转换数据（全局变量）
raw_data <- as.data.frame(sapply(mouse_follicular_fluid[, 14:27], as.numeric))  # 原始数据（未转换）
log_data <- log2(raw_data + 1)   # log2(x+1)转换后的数据（用于参数检验）

# 创建分组变量（8W 或 9M）
group <- ifelse(grepl("^8W", colnames(raw_data)), "2M", "9M") %>% 
  factor(levels = c("2M", "9M"))


### 2. OPLS-DA分析与VIP计算 ###
# 注意：VIP计算使用log转换+Pareto标准化后的数据
set.seed(2025)
oplsda_result <- opls(
  x = t(log_data),               # 输入log转换数据（样本×代谢物）
  y = group,                     # 使用统一的分组变量
  predI = 1,                     # 主成分数
  orthoI = 1,                    # 正交成分数
  log10L = FALSE,                # 已提前log转换，此处不再重复
  permI = 1000,                  # 置换检验次数
  scaleC = "pareto"              # Pareto标准化（VIP计算关键步骤）
)

# 提取VIP分数
vip_scores <- getVipVn(oplsda_result)

# 可视化OPLS-DA得分图
plot(oplsda_result,
     typeVc = "x-score",
     parAsColFcVn = group,
     parEllipsesL = TRUE,
     parPaletteVc = c("#00A087", "#3C5488")
)


### 3. 差异代谢物统计分析 ###
DEMs_of_mouse_follicular_fluid <- raw_data %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    Compounds = mouse_follicular_fluid$Compounds,
    CAS = mouse_follicular_fluid$CAS,
    Class_I = mouse_follicular_fluid$`Class I`,
    HMDBID = mouse_follicular_fluid$HMDB,
    KEGGID = mouse_follicular_fluid$kegg_map,
    
    # 组均值（原始数据）
    young_mean = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("8W")), na.rm = TRUE),
    old_mean = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("9M")), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # 变化倍数（原始数据计算后取log2）
    log2FC = log2(young_mean / old_mean),
    
    ### 基于log转换数据的统计检验 ###
    # Welch T检验（假设log转换后数据满足正态性）
    p_value_T = apply(log_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_8W <- x[group == "2M"]
      x_9M <- x[group == "9M"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_8W)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_9M)) < 2) return(NA)
      t.test(x_8W, x_9M, 
             alternative = "two.sided",
             var.equal = FALSE)$p.value  # Welch校正
    }),
    
    # FDR校正（BH方法）
    q_value_T = p.adjust(p_value_T, method = "BH"),
    
    ### 基于原始数据的非参数检验 ###
    # Mann-Whitney U检验（原始数据）
    p_value_Wilcox = apply(raw_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_8W <- x[group == "2M"]
      x_9M <- x[group == "9M"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_8W)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_9M)) < 2) return(NA)
      wilcox.test(x_8W, x_9M, 
                  alternative = "two.sided",
                  exact = FALSE)$p.value  # 大样本近似
    }),
    
    # FDR校正（BH方法）
    q_value_Wilcox = p.adjust(p_value_Wilcox, method = "BH"),
    
    ### VIP分数（来自OPLS-DA）###
    VIP = vip_scores
  )

DEMs_of_mouse_follicular_fluid <- DEMs_of_mouse_follicular_fluid %>%
  mutate(
    State = case_when(
      q_value_T >= 0.05 ~ "Not sig",
      VIP > 1 & q_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC > 0 ~ "2M",
      VIP > 1 & q_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC < 0 ~ "9M",
      TRUE ~ "Not sig"
    )
  )



# ### 4. 注释信息合并 ###

#   "/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx"

#     `Class I`, 物质一级分类, `Class II`, 物质二级分类
#   )

# # 预处理 Compounds 列，去掉空格并转为小写（确保格式一致）
# metware_data$Compounds <- tolower(trimws(metware_data$Compounds))
# DEM_of_mouse_follicular_fluid$Compounds <- tolower(trimws(DEM_of_mouse_follicular_fluid$Compounds))
# 
# # 左连接合并注释
# DEM_of_mouse_follicular_fluid <- DEM_of_mouse_follicular_fluid %>%
#   left_join(metware_data, by = "Compounds")


### 5. 显著差异代谢物筛选 ###
Sig_DEMs_of_mouse_follicular_fluid <- DEMs_of_mouse_follicular_fluid %>%
  filter(
    VIP > 1 &                # VIP阈值
    q_value_T < 0.05         # 显著性阈值
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%  # 按|log2FC|降序排列
  mutate(
    Sig = if_else(log2FC > 0, "2M-sig", "9M-sig")  # 添加 Sig 列
  ) %>%
  select(
    # 核心差异指标
    Compounds, VIP, log2FC, Sig, CAS, Class_I,
    q_value_T, p_value_T, young_mean, old_mean
  )     # `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG,Metlin, `PubChem CID`, `Class I`, 物质一级分类,`Class II`, 物质二级分类

# 输出筛选结果维度
print(paste("Sig-DEMS:",nrow(Sig_DEMs_of_mouse_follicular_fluid)))

### 6. 结果输出 ###
write.csv(
  Sig_DEMs_of_mouse_follicular_fluid,
  "Sig_DEMs_of_mouse_follicular_fluid.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

Sig_Young_DEMs_of_mouse_follicular_fluid <- Sig_DEMs_of_mouse_follicular_fluid %>%
  filter(Sig %in% "2M-sig")
dim(Sig_Young_DEMs_of_mouse_follicular_fluid)


# 分组差异代谢物火山图 -----------------------
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)  # 加载 ggrepel 包用于标签避让

# 1. 定义显著性分类
volcano_data <- DEMs_of_mouse_follicular_fluid %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      q_value_T >= 0.05 ~ "Not sig",
      VIP > 1 & q_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC > 0 ~ "2M",
      VIP > 1 & q_value_T < 0.05 & log2FC < 0 ~ "9M",
      TRUE ~ "Not sig"
    )
  )

# 2. 计算每组的数量（用于图例标签）
count_sig <- volcano_data %>%
  group_by(significance) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      significance == "2M" ~ paste0("2M (n=", count, ")"),
      significance == "9M" ~ paste0("9M (n=", count, ")"),
      TRUE ~ paste0("Not sig (n=", count, ")")
    )
  )


library(ggplot2)
Fig_6C <- ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(q_value_T), color = significance)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "2M" = "#4DBBD5",
      "9M" = "#E64B35",
      "Not sig" = "gray80"),
    labels = c(
      "2M" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "2M"],
      "9M" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "9M"],
      "Not sig" = count_sig$label[count_sig$significance == "Not sig"]
    ),
    name = NULL, #"Group"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "2M vs 9M",
    x = expression(log[2]("FC")),
    y = expression(-log[10]("FDR"))
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14, base_family = "Arial") +  
  xlim(-5, 5) +    # x轴范围固定
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    aspect.ratio = 1,  
    text = element_text(family = "Arial",face = "plain"),  # 全局Arial字体
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face="bold"),  
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 16),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent")
  )

Fig_6C
```

```{r,echo=TRUE,fig.height=6,fig.width=12}
                   "Sod2", # 线粒体锰超氧化物歧化酶（SOD2）; 定位于线粒体基质，清除线粒体电子传递链（ETC）产生的O₂•⁻。
                   "Sod3", # 胞外铜锌超氧化物歧化酶（SOD3）;分泌至细胞外基质（ECM）和体液（如血浆），保护组织免受氧化损伤。

# 提取显著差异基因 (adj.p < 0.05)
# sig_genes <- subset(DEGs, p_val_adj < 0.05 & p_val_adj > 0)
sig_genes <- DEGs
head(sig_genes)



library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# 辅助函数：转换GeneRatio（"10/100" → 0.1）
parse_ratio <- function(x) {
  sapply(strsplit(x, "/"), function(y) as.numeric(y[1]) / as.numeric(y[2]))
}

library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)

# 确保sig_genes按cluster分列
sig_genes <- sig_genes %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 按亚群运行GO分析
go_results <- lapply(levels(as.factor(sig_genes$cluster)), function(cl) {
  # 提取当前亚群的基因
  genes <- subset(sig_genes, cluster == cl)$gene
  
  # 转为Entrez ID（跳过无映射的基因）
  entrez <- bitr(genes, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db)
  
  # GO富集（严格过滤）
  enrichGO(
    gene = entrez$ENTREZID,
    OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
    keyType = "ENTREZID",
    ont = "BP",
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.01,  # 显著性阈值
    qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    readable = TRUE
  )
}) %>% setNames(levels(as.factor(sig_genes$cluster)))


# 2. 提取所有显著通路并合并为数据框
go_df <- lapply(names(go_results), function(cluster) {
  res <- go_results[[cluster]]
  if (is.null(res) || nrow(res) == 0) return(NULL)  # 跳过无结果的cluster
  data.frame(
    Cluster = cluster,
    Pathway = res$Description,
    GeneRatio = parse_ratio(res$GeneRatio),  # 使用辅助函数
    p.adjust = res$p.adjust,
    Count = res$Count,
    GeneSymbols = res$geneID
  )
}) %>% bind_rows() %>% filter(!is.na(Cluster))


# 筛选共有通路 
library(dplyr)

# 一步式管道操作: 筛选高频共有通路 → 聚焦脂质代谢 → 准备可视化数据
lipid_plot_data <- go_df %>%
  # 第一步: 筛选至少出现在10个Cluster中的通路
  group_by(Pathway) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(Cluster) >= 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # 第二步: 精确匹配目标脂质代谢通路
  filter(Pathway %in% c(
    "fatty acid metabolic process",
    "fatty acid oxidation", 
    "fatty acid catabolic process",
    "fatty acid beta-oxidation",
    "sphingolipid metabolic process",
    "sphingolipid biosynthetic process",
    "glycerolipid biosynthetic process",
    "glycerolipid metabolic process",
    "glycerophospholipid biosynthetic process",
    "glycerophospholipid metabolic process"
  )) %>%
  
  # 第三步: 按需排序并计算可视化参数
  arrange(Cluster, Pathway) %>%
  mutate(
    log_padj = -log10(p.adjust),
    # 更稳健的GeneRatio转换方法
    GeneRatio = if (is.character(GeneRatio)) {
      sapply(strsplit(as.character(GeneRatio), "/"), 
             function(x) as.numeric(x[1])/as.numeric(x[2]))
    } else {
      GeneRatio  # 如果已经是数值则保持不变
    }
  )

# 查看通路统计

# Young + Old 热图 --------------------
library(Seurat)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

# 定义目标基因
target_genes <- c("Gpx4", "Acsl4", "Cat", "Sod1", "Sod2", "Sod3", "Hspd1", "Hspe1")

# 提取子集并计算平均表达量
ovary_young <- subset(ovary, subset = age == "YOUNG")
ovary_old <- subset(ovary, subset = age == "OLD")

avg_young <- AverageExpression(ovary_young, 
                               assays = "RNA",
                               group.by = "cluster.names",
                               features = target_genes)$RNA  # 列=clusters, 行=genes

avg_old <- AverageExpression(ovary_old,
                             assays = "RNA",
                             group.by = "cluster.names",
                             features = target_genes)$RNA

# 标准化（组内Z-score）
z_young <- t(scale(t(avg_young)))
z_old <- t(scale(t(avg_old)))

# 合并数据，保留原始cluster名
combined_z <- cbind(z_young, z_old)

# 生成年龄分组标签（直接匹配列顺序）
age_groups <- rep(c("Young", "Old"), each = ncol(z_young))

# 检查列名是否一致（必须相同）
stopifnot(colnames(z_young) == colnames(z_old))  
cluster_names <- colnames(z_young)  # 原始cluster名

# 颜色定义
age_colors <- c("Young" = "#4DBBD5", "Old" = "#DC0000")

# 列注释（自动适配列顺序）
ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Age = age_groups,
  col = list(Age = age_colors),
  show_legend = TRUE,
  annotation_name_side = "left"
)

# 绘制热图
Heatmap(
  combined_z,
  name = "z-score",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#4DBBD5","white","#DC0000")),

  # 关键分块设置
  column_split = factor(age_groups, levels = c("Young", "Old")),
  cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
  column_title = c("Young Ovary", "Old Ovary"),  # 自定义分块标题

  cluster_columns = T,
  cluster_rows = F,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 45,
  
  # 添加注释和样式优化
  top_annotation = ha,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"),  # 加粗cluster名

  # 修正后的图例设置
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Scaled Expression",
    legend_direction = "horizontal",  # 横向图例更简洁
    title_position = "topcenter"      # 可选，仅对分类图例有效
  )
)

# 差异基因 @甘油磷脂通路 -------------
library(readr)
mouse_GP <- read_csv("~/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/Pathway/mmu00564_Glycerophospholipid_metabolism_genes.csv")

library(Seurat)

# 检查分组是否有效
if (!"age" %in% names(ovary@meta.data)) stop("metadata中无age列！")

# 设置分组标识（必须转为因子）
ovary@meta.data$age <- factor(ovary@meta.data$age, levels = c("YOUNG", "OLD"))

GC <- subset(ovary, subset = ovary@meta.data$cluster.names %in% "Granulosa")


# 运行差异分析（以YOUNG为基准）
markers <- FindMarkers(
  object = GC,
  ident.1 = "OLD",          # 对比组：OLD vs YOUNG
  ident.2 = "YOUNG",        # 基准组
  group.by = "age",         # 指定分组列
  test.use = "wilcox",      # 默认Wilcoxon秩和检验
  logfc.threshold = 0.25,   # 最小log2FC阈值
  min.pct = 0.1,            # 基因在至少10%的细胞中表达
  only.pos = FALSE          # 输出上下调基因
)


# 添加基因符号列（若ENSEMBL ID需转换）
markers$gene <- rownames(markers)

# 按显著性过滤 (FDR < 0.05 & |logFC| > 0.5)
sig_markers <- subset(markers, p_val_adj < 0.05 & p_val_adj > 0 & abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.5)

# 添加上下调标签
sig_markers$regulation <- ifelse(
  sig_markers$avg_log2FC > 0,
  "UP_in_OLD",
  "DOWN_in_OLD"
)

# 按logFC排序
sig_markers <- sig_markers[order(-sig_markers$avg_log2FC), ]

# 查看结果
head(sig_markers, 3)

# 获取在差异基因列表且存在于mouse_GP的基因
matched_genes <- intersect(sig_markers$gene, mouse_GP$Gene_Symbol)

# 筛选差异基因结果（保留匹配的基因）
annotated_markers <- sig_markers[sig_markers$gene %in% matched_genes, ]

# 提取mouse_GP中的对应注释信息（如基因功能等）
gene_annotations <- mouse_GP[mouse_GP$Gene_Symbol %in% matched_genes, ]

# 按需合并两个数据框（例如添加基因功能列）
final_result <- merge(
  x = annotated_markers,
  y = gene_annotations,
  by.x = "gene",
  by.y = "Gene_Symbol",
  all.x = FALSE  # 仅保留成功匹配的行
)

# 按logFC排序
final_result <- final_result[order(-final_result$avg_log2FC), ]

sort(unique(final_result$gene))

final_result
#     gene        p_val avg_log2FC pct.1 pct.2    p_val_adj  regulation Gene_ID
# 1  Adprm 2.478917e-09  0.7191870 0.211 0.131 5.023277e-05   UP_in_OLD   66358
# 2 Agpat1 3.416717e-30  0.5836712 0.408 0.219 6.923635e-26   UP_in_OLD   55979
# 3  Gpat3 2.065773e-06 -0.5431733 0.142 0.087 4.186081e-02 DOWN_in_OLD  231510
# 4  Gpd1l 1.627716e-11 -0.5603551 0.238 0.141 3.298404e-07 DOWN_in_OLD  333433



# 确保GC_GP中的基因存在于GC中
GC_GP <- intersect(rownames(GC), mouse_GP$Gene_Symbol)

# 提取表达矩阵（默认使用标准化数据层'data'）
expr_data <- GetAssayData(GC, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")[GC_GP, ]

# 添加分组信息（按meta.data中的age列）
group_info <- GC@meta.data$age  # 假设age是字符型或因子

# 转换为数据框并添加分组
expr_df <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(expr_data)))
expr_df$group <- group_info

# 按组计算均值
mean_expr <- aggregate(. ~ group, data = expr_df, FUN = mean)
rownames(mean_expr) <- mean_expr$group
mean_expr <- mean_expr[, -1]  # 移除分组列

library(pheatmap)

# 标准化数据（Z-score）以改善可视化效果
scaled_data <- t(scale(t(mean_expr)))

# 绘制热图
pheatmap(
  scaled_data,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50),  # 颜色映射
  cluster_rows = TRUE,     # 聚类行（age组）
  cluster_cols = TRUE,     # 聚类列（基因）
  show_colnames = TRUE,    # 显示基因名（若过多可设为FALSE）
  fontsize_row = 8,        # 行标签大小
  fontsize_col = 6,        # 列标签大小
  main = "Gene Expression by Age Group"  # 标题
)
```
