```{r,echo=TRUE,fig.height=6,fig.width=12}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)

# 1. 设置分组标识
Idents(ovary) <- "cluster.names"

# 2. 差异分析（对每个cluster比较OLD vs YOUNG）
de_results <- lapply(levels(ovary), function(cluster) {
  subset(ovary, idents = cluster) %>% 
    {Idents(.) <- "age"; .} %>% 
    FindMarkers(
      ident.1 = "OLD",
      ident.2 = "YOUNG",
      test.use = "wilcox",
      min.pct = 0.1,
      logfc.threshold = 0.5,
      verbose = FALSE
    ) %>% 
    filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.5)
}) %>% setNames(levels(ovary))

# 3. 结果概览
sapply(de_results, nrow)  # 各cluster差异基因数量

# 4. 合并所有结果并添加gene列
all_de_genes <- bind_rows(lapply(names(de_results), function(cluster) {
  de_results[[cluster]] %>% 
    mutate(Cluster = cluster, gene = rownames(.))
}), .id = "cluster")

# 5. 基因注释匹配
annotated_markers <- all_de_genes %>% 
  filter(gene %in% mouse_GP$Gene_Symbol) %>% 
  left_join(mouse_GP, by = c("gene" = "Gene_Symbol")) %>% 
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC))

# 6. 输出排序后的基因列表
sort(unique(annotated_markers$gene))

```
可以看到，黄体细胞（Luteal）同时高表达ACSL4（促铁死亡）和 GPX4（抗铁死亡）基因，可能反映了其需要 在促氧化（激素合成）和抗氧化（细胞存活）之间保持精密平衡。但是这里的黄体只是大类，包含黄体形成期、黄体消退期等细胞，GPX4和ACSL4可能存在差异。


**黄体细胞：铁死亡与高代谢的平衡中心**

黄体细胞的高代谢需求（孕酮合成需要大量线粒体氧化反应）必然伴随高ROS产生，而SOD2（线粒体超氧化物歧化酶）和GPX4共同抵抗由此引发的氧化损伤。
ACSL4的共表达进一步提示，黄体细胞需要主动调控脂质过氧化水平（可能通过PUFA磷脂的合成与清除动态平衡）。
PUFA磷脂供应：ACSL4提供的多不饱和脂肪酸是类固醇前体，但同时也是铁死亡的“燃料”。
双重防护：GPX4和SOD2共同维持氧化还原稳态，防止细胞崩溃。

三者协同表明黄体细胞同时面临极高的ROS生成压力和独特的修复机制，其氧化还原平衡直接影响黄体功能（如孕酮分泌）和寿命。

对比其他细胞：

颗粒细胞：低表达GPX4/ACSL4，以糖酵解为主，氧化代谢需求较低。
卵母细胞：依赖卵泡细胞的抗氧化保护（如通过gap junction传递GSH），自身抗氧化基因表达较低。
Stroma细胞：低代谢活性，氧化应激相关基因表达普遍较低（除SOD3外）。


**卵泡膜细胞：炎症与纤维化相关的“氧化哨点”**

高表达SOD3（胞外超氧化物歧化酶） + HSPD1/HSPE1（线粒体伴侣蛋白）
功能关联：
SOD3将超氧化物（O₂⁻）转化为H₂O₂，可能在卵泡膜-颗粒细胞界面建立H₂O₂梯度，参与：
信号传递：调控颗粒细胞增殖/分化（如H₂O₂可抑制颗粒细胞凋亡）。
屏障功能：保护卵母细胞免受外界氧化损伤。
HSPD1/HSPE1的高表达提示卵泡膜细胞的线粒体蛋白折叠压力较高（可能因其合成类固醇激素的需求）。
氧化应激热点证据：

SOD3的胞外定位和HSPs的线粒体保护作用共同指向卵泡膜细胞是卵巢中胞外ROS生成与防御的关键界面。
尽管其自身可能不经历剧烈氧化损伤（如黄体细胞），但作为ROS信号的中继站，调控邻近细胞的氧化微环境。


**潜在研究方向**

黄体细胞：

研究GPX4/ACSL4比值在黄体退化（luteolysis）中的作用，是否通过铁死亡调控程序性清除。
探索老年卵巢中黄体细胞氧化应激失衡与生殖衰老的关系。
卵泡膜细胞：

验证SOD3生成的H₂O₂如何影响颗粒细胞命运（如通过氧化还原信号通路如NF-κB/Nrf2）。
分析PCOS患者卵泡膜细胞中SOD3/HSPs的表达是否异常。
交互作用：

黄体细胞与卵泡膜细胞是否有抗氧化物质（如GSH、维生素E）的相互支援？


**黄体细胞中泛醌（辅酶Q10，Ubiquinone）和维生素D3（VD3）的年龄依赖性共定位现象**

与GPX4/ACSL4的联动：
老年黄体中泛醌/VD3的积累可能是对ACSL4高表达导致的脂质过氧化压力的适应性反应（补充GPX4的抗铁死亡能力）。

与SOD2的协同：
SOD2清除线粒体超氧化物，而泛醌直接中和脂质自由基，形成**“三级防御”**：
SOD2（O₂⁻→H₂O₂）→GPX4（H₂O₂→H₂O）→泛醌（终止脂质自由基链式反应）

**泛醌/VD3共定位程度或可作为卵巢衰老的分子标志物，比单纯激素水平更早反映黄体细胞状态**

**待验证的科学问题**

是衰老导致泛醌/VD3积累，还是这些分子的主动上调延缓了衰老？通过基因敲降（如VDR或CoQ10合成酶）验证其对黄体寿命的影响。
共定位是否集中在线粒体/脂滴？免疫电镜或可明确。
小鼠与人类黄体在衰老中的分子响应是否一致？（需类器官模型验证）


**黄体细胞中泛醌与VD3的年龄依赖性共定位**，揭示了：

老年黄体处于“高防御状态”：通过调用脂溶性抗氧化系统弥补氧化还原失衡。
代谢灵活性丧失：从年轻时的动态平衡转向保守维持，可能以牺牲激素合成能力为代价。
干预窗口期：在衰老早期补充泛醌/VD3或比晚期更有效（避免线粒体不可逆损伤）。


**黄体特异性磷脂（如 PE-PUFA、氧化修饰磷脂）和卵泡磷脂谱的动态变化**，可作为：

黄体功能的精准分子标记物**（评估活力、预测退化）。
卵泡发育质量的新型评估指标**（预测排卵潜力、闭锁风险）。闭锁卵泡可能提前出现 PE-PUFA 升高（类似黄体，但无正常黄体功能）。PCOS 患者的卵泡磷脂异常：
可能检测到 PE 16:0/20:4 过早积累（与卵泡发育停滞相关）

结合脂质组学和空间成像技术，未来可能发展出：
“磷脂指纹”预测模型：用于个性化ART方案优化。
抗铁死亡治疗靶点：如通过调节ACSL4/PE-PUFA延缓黄体退化。

```{r,echo=TRUE}
# GO ---------------------------
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(Seurat)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(DOSE)
library(tidyverse)
setwd("/home/hsinyinteng/GSE232309_mouse_ovary")

mouse_ovary <- readRDS("/home/hsinyinteng/GSE232309_mouse_ovary/GSE232309_age.combined.RDS")


# 初始化汇总表格
combined_results <- data.frame()

# 定义细胞类型列表
celltypes <- unique(mouse_ovary$cluster.names)

for (celltype in celltypes) {
    # Step 1: 差异基因分析 ----
    message("\nProcessing: ", celltype)
    subset_cells <- subset(mouse_ovary, cluster.names == celltype)
    subset_cells <- subset(subset_cells, age %in% c("YOUNG", "OLD"))
    Idents(subset_cells) <- "age"
    
    markers <- FindMarkers(
        object = subset_cells,
        ident.1 = "YOUNG",
        ident.2 = "OLD",
        test.use = "wilcox",
        logfc.threshold = 0.1,
        min.pct = 0.01,  
        only.pos = FALSE
    ) %>%
        as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>%
        mutate(state = if_else(avg_log2FC > 0, "Young-Up", "Old-Up"))
    
    # Step 2: GO富集 ----
    sig_genes <- markers %>% 
        dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% 
        pull(gene)
    
    if (length(sig_genes) >= 5) {
        gene_entrez <- bitr(
            sig_genes,
            fromType = "SYMBOL",
            toType = "ENTREZID",
            OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db
        ) %>%
            dplyr::filter(!is.na(ENTREZID))
        
        if (nrow(gene_entrez) >= 3) {
            go_bp <- enrichGO(
                gene = gene_entrez$ENTREZID,
                OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
                keyType = "ENTREZID",
                ont = "BP",
                pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                readable = TRUE
            )
            
            if (nrow(go_bp) > 0) {
                # 关键修复：显式调用dplyr并简化流程
                state_mapping <- markers %>% 
                    dplyr::select(gene, state) %>% 
                    distinct()
                
                go_results <- go_bp@result %>%
                    mutate(cell_type = celltype) %>%
                    separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") %>%
                    mutate(gene = str_trim(geneID)) %>%
                    inner_join(state_mapping, by = "gene")  # 严格匹配
                
                combined_results <- bind_rows(combined_results, go_results)
            }
        }
    }
}

# 保存为CSV
write.csv(combined_results, "GSE232309_Combined_DEG_GO_Results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 可选：过滤低质量结果（如保留至少3个基因的通路）
filtered_results <- combined_results %>%
  group_by(ID, cell_type) %>%
  filter(Count >= 3) %>%
  ungroup()

# 保存过滤后结果
write.csv(filtered_results, "GSE232309_DEGs_GO_Results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 显示汇总信息

# KEGG通路富集 ---------------------------
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(Seurat)

# Initialize combined results
combined_results <- data.frame()

# Define cell types
celltypes <- unique(mouse_ovary$cluster.names)

for (celltype in celltypes) {
    message("\nProcessing: ", celltype)
    
    # Step 1: Differential expression - SAFELY
    tryCatch({
        subset_cells <- subset(mouse_ovary, cluster.names == celltype)
        subset_cells <- subset(subset_cells, age %in% c("YOUNG", "OLD"))
        Idents(subset_cells) <- "age"
        
        # Verify we have both conditions
        if (length(unique(subset_cells$age)) < 2) {
            message("Skipping ", celltype, " - not enough age groups")
            next
        }
        
        markers <- FindMarkers(
            object = subset_cells,
            ident.1 = "YOUNG",
            ident.2 = "OLD",
            test.use = "wilcox",
            logfc.threshold = 0.1,
            min.pct = 0.01,
            only.pos = FALSE
        ) %>%
            as.data.frame() %>%
            tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
            dplyr::mutate(state = if_else(avg_log2FC > 0, "Young-Up", "Old-Up"))
        
        # Step 2: KEGG enrichment - ROBUSTLY
        sig_genes <- markers %>% 
            dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% 
            dplyr::pull(gene)
        
        if (length(sig_genes) >= 5) {
            gene_entrez <- tryCatch(
                {
                    clusterProfiler::bitr(
                        sig_genes,
                        fromType = "SYMBOL",
                        toType = "ENTREZID",
                        OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db
                    ) %>% 
                        dplyr::filter(!is.na(ENTREZID)) %>%
                        dplyr::rename(gene = SYMBOL)  # Ensure 'gene' column exists
                },
                error = function(e) {
                    message("Gene conversion failed: ", e$message)
                    return(NULL)
                }
            )
            
            if (!is.null(gene_entrez) && nrow(gene_entrez) >= 3) {
                kegg_result <- tryCatch(
                    clusterProfiler::enrichKEGG(
                        gene = gene_entrez$ENTREZID,
                        organism = "mmu",
                        keyType = "ncbi-geneid",
                        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                        pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                        qvalueCutoff = 0.2
                    ),
                    error = function(e) {
                        message("KEGG enrichment failed: ", e$message)
                        return(NULL)
                    }
                )
                
                if (!is.null(kegg_result) && nrow(kegg_result@result) > 0) {
                    # SAFELY process KEGG results
                    kegg_df <- kegg_result@result %>%
                        as.data.frame() %>%
                        dplyr::mutate(cell_type = celltype) %>%
                        tidyr::separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") %>%
                        # Join with normalized column names
                        dplyr::left_join(
                            gene_entrez %>% dplyr::select(ENTREZID, gene),
                            by = c("geneID" = "ENTREZID"),
                            relationship = "many-to-many"
                        ) %>%
                        # Then join with markers
                        dplyr::left_join(
                            markers %>% dplyr::select(gene, state),
                            by = "gene",
                            relationship = "many-to-many"
                        )
                    
                    combined_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(combined_results, kegg_df)
                }
            }
        }
    }, error = function(e) {
        message("Error processing ", celltype, ": ", e$message)
    })
}

# Check the final output
if (nrow(combined_results) > 0) {
    head(combined_results)
} else {
    message("No KEGG results were produced. Check your input data and filters.")
}

  group_by(ID, cell_type) %>%
  filter(Count >= 3) %>%
  ungroup()

# 保存过滤后结果
write.csv(filtered_results, "GSE232309_DEGs_KEGG_Results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

message("\n===== Analysis Completed =====")
message("Total enriched pathways: ", n_distinct(combined_results$ID))
message("Cell types with results: ", toString(unique(combined_results$cell_type)))
```

```{r}
# 0x0 按细胞类别进行GO分析+分别保存通路结果，再筛选GP通路 --------------------------
library(Seurat)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(DOSE)
library(tidyverse)
setwd("/home/hsinyinteng/GSE255690_human_ovary")

human_ovary <- readRDS("/home/hsinyinteng/GSE255690_human_ovary/ovary_harmony_filted_240531.rds")

assign_Age <- function(orig_ident) {
  case_when(
    grepl("^young", orig_ident) ~ "young",
    grepl("^middle", orig_ident) ~ "middle",
    grepl("^old", orig_ident) ~ "old"
  )
}

human_ovary$Age <- factor(
  sapply(human_ovary$orig.ident, assign_Age),
  levels = c("young", "middle", "old")
)

table(human_ovary$Age)


for (celltype in celltypes) {
  # Step 1: 差异基因分析
  subset_cells <- subset(human_ovary, umap_celltype == celltype)
  subset_cells <- subset(subset_cells, Age %in% c("young", "middle"))
  Idents(subset_cells) <- "Age"

  markers <- FindMarkers(
    object = subset_cells,
    ident.1 = "young",
    ident.2 = "middle",
    test.use = "wilcox",
    logfc.threshold = 0.1,
    min.pct = 0.01,
    only.pos = FALSE
  )
  markers$gene <- rownames(markers)
  write.csv(markers, file = paste0("DEG_", celltype, "_young_vs_middle.csv"))

  # Step 2: 仅对显著差异基因进行GO分析（padj < 0.05）
  sig_genes <- markers %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
    pull(gene)

  if (length(sig_genes) >= 5) {  # 至少5个基因才能运行GO
    # 转换基因名为Entrez ID
    gene_entrez <- bitr(
      sig_genes,
      fromType = "SYMBOL",
      toType = "ENTREZID",
      OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
    )

    # GO富集分析（生物过程BP）
    go_bp <- enrichGO(
      gene = gene_entrez$ENTREZID,
      OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
      keyType = "ENTREZID",
      ont = "BP",
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
      qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
      readable = TRUE
    )

    # 保存GO结果
    write.csv(go_bp@result, paste0("GO_BP_", celltype, ".csv"))

    # Step 3: 可视化
    if (nrow(go_bp) > 0) {  # 确保有显著富集通路
      # 1. 点图（Top 10通路）
      pdf(paste0("GO_DotPlot_", celltype, ".pdf"), width = 10, height = 6)
      print(
        dotplot(go_bp, showCategory = 10, title = paste("GO BP -", celltype)) +
          theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
      )
      dev.off()

      # 2. 网络图（通路关联性）
      # pdf(paste0("GO_Network_", celltype, ".pdf"), width = 8, height = 8)
      # print(
      #   emapplot(pairwise_termsim(go_bp), showCategory = 15) +
      #     ggtitle(paste("GO Network -", celltype))
      # )
      # dev.off()
    } else {
      message("No significant GO terms for: ", celltype)
    }
  } else {
    message("Not enough DEGs (n < 5) for GO in: ", celltype)
  }
}




target_pathways <- c(
  "glycerophospholipid biosynthetic process",
  "glycerophospholipid catabolic process",
  "glycerophospholipid metabolic process"
)

library(tidyverse)

# 获取所有细胞类型的GO结果文件（例如GO_BP_Oocyte.csv）
go_files <- list.files(pattern = "GO_BP_.*\\.csv")

# 初始化空列表存储筛选后的数据
filtered_go_list <- list()

for (file in go_files) {
  # 提取细胞类型名称（从文件名）
  celltype <- str_extract(file, "(?<=GO_BP_)[^.]*")  # 匹配GO_BP_后的部分

  # 读取文件并筛选目标通路
  go_data <- read_csv(file) %>%
    filter(str_detect(Description, paste(target_pathways, collapse = "|"))) %>%
    mutate(celltype = celltype)  # 添加celltype列

  # 如果筛选后不为空，存入列表
  if (nrow(go_data) > 0) {
    filtered_go_list[[celltype]] <- go_data
  } else {
    message("No target pathways found in: ", celltype)
  }
}

# 合并所有筛选后的数据
merged_glycerophospholipid <- bind_rows(filtered_go_list)

# 检查结果
if (nrow(merged_glycerophospholipid) > 0) {
  print(merged_glycerophospholipid %>% select(celltype, Description, p.adjust, Count))

mk_ovary <- c('DCN','STAR',  # Theca and Stroma cells--T&S
        'ACTA2','MUSTN1', # Smooth muscle cells (SMCs)
        'TM4SF1','VWF', # Endothelial cells(EC)
        'CCL5','NKG7', # Natural killer cells (NK)
        'IL7R','KLRB1',  # T lymphocytes
        'TYROBP', 'IFI30', # Monocytes
        'GSTA1','AMH','HSD17B1', # Granulosa cells(GCs)
        'ZP3','FIGLA'    # Oocytes  'TUBB8',
)
DotPlot(human_ovary,features = mk_ovary)+RotatedAxis()


# 初始化汇总表格
combined_results <- data.frame()

# 定义细胞类型列表
celltypes <- unique(human_ovary$umap_celltype)

for (celltype in celltypes) {
    # Step 1: 差异基因分析 ----
    message("\nProcessing: ", celltype)
    subset_cells <- subset(human_ovary, umap_celltype == celltype)
    subset_cells <- subset(subset_cells, Age %in% c("young", "middle"))
    Idents(subset_cells) <- "Age"
    
    markers <- FindMarkers(
        object = subset_cells,
        ident.1 = "young",
        ident.2 = "middle",
        test.use = "wilcox",
        logfc.threshold = 0.1,
        min.pct = 0.01,  
        only.pos = FALSE
    ) %>%
        as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>%
        mutate(state = if_else(avg_log2FC > 0, "Young-Up", "Middle-Up"))
    
    # Step 2: GO富集 ----
    sig_genes <- markers %>% 
        dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% 
        pull(gene)
    
    if (length(sig_genes) >= 5) {
        gene_entrez <- bitr(
            sig_genes,
            fromType = "SYMBOL",
            toType = "ENTREZID",
            OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
        ) %>%
            dplyr::filter(!is.na(ENTREZID))
        
        if (nrow(gene_entrez) >= 3) {
            go_bp <- enrichGO(
                gene = gene_entrez$ENTREZID,
                OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                keyType = "ENTREZID",
                ont = "BP",
                pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                readable = TRUE
            )
            
            if (nrow(go_bp) > 0) {
                # 关键修复：显式调用dplyr并简化流程
                state_mapping <- markers %>% 
                    dplyr::select(gene, state) %>% 
                    distinct()
                
                go_results <- go_bp@result %>%
                    mutate(cell_type = celltype) %>%
                    separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") %>%
                    mutate(gene = str_trim(geneID)) %>%
                    inner_join(state_mapping, by = "gene")  # 严格匹配
                
                combined_results <- bind_rows(combined_results, go_results)
            }
        }
    }
}

# 保存为CSV
write.csv(combined_results, "GSE255690_Combined_DEG_GO_Results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 可选：过滤低质量结果（如保留至少3个基因的通路）
filtered_results <- combined_results %>%
  group_by(ID, cell_type) %>%
  filter(Count >= 3) %>%
  ungroup()

# 保存过滤后结果
write.csv(filtered_results, "GSE255690_DEGs_GO_Results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 显示汇总信息
message("\n===== Analysis Completed =====")
message("Total enriched pathways: ", n_distinct(combined_results$ID))
message("Cell types with results: ", toString(unique(combined_results$cell_type)))

# KEGG通路富集 ---------------------------
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(Seurat)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(DOSE)
library(tidyverse)
setwd("/home/hsinyinteng/GSE255690_human_ovary")

human_ovary <- readRDS("/home/hsinyinteng/GSE255690_human_ovary/ovary_harmony_filted_240531.rds")

# Initialize combined results
combined_results <- data.frame()

# Define cell types
celltypes <- unique(human_ovary$umap_celltype)

for (celltype in celltypes) {
    message("\nProcessing: ", celltype)
    
    # Step 1: Differential expression - SAFELY
    tryCatch({
        subset_cells <- subset(human_ovary, umap_celltype == celltype)
        subset_cells <- subset(subset_cells, Age %in% c("young", "middle"))
        Idents(subset_cells) <- "Age"
        
        # Verify we have both conditions
        if (length(unique(subset_cells$Age)) < 2) {
            message("Skipping ", celltype, " - not enough age groups")
            next
        }
        
        markers <- FindMarkers(
            object = subset_cells,
            ident.1 = "young",
            ident.2 = "middle",
            test.use = "wilcox",
            logfc.threshold = 0.1,
            min.pct = 0.01,
            only.pos = FALSE
        ) %>%
            as.data.frame() %>%
            tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
            dplyr::mutate(state = if_else(avg_log2FC > 0, "Young-Up", "Middle-Up"))
        
        # Step 2: KEGG enrichment - ROBUSTLY
        sig_genes <- markers %>% 
            dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% 
            dplyr::pull(gene)
        
        if (length(sig_genes) >= 5) {
            gene_entrez <- tryCatch(
                {
                    clusterProfiler::bitr(
                        sig_genes,
                        fromType = "SYMBOL",
                        toType = "ENTREZID",
                        OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
                    ) %>% 
                        dplyr::filter(!is.na(ENTREZID)) %>%
                        dplyr::rename(gene = SYMBOL)  # Ensure 'gene' column exists
                },
                error = function(e) {
                    message("Gene conversion failed: ", e$message)
                    return(NULL)
                }
            )
            
            if (!is.null(gene_entrez) && nrow(gene_entrez) >= 3) {
                kegg_result <- tryCatch(
                    clusterProfiler::enrichKEGG(
                        gene = gene_entrez$ENTREZID,
                        organism = "hsa",
                        keyType = "ncbi-geneid",
                        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                        pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                        qvalueCutoff = 0.2
                    ),
                    error = function(e) {
                        message("KEGG enrichment failed: ", e$message)
                        return(NULL)
                    }
                )
                
                if (!is.null(kegg_result) && nrow(kegg_result@result) > 0) {
                    # SAFELY process KEGG results
                    kegg_df <- kegg_result@result %>%
                        as.data.frame() %>%
                        dplyr::mutate(cell_type = celltype) %>%
                        tidyr::separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") %>%
                        # Join with normalized column names
                        dplyr::left_join(
                            gene_entrez %>% dplyr::select(ENTREZID, gene),
                            by = c("geneID" = "ENTREZID"),
                            relationship = "many-to-many"
                        ) %>%
                        # Then join with markers
                        dplyr::left_join(
                            markers %>% dplyr::select(gene, state),
                            by = "gene",
                            relationship = "many-to-many"
                        )
                    
                    combined_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(combined_results, kegg_df)
                }
            }
        }
    }, error = function(e) {
        message("Error processing ", celltype, ": ", e$message)
    })
}

# Check the final output
if (nrow(combined_results) > 0) {
    head(combined_results)
} else {
    message("No KEGG results were produced. Check your input data and filters.")
}


# 保存为CSV
# write.csv(combined_results, "GSE255690_Combined_DEG_KEGG_Results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 可选：过滤低质量结果（如保留至少3个基因的通路）
filtered_results <- combined_results %>%
  group_by(ID, cell_type) %>%
  filter(Count >= 3) %>%
  ungroup()

# 保存过滤后结果
write.csv(filtered_results, "GSE255690_DEGs_KEGG_Results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 显示汇总信息
message("\n===== Analysis Completed =====")
message("Total enriched pathways: ", n_distinct(combined_results$ID))
message("Cell types with results: ", toString(unique(combined_results$cell_type)))
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
            go_bp <- enrichGO(
                gene = gene_entrez$ENTREZID,
                OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                keyType = "ENTREZID",
                ont = "BP",
                pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                readable = TRUE
            )
            
            if (nrow(go_bp) > 0) {
                # 关键修复：显式调用dplyr并简化流程
                state_mapping <- markers %>% 
                    dplyr::select(gene, state) %>% 
                    distinct()
                
                go_results <- go_bp@result %>%
                    mutate(cell_type = celltype) %>%
                    separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") %>%
                    mutate(gene = str_trim(geneID)) %>%
                    inner_join(state_mapping, by = "gene")  # 严格匹配
                
                hsa_combined_results <- bind_rows(hsa_combined_results, go_results)
            }
        }
    }
}

# 保存为CSV
write.csv(hsa_combined_results, "GSE255690_Combined_DEGs_GO_Results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 可选：过滤低质量结果（如保留至少3个基因的通路）
hsa_filtered_results <- hsa_combined_results %>%
  group_by(ID, cell_type) %>%
  filter(Count >= 3) %>%
  ungroup()

# 保存过滤后结果
write.csv(hsa_filtered_results, "GSE255690_DEGs_GO_Results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 显示汇总信息
message("\n===== Analysis Completed =====")
message("Total enriched pathways: ", n_distinct(hsa_combined_results$ID))
message("Cell types with results: ", toString(unique(hsa_combined_results$cell_type)))

mmu_combined_results <- data.frame()

# 定义细胞类型列表
celltypes <- unique(mouse_ovary$cluster.names)

for (celltype in celltypes) {
    # Step 1: 差异基因分析 ----
    message("\nProcessing: ", celltype)
    subset_cells <- subset(mouse_ovary, cluster.names == celltype)
    subset_cells <- subset(subset_cells, age %in% c("YOUNG", "OLD"))
    Idents(subset_cells) <- "age"
    
    markers <- FindMarkers(
        object = subset_cells,
        ident.1 = "YOUNG",
        ident.2 = "OLD",
        test.use = "wilcox",
        logfc.threshold = 0.1,
        min.pct = 0.01,  
        only.pos = FALSE
    ) %>%
        as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>%
        mutate(state = if_else(avg_log2FC > 0, "Young-Up", "Old-Up"))
    
    # Step 2: GO富集 ----
    sig_genes <- markers %>% 
        dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% 
        pull(gene)
    
    if (length(sig_genes) >= 5) {
        gene_entrez <- bitr(
            sig_genes,
            fromType = "SYMBOL",
            toType = "ENTREZID",
            OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db
        ) %>%
            dplyr::filter(!is.na(ENTREZID))
        
        if (nrow(gene_entrez) >= 3) {
            go_bp <- enrichGO(
                gene = gene_entrez$ENTREZID,
                OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
                keyType = "ENTREZID",
                ont = "BP",
                pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                readable = TRUE
            )
            
            if (nrow(go_bp) > 0) {
                # 关键修复：显式调用dplyr并简化流程
                state_mapping <- markers %>% 
                    dplyr::select(gene, state) %>% 
                    distinct()
                
                go_results <- go_bp@result %>%
                    mutate(cell_type = celltype) %>%
                    separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") %>%
                    mutate(gene = str_trim(geneID)) %>%
                    inner_join(state_mapping, by = "gene")  # 严格匹配
                
                mmu_combined_results <- bind_rows(mmu_combined_results, go_results)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

# image_DIY()
```{r,echo=TRUE}
image_DIY <- function(mse_obj, mz = mz) {
  # 自定义色阶（沿用你的设定）
  color_palette <- colorRampPalette(c(
    "black", "#000033", "#000066", "#0000FF", "#0077FF", "#00AAFF", 
    "cyan", "#66FF99", "green", "#AFFF00", "yellow", "#FFCC00", 
    "#FF9F00", "#FF6600", "red", "#CC0066", "purple"
  ))(300)
  
  #--- 调用 Cardinal::image 并提取数据 ---
  p <- Cardinal::image(
    mse_obj,
    mz = mz,
    smooth = "gaussian",
    enhance = "hist",
    col = color_palette)
  
  # 提取坐标和强度值
  x <- p$plots[[1]]$marks$pixels$encoding$x
  y <- p$plots[[1]]$marks$pixels$encoding$y
  intensity <- p$plots[[1]]$marks$pixels$encoding$color
  
  # 构建数据框
  df <- data.frame(x = x, y = y, intensity = intensity)
  
  #--- 用 ggplot2 绘图 + 优化样式 ---
  library(ggplot2)
  ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = intensity)) +
    geom_raster(interpolate = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = color_palette) +
    labs(title = paste("m/z =", round(mz, 4))) +
    scale_y_reverse() +  # Y轴反向（MSI标准）
    coord_fixed() +      # 固定比例
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "gray30", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5), # 主面板细边框
      panel.grid = element_blank(),  # 删除背景网格线
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,            # 水平居中
        face = "bold",          # 加粗
        size = 12,              # 字号
        margin = margin(b = 10) # 底部间距
      ),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"), # 坐标轴标签字体
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.background = element_blank() # 整体简洁主题
    )
}
```

```{r,echo=TRUE,fig.width=16,fig.height=8}
log_data <- log2(raw_data + 1)   # log2(x+1)转换后的数据（用于参数检验）

# 创建分组变量（8W 或 9M）
group <- ifelse(grepl("^8W", colnames(raw_data)), "8W", "9M") %>% 
  factor(levels = c("8W", "9M"))


### 2. OPLS-DA分析与VIP计算 ###
# 注意：VIP计算使用log转换+Pareto标准化后的数据
set.seed(2025)
oplsda_result <- opls(
  x = t(log_data),               # 输入log转换数据（样本×代谢物）
  y = group,                     # 使用统一的分组变量
  predI = 1,                     # 主成分数
  orthoI = 1,                    # 正交成分数
  log10L = FALSE,                # 已提前log转换，此处不再重复
  permI = 1000,                  # 置换检验次数
  scaleC = "pareto"              # Pareto标准化（VIP计算关键步骤）
)

# 提取VIP分数
vip_scores <- getVipVn(oplsda_result)

# 可视化OPLS-DA得分图
# plot(oplsda_result,
#      typeVc = "x-score",
#      parAsColFcVn = group,
#      parEllipsesL = TRUE,
#      parPaletteVc = c("#1F77B4", "#FF7F0E")
# )


### 3. 差异代谢物统计分析 ###
DEM_of_mouse_follicular_fluid <- raw_data %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    Compounds = mouse_follicular_fluid$Compounds,
    CAS = mouse_follicular_fluid$CAS,
    
    # 组均值（原始数据）
    young_mean = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("8W")), na.rm = TRUE),
    old_mean = rowMeans(select(., !starts_with("8W")), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # 变化倍数（原始数据计算后取log2）
    log2FC = log2(young_mean / old_mean),
    
    ### 基于log转换数据的统计检验 ###
    # Welch T检验（假设log转换后数据满足正态性）
    p_value_T = apply(log_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_8W <- x[group == "8W"]
      x_9M <- x[group == "9M"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_8W)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_9M)) < 2) return(NA)
      t.test(x_8W, x_9M, 
             alternative = "two.sided",
             var.equal = FALSE)$p.value  # Welch校正
    }),
    
    # FDR校正（BH方法）
    q_value_T = p.adjust(p_value_T, method = "BH"),
    
    ### 基于原始数据的非参数检验 ###
    # Mann-Whitney U检验（原始数据）
    p_value_Wilcox = apply(raw_data, 1, function(x) {
      x_8W <- x[group == "8W"]
      x_9M <- x[group == "9M"]
      if (sum(!is.na(x_8W)) < 2 | sum(!is.na(x_9M)) < 2) return(NA)
      wilcox.test(x_8W, x_9M, 
                  alternative = "two.sided",
                  exact = FALSE)$p.value  # 大样本近似
    }),
    
    # FDR校正（BH方法）
    q_value_Wilcox = p.adjust(p_value_Wilcox, method = "BH"),
    
    ### VIP分数（来自OPLS-DA）###
    VIP = vip_scores
  )

# ### 4. 注释信息合并 ###
# metware_data <- read_excel(
#   "/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx"
# ) %>% 
#   transmute(
#     mz = round(as.numeric(`Precursor (Da)`), 4),
#     Compounds, 物质, 
#     `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG, Metlin, `PubChem CID`,
#     `Class I`, 物质一级分类, `Class II`, 物质二级分类
#   )

# # 预处理 Compounds 列，去掉空格并转为小写（确保格式一致）
# metware_data$Compounds <- tolower(trimws(metware_data$Compounds))
# DEM_of_mouse_follicular_fluid$Compounds <- tolower(trimws(DEM_of_mouse_follicular_fluid$Compounds))
# 
# # 左连接合并注释
# DEM_of_mouse_follicular_fluid <- DEM_of_mouse_follicular_fluid %>%
#   left_join(metware_data, by = "Compounds")


### 5. 显著差异代谢物筛选 ###
Sig_DEM_of_mouse_follicular_fluid <- DEM_of_mouse_follicular_fluid %>%
  filter(
    VIP > 1 &                # VIP阈值
    q_value_T < 0.05         # 显著性阈值
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%  # 按|log2FC|降序排列
  mutate(
    Sig = if_else(log2FC > 0, "young-sig", "old-sig")  # 添加 Sig 列
  ) %>%
  select(
    # 核心差异指标
    Compounds, VIP, log2FC, Sig, CAS, # 新增 Sig 列
    q_value_T, p_value_T, young_mean, old_mean
  )     # `Molecular weight (Da)`, Adduct, CAS, HMDB, KEGG,Metlin, `PubChem CID`, `Class I`, 物质一级分类,`Class II`, 物质二级分类

# 输出筛选结果维度
print(paste("显著差异代谢物数量:",nrow(Sig_DEM_of_mouse_follicular_fluid)))

### 6. 结果输出 ###
write.csv(
  Sig_DEM_of_mouse_follicular_fluid,
  "Sig_DEM_of_mouse_follicular_fluid.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

Sig_Young_DEM_of_mouse_follicular_fluid <- Sig_DEM_of_mouse_follicular_fluid %>%
  filter(Sig %in% "young-sig")
dim(Sig_Young_DEM_of_mouse_follicular_fluid)
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
# 小鼠卵巢空间代谢组 @次级卵泡+窦卵泡 --------------------
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
ALL_sample_data <- read_excel("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/ALL_sample_data_1236_20241113.xlsx")

library(readxl)
Y2O_sig_diff_metabolites_14_Antral <- read_excel("~/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/Table_S7-2_Antral_DEMs(2M vs 9M).xlsx")
Y2O_sig_diff_metabolites_14_Secondary <- read_excel("~/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/Table_S7_Secondary_Follicle_DEMs(2M vs 9M).xlsx")

matched_cas_data <- ALL_sample_data %>%
  filter(CAS != "-", `Class I` == "GP") %>%          
  filter(Compounds %in% union(                       
    Y2O_sig_diff_metabolites_14_Antral$Compounds,
    Y2O_sig_diff_metabolites_14_Secondary$Compounds
  )) %>%
  select(Compounds, `Precursor (Da)`, `Class I`, CAS) %>%  
  rename(mz = `Precursor (Da)`) %>%
  mutate(mz = as.numeric(mz)) %>%
  # 添加 State 列，判断 log2FC 方向
  mutate(
    State = case_when(
      # 若 Compounds 在 Antral 数据中且 log2FC > 0
      Compounds %in% Y2O_sig_diff_metabolites_14_Antral$Compounds & 
        Y2O_sig_diff_metabolites_14_Antral$log2FC[match(Compounds, Y2O_sig_diff_metabolites_14_Antral$Compounds)] > 0 ~ "up-in-2M-Antral",
      # 若 Compounds 在 Antral 数据中且 log2FC <= 0
      Compounds %in% Y2O_sig_diff_metabolites_14_Antral$Compounds & 
        Y2O_sig_diff_metabolites_14_Antral$log2FC[match(Compounds, Y2O_sig_diff_metabolites_14_Antral$Compounds)] <= 0 ~ "up-in-9M-Antral",
      # 若 Compounds 在 Secondary 数据中且 log2FC > 0
      Compounds %in% Y2O_sig_diff_metabolites_14_Secondary$Compounds & 
        Y2O_sig_diff_metabolites_14_Secondary$log2FC[match(Compounds, Y2O_sig_diff_metabolites_14_Secondary$Compounds)] > 0 ~ "up-in-2M-Secondary",
      # 若 Compounds 在 Secondary 数据中且 log2FC <= 0
      Compounds %in% Y2O_sig_diff_metabolites_14_Secondary$Compounds & 
        Y2O_sig_diff_metabolites_14_Secondary$log2FC[match(Compounds, Y2O_sig_diff_metabolites_14_Secondary$Compounds)] <= 0 ~ "up-in-9M-Secondary",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  # 默认值（理论上不会触发，因前面已筛选）
    )
  )

print(matched_cas_data)

# 4 1,2-Dilinoleoyl-SN-glycero-3-phosphocholine @1,2-二亚油酰磷脂酰胆碱                             782.5674 GP        998-06-1   up-in-2M-Secondary
```

# GSE175836 @mouse oocyte and GC RNA-seq data

![GSE175836.png](/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/code/Image/GSE175836.png)

所用数据源自公开数据GSE175836,关联文献为 Granulosa cell mevalonate pathway abnormalities contribute to oocyte meiotic defects and aneuploidy

这里使用6周龄和10月龄C57BL/6小鼠的卵母细胞和颗粒细胞的SMART-seq数据，对不同卵泡发育阶段进行分析。其中次级卵泡对应原文中的FGO时期，窦卵泡对应GO时期。对甘油磷脂通路的所有基因进行了差异分析，并以火山图形式呈现。

```{r,echo=TRUE}
# 筛选甘油磷脂通路的显著差异基因 -----------------
library(data.table)
library(magrittr)  

# 1. 数据预处理：统一转换为data.table并清理基因名称
combined_data <- as.data.table(combined_data)
mouse_GP <- as.data.table(mouse_GP) %>%
  .[, Gene_Symbol_clean := toupper(trimws(Gene_Symbol))]  # 预清洗基因名

# 2. 核心合并操作（单次管道完成全部流程）
final_result <- combined_data %>%
  # 筛选显著基因
  .[type != "noSig"] %>%
  # 标准化gene列以匹配mouse_GP
  .[, gene_clean := toupper(trimws(gene))] %>%
  # 内连接合并（保留双方共有的基因）
  merge(
    mouse_GP[, .(Gene_Symbol, Gene_Symbol_clean, Description)],
    by.x = "gene_clean",
    by.y = "Gene_Symbol_clean",
    all = FALSE  # 内连接确保只保留匹配项
  ) %>%
  # 后处理
  .[, .(
    # 保留原始combined_data列
    ENSEMBL, baseMean, avg_log2FC, lfcSE, stat, p_val, p_val_adj, 
    gene = Gene_Symbol,  # 使用mouse_GP的正式基因名
    cluster,
    Description         # 来自mouse_GP的描述
  )] %>%
  # 按显著性排序
  .[order(p_val)]

# 3. 验证输出
cat("\n===== 合并结果摘要 =====\n")
cat("保留基因数:", nrow(final_result), 
    "/ 原显著基因数:", nrow(combined_data[type != "noSig"]), "\n")
cat("Top 5最显著基因:\n")
print(head(final_result, 5))
```

```{r,eval=FALSE}
665270 Plb1; 1 2-(((R)-2,3-Dihydroxypropyl)phosphoryloxy)-N,N,N-trimethylethanaminium @甘油磷酸胆碱 258.1108 GP        28319-77-9 up-in-9M-Secondary 

GPC主要通过磷脂酰胆碱（PC）的水解产生，关键酶包括：

1.磷脂酶A2（Phospholipase A2, PLA2）
基因：PLA2G4A（胞质PLA2）、PLA2G1B（分泌型PLA2）等
作用：水解PC的sn-2位脂肪酸，生成 溶血磷脂酰胆碱（LPC）。
2.溶血磷脂酶（Lysophospholipase, LYPLA）
基因：LYPLA1, LYPLA2
作用：水解LPC生成 G3P（甘油-3-磷酸） 和 胆碱，或进一步代谢为GPC。

PLB1(磷脂酶B1)是一种多功能酶，兼具 磷脂酶A2（PLA2） 和 溶血磷脂酶（Lysophospholipase） 活性，可同时水解磷脂（如PC）的 sn-1和sn-2位 脂肪酸，生成 甘油磷酸胆碱（GPC）前体（如溶血磷脂酰胆碱，LPC）和游离脂肪酸。
```

```{r,eval=FALSE}
# 自定义3D函数 OK ------------------
#' 绘制 m/z 特征的 3D 强度曲面图并保存为 HTML
#'
#' @param mse_obj  MSEnternal 对象（如 `o1_f7`, `o2_f8` 等）
#' @param mz_obj   目标 m/z 值（numeric，如 820.5255）
#' @param colorscale 颜色映射（默认 "Viridis"）
#' @param save_plot  是否保存为 HTML 文件（默认 TRUE）
#' @param show_plot  是否显示交互式图表（默认 TRUE）
#'
#' @return 返回 plotly 图形对象（若 `save_plot=TRUE` 会额外保存 HTML）
#' @export
#'
#' @examples
#' # 直接调用示例：
#' plot_mz_3D(o1_f7, 820.5255)
plot_mz_3D <- function(mse_obj, mz_obj, colorscale = "Viridis", save_plot = TRUE, show_plot = TRUE) {
  
  # Load required packages
  if (!requireNamespace("plotly", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("请先安装 plotly 包：install.packages('plotly')")
  }
  library(plotly)
  library(Cardinal)
  
  # 核心计算逻辑
  # 提取指定 m/z 的特征
  mz_3D <- subsetFeatures(mse_obj, mz %in% mz_obj)
  
  # 将强度转换为矩阵并获取像素坐标
  intensity_matrix <- as.matrix(intensity(mz_3D))
  pixel_coords <- pixelData(mz_3D)[, c("x", "y")]
  
  # 计算矩阵的行数和列数
  n_rows <- max(pixel_coords$y) - min(pixel_coords$y) + 1
  n_cols <- max(pixel_coords$x) - min(pixel_coords$x) + 1
  
  # 创建强度矩阵并填充
  intensity <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_rows, ncol = n_cols)
  row_indices <- pixel_coords$y - min(pixel_coords$y) + 1
  col_indices <- pixel_coords$x - min(pixel_coords$x) + 1
  intensity[cbind(row_indices, col_indices)] <- intensity_matrix
  
  # 设置行列名为原始坐标值
  rownames(intensity) <- min(pixel_coords$y):max(pixel_coords$y)
  colnames(intensity) <- min(pixel_coords$x):max(pixel_coords$x)
  
  # 计算 aspectratio 比例
  x_range <- range(pixelData(mz_3D)$x)
  y_range <- range(pixelData(mz_3D)$y)
  x_ratio <- diff(x_range) / max(diff(x_range), diff(y_range))
  y_ratio <- diff(y_range) / max(diff(x_range), diff(y_range))
  
  # 获取原始坐标值
  x_coords <- as.numeric(colnames(intensity))
  y_coords <- as.numeric(rownames(intensity))
  
  # 绘图逻辑
  fig <- plot_ly(
    x = x_coords, 
    y = y_coords, 
    z = intensity, 
    type = "surface"
  ) %>%
    add_surface(
      contours = list(
        z = list(
          show = TRUE, 
          usecolormap = TRUE, 
          highlightcolor = "#ff0000", 
          project = list(z = TRUE)
        )
      ),
      colorbar = list(title = "Intensity"),
      colorscale = colorscale
    ) %>%
    layout(
      scene = list(
        xaxis = list(title = "X", autorange = "reversed"),
        yaxis = list(title = "Y"),
        zaxis = list(title = "Intensity"),
        aspectratio = list(x = x_ratio, y = y_ratio, z = 1)
      )
    )
  
  # 保存与返回 
  if (save_plot) {
    # 自动生成文件名（使用 substitute 获取传入的变量名）
    obj_name <- deparse(substitute(mse_obj))  # 如 "o1_f7"
    file_name <- paste0("3D_intensity_of_", obj_name, "_mz_", mz_obj, ".html")
    htmlwidgets::saveWidget(fig, file = file_name, selfcontained = TRUE)
    message("已保存文件：", file_name)
  }
  
  if (show_plot) {
    print(fig)
  }
  
  invisible(fig)  # 返回图形对象（可通过变量接收）
}

plot_mz_3D(o_2_mse, 885.6683, save_plot = T) # colorscale = "Hot",
```

# Smart-seq
## SMART-seq@DESeq2 @DEG
```{r,echo=TRUE}
# 读取与合并计数文件（直接保留ENSEMBL ID） ------------------
setwd("/home/hsinyinteng/GSE175836_mouse_meiosis/")

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)

# 1. 读取所有.gz文件并合并为长格式
gz_files <- list.files(
    path = "/home/hsinyinteng/GSE175836_mouse_meiosis/data/",
    pattern = "\\.counts\\.txt\\.gz$",
    full.names = TRUE
)

count_long <- rbindlist(
    lapply(gz_files, function(file) {
        dt <- fread(file, header = FALSE, col.names = c("gene_id", "count"))  # 强制统一列名
        dt[, sample := basename(file)]  # 添加样本列
        return(dt)
    }),
    fill = TRUE  # 允许列数不同时填充NA
)

# 2. 检查基因一致性（可选）
if (length(unique(count_long[, .N, by = gene_id]$N)) > 1) {
    warning("不同样本的基因数量不一致！")
}

# 3. 转换为宽格式（基因×样本矩阵）并处理重复基因
count_wide <- dcast(
    count_long[!grepl("^__", gene_id)],
    gene_id ~ sample,  # 行=基因，列=样本名
    value.var = "count",
    fun.aggregate = mean,  # 对重复基因取均值
    na.rm = TRUE          # 忽略NA值
)

# 4. 转换为矩阵并处理缺失值
# 转换为 data.frame 再矩阵化（保留行名）
count_df <- as.data.frame(count_wide)
rownames(count_df) <- count_df$gene_id
count_matrix <- as.matrix(count_df[, -1])

# 验证
head(count_matrix[, 1:3])




# 5. 检查重复基因和NaN
if (any(duplicated(rownames(count_matrix)))) {
    stop("仍有重复基因未被合并！")
}
count_matrix[is.na(count_matrix) | is.nan(count_matrix)] <- 0  # 合并处理NA和NaN

# 6. 四舍五入为整数（DESeq2要求）
count_matrix <- round(count_matrix)

# 输出检查
head(count_matrix[, 1:3])

# 检查零值基因比例
zero_ratio <- rowMeans(count_matrix == 0)
summary(zero_ratio)  # 若大部分基因的零值比例高，需过滤低表达基因



# 样本分组 ----------------
# 样本名
sample_names <- colnames(count_matrix)

# 使用 strsplit() 按第一个 _ 分隔
split_names <- strsplit(sample_names, "_")  

# (1) 年龄分组：第2部分的首字母
age_group <- ifelse(substr(sapply(split_names, `[`, 2), 1, 1) == "Y", "6W", "10M")

# (2) 细胞类型：检查是否含 "GC"
cell_type <- ifelse(grepl("GC", sapply(split_names, `[`, 2)), "GC", "Oocyte")

# (3) 发育阶段：从第2部分提取
phase_group <- sapply(split_names, function(x) {
  code <- x[2]
  if (grepl("FGO", code)) "FGO"
  else if (grepl("GO", code)) "GO"        
  else if (grepl("MIIO", code)) "MIIO"
  else if (grepl("MIO", code)) "MIO"
  else "Unknown"
})

# (4) 唯一ID：组合细胞类型 + 阶段 + 数字编号
cell_id <- paste(
  cell_type, 
  phase_group, 
  gsub("\\D", "", sapply(split_names, `[`, 3)),  # 提取纯数字（如 "1.counts.txt.gz" → "1"）
  sep = "_"
)

# 构建分组数据框
colData <- data.frame(
  Sample = sample_names,
  Age = age_group,
  CellType = cell_type,
  Phase = phase_group,
  CellID = cell_id,
  row.names = sample_names
)

# 查看前5行分组信息
head(colData, 5)

# 分组统计
table(colData$Age, colData$CellType, colData$Phase)


```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
# GO --------------------------
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)

# 1. 数据准备与DESeq2分析（一步完成） 
dds_GO <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_matrix[, colData$Phase == "GO"],
  colData = colData[colData$Phase == "GO", ] %>% 
    mutate(Age = factor(Age, levels = c("6W", "10M"))),
  design = ~ Age
) %>%
  .[rowSums(counts(.) >= 5) >= 3, ] %>%  # 预过滤
  DESeq()

# 2. 结果提取与收缩（管道操作）
res_GO <- lfcShrink(dds_GO, 
                contrast = c("Age", "10M", "6W"), 
                type = "normal",
                quiet = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  # filter(padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1) |>  
  filter(pvalue < 0.05) |>  
  mutate(Group = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, "10M", "6W"))

# 3. 差异统计（即时计算不保存变量）
cat(sprintf("DEGs: Up(10M)=%d, Up(6W)=%d, Total=%d",
            sum(res_GO$log2FoldChange > 0),
            sum(res_GO$log2FoldChange < 0),
            nrow(res_GO)))

# DEGs: Up(10M)=434, Up(6W)=2429, Total=2863

write.csv(res_GO, "GO_phase_DEGs_6W_vs_10M.csv", row.names = TRUE)

# 多组箱线图 -------------
library(tidyverse)

# 定义函数，一次性生成全部比较结果
create_comparisons <- function() {
  list(
    list(data = res_GO, phase = "GO", comp = "10M_vs_6W", groups = c("GO-6W", "GO-10M")),
    list(data = res_FGO, phase = "FGO", comp = "10M_vs_6W", groups = c("FGO-6W", "FGO-10M")),
    list(data = res_Young, phase = "Young", comp = "FGO_vs_GO", groups = c("Young-FGO", "Young-GO")),
    list(data = res_Old, phase = "Old", comp = "FGO_vs_GO", groups = c("Old-FGO", "Old-GO"))
  ) %>% 
    map_dfr(~ {
      data <- .x$data
      tibble(
        Phase = .x$phase,
        compare = .x$comp,
        group = .x$groups,
        up_6W = if (.x$comp == "10M_vs_6W") c(sum(data$log2FoldChange < 0), NA),
        up_10M = if (.x$comp == "10M_vs_6W") c(NA, sum(data$log2FoldChange > 0)),
        up_FGO = if (.x$comp == "FGO_vs_GO") c(sum(data$log2FoldChange > 0), NA),
        up_GO = if (.x$comp == "FGO_vs_GO") c(NA, sum(data$log2FoldChange < 0)),
        Total = nrow(data)
      )
    })
}

library(tidyverse)

# 改进后的绘图代码（添加数量标签）
p_follicle <- create_comparisons() %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("up_"), names_to = "Direction", values_to = "Count", values_drop_na = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Direction = factor(Direction, 
                           levels = c("up_6W", "up_10M", "up_GO", "up_FGO"),
                           labels = c("Up in 6W", "Up in 10M", "Up in GO", "Up in FGO")))

                            "Young-GO","Young-FGO", "Old-GO", "Old-FGO"))
```

```{r,eval=FALSE}
# 14 ovary --------------
library(Cardinal)
spectra_14_ovary <- as.matrix(t(intensity(mouse_14_ovary)))
colnames(spectra_14_ovary) <- mz(mouse_14_ovary)
rownames(spectra_14_ovary) <- pixelData(mouse_14_ovary)$pixel_ID
dim(spectra_14_ovary)

# 1. 移除常数列（可选）
spectra_14_ovary <- spectra_14_ovary[, apply(spectra_14_ovary, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0]
dim(spectra_14_ovary)

# 2. Min-Max归一化
min_vals <- apply(spectra_14_ovary, 2, min, na.rm = TRUE)
max_vals <- apply(spectra_14_ovary, 2, max, na.rm = TRUE)
spectra_scaled <- sweep(sweep(spectra_14_ovary, 2, min_vals, `-`), 2, max_vals - min_vals, `/`)
spectra_scaled_14_ovary <- as.matrix(spectra_scaled)  # 确保为矩阵

# o_1_mse ---------------
library(Cardinal)
spectra_o1 <- as.matrix(t(intensity(o_1_mse)))
colnames(spectra_o1) <- mz(o_1_mse)
rownames(spectra_o1) <- pixelData(o_1_mse)$pixel_ID
dim(spectra_o1)

# 1. 移除常数列（可选）
spectra_o1 <- spectra_o1[, apply(spectra_o1, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0]
dim(spectra_o1)

# 2. Min-Max归一化
min_vals <- apply(spectra_o1, 2, min, na.rm = TRUE)
max_vals <- apply(spectra_o1, 2, max, na.rm = TRUE)
spectra_scaled <- sweep(sweep(spectra_o1, 2, min_vals, `-`), 2, max_vals - min_vals, `/`)
spectra_scaled_o1 <- as.matrix(spectra_scaled)  # 确保为矩阵


# PCA @o_1_mse @Cardinal -----------------
library(Cardinal)
o_1_mse
o_1_pca <- PCA(o_1_mse, ncomp=6)
o_1_pca
image(o_1_pca, smooth="adaptive", enhance="histogram")
plot(o_1_pca, linewidth=2)

# PCA @o_1_mse @手动 -----------------
library(Cardinal)
library(ggplot2)

# 使用已处理的Min-Max标准化数据
spectra_pca <- prcomp(spectra_scaled_o1, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE) 

# 构建绘图数据框
pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = spectra_pca$x[,1],
  PC2 = spectra_pca$x[,2],
  x = pixelData(o_1_mse)$x,
  y = pixelData(o_1_mse)$y,
  pixel_id = pixelData(o_1_mse)$pixel_ID
)

library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# PCA散点图（无网格线）
p1 <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  labs(title = NULL,
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(summary(spectra_pca)$importance[2,1]*100, 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(summary(spectra_pca)$importance[2,2]*100, 1), "%)")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),  # 去除所有网格线
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black")  # 保留边框
  )

# 空间分布图（无网格线 + y轴倒置）
p2 <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x, y, color = PC1)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", 
    midpoint = median(pca_df$PC1)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Spatial Distribution of o_1", 
       x = "X", y = "Y") +
  coord_fixed() +
  # 关键修改：scale_y_reverse倒置y轴
  scale_y_reverse() +  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),  # 去除所有网格线
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# 并排显示（2列布局）
combined_plot <- p1 + p2 + plot_layout(ncol = 2)
print(combined_plot)

# NMF @o_1_mse @Cardinal------------------
o1_nmf <- NMF(o_1_mse, ncomp=6, niter=30)
o1_nmf
image(o1_nmf, smooth="adaptive", enhance="histogram")
plot(o1_nmf, linewidth=2)

# spatial shrunken centroids @o_1_mse @Cardinal------------------
set.seed(2025)
o1_ssc <- spatialShrunkenCentroids(o_1_mse,
	weights="adaptive", r=2, k=6, s=5)
o1_ssc
image(o1_ssc,i=1)
image(o1_ssc, type="class")
plot(o1_ssc, type="statistic", linewidth=2)

# UMAP @o_1_mse @手动 @余弦距离 ------------------
library(reticulate)
umap <- import("umap")
np <- import("numpy")

np$random$seed(2025L)
umap_result <- umap$UMAP(
    # metric = "euclidean",  # 默认值,欧几里得距离
    metric = "cosine",  # 余弦距离
    n_neighbors = 30L,        
    min_dist = 0.05,
    n_components = 2L,
    random_state = 2025L,  # 随机数种子（Random Seed）
    n_jobs = 1L,
    verbose = TRUE
)$fit_transform(spectra_scaled_o1)

# 4. 转换为R格式（优化后的版本）
umap_matrix <- py_to_r(np$array(umap_result, dtype = np$float64))
umap_df <- data.frame(
    UMAP1 = umap_matrix[, 1],
    UMAP2 = umap_matrix[, 2],
    row.names = rownames(spectra_o1)  # 保留样本名
)

set.seed(2024)
kmeans_result <- kmeans(umap_df[, c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")], centers = 10)

umap_df$ID <- pixelData(o_1_mse)$run

umap_df$y <- pixelData(o_1_mse)$y
umap_df$pixel_ID <- pixelData(o_1_mse)$pixel_ID

# 检查 pixel_ID 是否一致
all(pixelData(o_1_mse)$pixel_ID == umap_df$pixel_ID)  # 应该返回 TRUE

# 如果一致，直接赋值
pixelData(o_1_mse)$kmeans_cluster <- umap_df$kmeans_cluster


ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = factor(kmeans_cluster))) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1, alpha = 1) +
  scale_y_reverse() +

library(reticulate)
if (!py_module_available("openTSNE")) {
  stop("请先安装 openTSNE: py_install('openTSNE')")
}

opentsne <- import("openTSNE")
np <- import("numpy")

# 将 R 矩阵转换为 NumPy 数组（假设 spectra_scaled_14_ovary 是归一化后的数据）
spectra_py <- r_to_py(spectra_scaled_14_ovary)

# 设置 openTSNE 参数
set.seed(123)  # 保证可重复性
tsne <- opentsne$TSNE(
  n_components = 2L,          # 降维到 2D
  metric = "cosine",          # 使用余弦距离（openTSNE 支持！）
  perplexity = 30L,           # 推荐值 5-50
  n_iter = 1000L,             # 迭代次数（可减少以加速）
  random_state = 123L,        # 随机种子
  n_jobs = -1L                # 使用所有 CPU 核心（关键加速！）
)

# 拟合并转换数据
tsne_coords_py <- tsne$fit(spectra_py)  # 注意：openTSNE 使用 $fit() 而非 fit_transform()

# 转换回 R 数据框
tsne_coords <- py_to_r(tsne_coords_py)
tsne_df <- as.data.frame(tsne_coords)
colnames(tsne_df) <- c("tSNE1", "tSNE2")

# 输出结果
head(tsne_df)

set.seed(2025)
kmeans_reult <- kmeans(tsne_df[, c("tSNE1", "tSNE2")], centers = 10) 

tsne_df$kmeans_cluster <- as.factor(kmeans_result$cluster)       # K-means 聚类结果
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
# 01 自定义函数 -----------------------
library(Cardinal)

#' 提取特定m/z的特征强度
#' @param obj 对象（Follicle/Stroma/CL）
#' @param mz_target 目标m/z值
#' @return 均值强度
extract_coq10 <- function(obj, mz_target = 885.6683) {
  coq10 <- subsetFeatures(obj, mz %in% mz_target) |>
    summarizeFeatures(c(Mean = "mean"))
  return(featureData(coq10)$Mean)
}

# 初始化结果存储
results <- data.frame()

# 样本列表（o1/o2/o5/o6）
samples <- c("y1", "y2", "y3", "y5", "o1", "o2", "o5", "o6")
tissues <- c("follicles", "stroma", "CL")

# 循环提取数据
for (sample in samples) {
  # 提取当前样本的follicle强度作为基准
  follicle_intensity <- extract_coq10(get(paste0(sample, "_follicles")))
  
  for (tissue in tissues) {
    obj_name <- paste0(sample, "_", tissue)
    if (exists(obj_name)) {
      intensity <- extract_coq10(get(obj_name))
      log2fc <- ifelse(
        tissue == "follicles", 
        0,  # follicle自身log2FC为0
        log2(intensity / follicle_intensity)  # 其他组织与follicle比较
      )
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
        Sample = sample,
        Tissue = tissue,
        Intensity = intensity,
        log2FC = log2fc
      ))
    }
  }
}


# 整理数据格式
results$Tissue <- factor(results$Tissue, levels = c("follicles", "stroma", "CL"))
results$Sample <- factor(results$Sample, levels = samples)

# 查看结果
print(results)
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
mouse_14_ovary2 <- subsetFeatures(mouse_14_ovary, mz %in% unique(mz_selected))

mouse_14_ovary2

# UMAP @余弦距离 ----------------------
library(Cardinal)
spectra_14_ovary2 <- as.matrix(t(intensity(mouse_14_ovary2)))
colnames(spectra_14_ovary2) <- mz(mouse_14_ovary2)
rownames(spectra_14_ovary2) <- pixelData(mouse_14_ovary2)$pixel_ID
dim(spectra_14_ovary2)

# 1. 移除常数列（可选）
spectra_14_ovary2 <- spectra_14_ovary2[, apply(spectra_14_ovary2, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0]
dim(spectra_14_ovary2)

# 2. Min-Max归一化
min_vals <- apply(spectra_14_ovary2, 2, min, na.rm = TRUE)
max_vals <- apply(spectra_14_ovary2, 2, max, na.rm = TRUE)
spectra_scaled2 <- sweep(sweep(spectra_14_ovary2, 2, min_vals, `-`), 2, max_vals - min_vals, `/`)
spectra_scaled2 <- as.matrix(spectra_scaled2)  # 确保为矩阵


# 3. UMAP降维（Python）
library(reticulate)
umap <- import("umap")
np <- import("numpy")

np$random$seed(2025L)
umap_result <- umap$UMAP(
    metric = "euclidean",  # 默认值,欧几里得距离
    # metric = "cosine",  # 余弦距离
    n_neighbors = 30L,        
    min_dist = 0.05,
    n_components = 2L,
    random_state = 2025L,  # 随机数种子（Random Seed）
    n_jobs = 1L,
    verbose = TRUE
)$fit_transform(spectra_scaled2)

# 4. 转换为R格式（优化后的版本）
umap_matrix <- py_to_r(np$array(umap_result, dtype = np$float64))
umap_df <- data.frame(
    UMAP1 = umap_matrix[, 1],
    UMAP2 = umap_matrix[, 2],
    row.names = rownames(spectra_14_ovary2)  # 保留样本名
)


# kmeans -----------------------
set.seed(2024)
kmeans_result <- kmeans(umap_df[, c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")], centers = 10) 

umap_df$kmeans_cluster <- as.factor(kmeans_result$cluster)
umap_df$ID <- pixelData(mouse_14_ovary2)$run
umap_df$x <- pixelData(mouse_14_ovary2)$x
umap_df$y <- pixelData(mouse_14_ovary2)$y
umap_df$pixel_ID <- pixelData(mouse_14_ovary2)$pixel_ID

# 检查 pixel_ID 是否一致
all(pixelData(mouse_14_ovary2)$pixel_ID == umap_df$pixel_ID)  # 应该返回 TRUE

# 如果一致，直接赋值
pixelData(mouse_14_ovary2)$kmeans_cluster <- umap_df$kmeans_cluster

# UMAP使用欧氏距离得到的聚类结果并不如余弦距离好（比如卵泡对应的聚类形状较分散，并非圆形或椭圆形）。这里用 UMAP余弦距离+Kmeans 可能并非最优方案。


# UMAP坐标图 ----------------------
# class(umap_df)
library(ggplot2)
Fig_S3A <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = kmeans_cluster)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.01, alpha = 0.7) +  # 使用点形状
    labs(# title = "UMAP Clustering of All Pixels", 
         x = "UMAP1", 
         y = "UMAP2") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values =  c("1" = "#3C5488",    # 深蓝色
                    "2" = "#00A087",    # 蓝绿色
                    "3" = "#E64B35",    # 红色
                    "4" = "#F39B7F",    # 浅橙色
                    "5" = "#4DBBD5",    # 青色
                    "6" = "#8491B4",    # 灰蓝色
                    "7" = "#91D1C2",    # 浅蓝绿色
                    "8" = "#7E6148",    # 棕色
                    "9" = "#DC0000",    # 深红色
                    "10" = "#B09C85"    # 灰褐色
                    ),
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 8),# 调整图例点大小
                                            ncol=1) # 图例的列数 
                       ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20), 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 18), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16),  
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),  
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),  
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1), 
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    coord_cartesian()  # 设置坐标轴范围

Fig_S3A

ggsave("Fig_S3A_Spatial_Clustering_of_Mouse_Ovaries_in_UMAP_Coordinate.pdf", plot = Fig_S3A, width = 10, height = 6, device = cairo_pdf, family = "Arial")


# 图例放右边，多列展示 --------------------------
ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = x, y = y, color=factor(kmeans_cluster))) +
    geom_point(size = 0.01, alpha = 0.7) +  # 使用点形状

  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +  # 这保证 x 和 y 轴的1单位长度相同
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14, base_family = "Arial") +

    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(3,0,3,0),face = "plain", family = "Arial"),# 分面标签调整为稍小字号
    axis.text = element_blank(),    # 合并xy轴文本设置
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),   # 合并xy轴刻度线
    axis.title = element_blank(),  # 直接隐藏所有轴标题（X & Y）
    plot.title = element_blank(),  # 去掉标题
    panel.grid = element_blank(),  # 去除主要网格线
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),  # 调整图例文本字体大小
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18)  # 调整图例标题字体
    )

# 图例放底部 -----------------
Fig_3B <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = factor(kmeans_cluster))) +
  geom_point(size = 0.01, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_color_manual(
        values =  c("1" = "#3C5488",    # 深蓝色
                    "2" = "#00A087",    # 蓝绿色
                    "3" = "#E64B35",    # 红色
                    "4" = "#F39B7F",    # 浅橙色
                    "5" = "#4DBBD5",    # 青色
                    "6" = "#8491B4",    # 灰蓝色
                    "7" = "#91D1C2",    # 浅蓝绿色
                    "8" = "#7E6148",    # 棕色
                    "9" = "#DC0000",    # 深红色
                    "10" = "#B09C85"    # 灰褐色
                    ),
    name = "Kmeans Cluster",
    guide = guide_legend(
      title.position = "left",      # 标题放在图例顶部"top"
      title.hjust = 0.5,           # 标题居中
      ncol = 13,                    # 3列排列
      byrow = TRUE,                # 按行填充
      override.aes = list(size = 8) # 增大图例点大小
    )
  ) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    legend.justification = "center", 
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.5, 'cm'), # 图例子项水平间距
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),  
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18), 
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 20, 10) # 调整底部边距避免图例被裁剪
  )

Fig_3B

ggsave(
  "Fig_3B_Spatial_Clustering_of_Mouse_Ovaries_in_Original_Coordinate.pdf",
  plot = Fig_3B,
  width = 12,
  height = 4, family = "Arial"
)
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
RenameGenesSeurat_v2 <- function(obj,newnames,gene.use=NULL,de.assay="RNA") {
  print("Run this before integration. It only changes obj@assays$*@counts, @data and @scale.data, @var.features,@reductions$pca@feature.loadings")
  lassays <- Assays(obj)
  assay.use <- obj@reductions$pca@assay.used
  DefaultAssay(obj) <- de.assay
  if (is.null(gene.use)) {
    all_genenames <- rownames(obj)
  }else{
    all_genenames <- gene.use
    obj <- subset(obj,features=gene.use)
  }
  
  order_name <- function(v1,v2,ref){
    v2 <- make.names(v2,unique=T)
    df1 <- data.frame(v1,v2)
    rownames(df1) <- df1$v1
    df1 <- df1[ref,]
    return(df1)
  }
  
  df1 <- order_name(v1=all_genenames,v2=newnames,ref=rownames(obj))
  all_genenames <- df1$v1
  newnames <- df1$v2
  
  if ('SCT' %in% lassays) {
    if ('SCTModel.list' %in%  slotNames(obj@assays$SCT)) {
      obj@assays$SCT@SCTModel.list$model1@feature.attributes <- obj@assays$SCT@SCTModel.list$model1@feature.attributes[all_genenames,]
      rownames(obj@assays$SCT@SCTModel.list$model1@feature.attributes) <- newnames
    }
  }
  change_assay <- function(a1=de.assay,obj,newnames=NULL,all_genenames=NULL){
    RNA <- obj@assays[a1][[1]]
    if (nrow(RNA) == length(newnames)) {
      if (length(RNA@counts)) RNA@counts@Dimnames[[1]]            <- newnames
      if (length(RNA@data)) RNA@data@Dimnames[[1]]                <- newnames
      if (length(RNA@var.features)) {
        df1 <- order_name(v1=all_genenames,v2=newnames,ref=RNA@var.features)
        all_genenames1 <- df1$v1
        newnames1 <- df1$v2
        RNA@var.features            <- newnames1
      }
      if (length(RNA@scale.data)){
        df1 <- order_name(v1=all_genenames,v2=newnames,ref=rownames(RNA@scale.data))
        all_genenames1 <- df1$v1
        newnames1 <- df1$v2
        rownames(RNA@scale.data)    <- newnames1
      }
      
    } else {"Unequal gene sets: nrow(RNA) != nrow(newnames)"}
    obj@assays[a1][[1]] <- RNA
    return(obj)
  }
  
  for (a in lassays) {
    DefaultAssay(obj) <- a
    df1 <- order_name(v1=all_genenames,v2=newnames,ref=rownames(obj))
    all_genenames1 <- df1$v1
    newnames1 <- df1$v2
    obj <- change_assay(obj=obj,a1=a,newnames=newnames1,all_genenames=all_genenames1)
  }
  
  hvg <- VariableFeatures(obj,assay=assay.use)
  if (length(obj@reductions$pca)){
    df1 <- order_name(v1=all_genenames,v2=newnames,ref=hvg)
    all_genenames1 <- df1$v1
    newnames1 <- df1$v2
    rownames(obj@reductions$pca@feature.loadings) <- newnames1
  }
  
  return(obj)
}
```

```{r,echo=TRUE,fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# 设置工作路径
setwd("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/ICR_mouse_ovary_spermidine")

# 加载必要库
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# 1. 数据加载与预处理
ICR_mouse_ovary <- read_excel("43587_2023_498_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx")

# 2. 数据清洗与统计
plot_data <- ICR_mouse_ovary %>%
  # 筛选 State 为 Up 或 Down 的行
  filter(State %in% c("Up", "Down")) %>%
  # 选择目标列并重命名
  select(
    HMDBID = "HMDB ID",
    KEGGID = "KEGG ID",
    Name,
    Class,
    State
  ) %>%
  # 处理缺失值
  mutate(
    Class = ifelse(is.na(Class), "Unclassified", Class)
  ) %>%
  # 按分类统计
  group_by(Class) %>%
  summarise(Count = n()) %>%
  # 计算比例和标签
  mutate(
    Percentage = round(Count / sum(Count) * 100, 1),
    LegendLabel = sprintf("%s (n=%d, %.1f%%)", Class, Count, Percentage)
  ) %>%
  # 按数量降序排列
  arrange(desc(Count)) %>%
  # 固定因子顺序
  mutate(Class = factor(Class, levels = Class))

# 3. 自定义颜色（40种高区分度颜色）
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
# 加载数据 -------------------
setwd("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/ICR_mouse_ovary_spermidine")

library(readxl)
ICR_mouse_ovary <- read_excel("43587_2023_498_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx")

# PCA ------------------------
# 加载必要的包
library(tidyverse)
library(FactoMineR)

# 数据预处理
sample_cols <- grep("young-|Aged-", colnames(ICR_mouse_ovary), value = TRUE)

expr_matrix <- ICR_mouse_ovary %>% 
  select(all_of(sample_cols)) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  t()

# 添加分组信息
metadata <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(expr_matrix),
  Group = ifelse(grepl("young", rownames(expr_matrix)), "Young", "Aged"),
  row.names = rownames(expr_matrix)
)

# 数据标准化
expr_matrix_scaled <- scale(log2(expr_matrix + 1))

# PCA分析
pca_result <- PCA(expr_matrix_scaled, scale.unit = TRUE, graph = FALSE)

# 获取PCA坐标和解释百分比
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$ind$coord[, 1:2])
colnames(pca_scores) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
pca_scores$Group <- metadata$Group
pca_scores$Sample <- rownames(pca_scores)

# 获取方差解释百分比
pc1_var <- round(pca_result$eig[1, 2], 1)
pc2_var <- round(pca_result$eig[2, 2], 1)

# 用ggplot2绘制PCA图
ICR_pca <- ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 5, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.95, linetype = 2, size = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#FC4E07", "#00AFBB")) +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_var, "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_var, "%)"),
       title = "ICR Mouse Ovary Metabolites",
       color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "bold", family = "sans"), # Set valid font
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, family = "sans", face = "bold"), # Bold axis titles
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16, family = "sans"),  
    legend.position = "top",  
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16), # Remove invalid font
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, family = "sans"),  
    panel.grid = element_blank(),  
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)  
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = 0)))

print(ICR_pca)

ggsave(
    plot = ICR_pca,
    filename = "Fig-1A_PCA_of_ICR_Mouse_Ovary.pdf",
    width = 6,
    height = 6,
    device = "pdf"
)
```

## Fig-1F OK
```{r,echo=TRUE}
library(dplyr)
setwd("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/ICR_mouse_ovary_spermidine")

library(readxl)
ICR_mouse_ovary <- read_excel("43587_2023_498_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx")

# # 目标代谢物列表
# targets <- c("Spermidine", "Β-alanine", "Uracil", "5,6-dihydrouracil", 
#              "Υ-aminobutyric acid (gaba)", "B-ala-lys", "Pantothenic acid", "3-ureidopropionate")
# 
# # 快速检查（返回逻辑向量）
# targets %in% ICR_mouse_ovary$Name
# 
# # 直接输出结果（TRUE/FALSE对应是否存在）
# data.frame(Metabolite = targets, Exists = targets %in% ICR_mouse_ovary$Name)

ICR_filtered <- ICR_mouse_ovary %>%
  filter(!is.na(Class)) %>%
  select(Name, starts_with("young-"), starts_with("Aged-")) %>%
  filter(Name %in% c("Spermidine", "Β-alanine", "Uracil", "5,6-dihydrouracil", 
             "Υ-aminobutyric acid (gaba)", "B-ala-lys", "Pantothenic acid", "3-ureidopropionate")) %>%     # 先筛选不规范名称
  mutate(Name = case_when(            # 再用 case_when 修正名称
    Name == "Β-alanine" ~ "β-Alanine",
    Name == "5,6-dihydrouracil" ~ "5,6-Dihydrouracil",
    Name == "Υ-aminobutyric acid (gaba)" ~ "γ-Aminobutyric acid",
    Name == "B-ala-lys" ~ "β-Ala-Lys",
    Name == "3-ureidopropionate" ~ "3-Ureidopropionate",
    TRUE ~ Name  # 避免其他名称被丢弃
  ))


# 2. 行名设置为代谢物名称，列名为样本
heatmap_data <- ICR_filtered %>% 
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Name") %>% 
  as.matrix()

# 3. Z-score 归一化（按行归一化，即每个代谢物在样本间的表达值标准化）
heatmap_data_scaled <- t(scale(t(heatmap_data)))  

# 4. 样本排序：Young 在前，Aged 在后
sample_order <- c(grep("^young-", colnames(heatmap_data), value = TRUE),
                  grep("^Aged-", colnames(heatmap_data), value = TRUE))
heatmap_data_scaled <- heatmap_data_scaled[, sample_order]

# 5. 定义颜色
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  breaks = c(-2, 0, 2),  # Z-score 范围
  colors = c("darkgreen", "white", "orange")  # 低中高分别用蓝-白-红
)

# 6. 绘制热图
Fig_1F <- Heatmap(
  heatmap_data_scaled,               # 归一化后的数据
  name = "Z-score",                  # 颜色栏名称
  col = col_fun,                     # 定义颜色映射
  row_names_side = "left",           # 代谢物名称在左侧  
  column_names_side = "bottom",      # 样本名称在下侧
  cluster_rows = T,              # 不聚类代谢物
  cluster_columns = FALSE,           # 不聚类样本
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10), # 行名字体大小
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),  # 列名字体大小
  show_row_dend = FALSE,             # 不显示行聚类树
  show_column_dend = FALSE           # 不显示列聚类树
)

draw(Fig_1F) 

# 自动处理 Unicode 字符（如 α、β）
cairo_pdf("Fig-1F_Heatmap.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
draw(Fig_1F)
dev.off()








```

## Fig-1H OK
```{r,echo=TRUE}
library(dplyr)
setwd("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/ICR_mouse_ovary_spermidine")

library(readxl)
ICR_mouse_ovary <- read_excel("43587_2023_498_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx") 

retained_columns <- c("Fold Change", "pvalue", "qvalue", "VIP", "Name", "State",
                     grep("^young-|^Aged-|^QC_", colnames(ICR_mouse_ovary), value = TRUE))

ICR_Spermidine <- ICR_mouse_ovary %>%
  filter(Name %in% c("Spermidine")) %>%
  select(all_of(retained_columns)) 


library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(ggsignif)  # 用于添加显著性标记

# 1. 提取数据并转换为长格式
data_long <- ICR_Spermidine %>%
  select(starts_with("young-"), starts_with("Aged-")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = ifelse(grepl("^young", Sample), "Young", "Aged")
  )

# 2. 计算组均值和标准差（以Young组为基准）
young_mean <- mean(data_long$Value[data_long$Group == "Young"])
summary_data <- data_long %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Value),
    SD = sd(Value),
    Relative_Mean = (Mean / young_mean) * 100,
    Relative_SD = (SD / young_mean) * 100
  )

# 转换为因子并设置顺序
summary_data$Group <- factor(summary_data$Group, levels = c("Young", "Aged"))
data_long$Group <- factor(data_long$Group, levels = c("Young", "Aged"))

# 3. 计算T检验结果
t_test <- t.test(Value ~ Group, data = data_long)
p_value <- t_test$p.value
signif_label <- ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "***",
                      ifelse(p_value < 0.01, "**",
                            ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "*", "ns")))

# 4. 绘制图形（柱状图 + 散点 + 误差线 + 显著性）
Fig_1H <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = Group)) +
  # 柱状图 (仅边框，无填充)
  geom_bar(
    aes(y = Relative_Mean, color = Group), 
    stat = "identity", 
    width = 0.6, 
    fill = NA,
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  # 个体散点
  geom_jitter(
    data = data_long, 
    aes(y = (Value / young_mean) * 100, color = Group),
    width = 0.15, 
    size = 3, 
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  # 误差线
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Relative_Mean - Relative_SD, ymax = Relative_Mean + Relative_SD),
    width = 0.4, 
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  # 显著性标记 (关键修复: 确保x和y映射完整)
  geom_signif(
    aes(y = (Value / young_mean) * 100, x = Group),  # 提供y的映射
    data = data_long,                                # 明确数据源
    comparisons = list(c("Young", "Aged")),
    annotations = signif_label,
    y_position = max((data_long$Value / young_mean) * 100) * 1.2,
    tip_length = 0.01,
    color = "black",                                 # 线条颜色
    textsize = 12,                                     # 星号大小
    manual = FALSE
  ) +
  # 颜色方案
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Young" = "blue", "Aged" = "#E41A1C")) +
  # Y轴从0开始
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)),
    limits = c(0, NA)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Spermidine",
    y = "Relative Level (%)",
    x = ""
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 20),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

Fig_1H

# 5. 保存图形
ggsave("Fig-1H_Spermidine_Barplot.pdf", Fig_1H, width = 5, height = 6, dpi = 300)


```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
# 热图 @所有代谢物 --------------------------
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)

# 提取代谢物丰度数据（假设实际数值在"young-1"到"Aged-5"列中）
expression_data <- ICR_mouse_ovary %>% 
  select(`Metabolite ID`, matches("young|Aged")) %>%  # 选择代谢物和样本列
  column_to_rownames("Metabolite ID") %>%            # 将代谢物ID设为行名
  as.matrix()

# 创建分组注释（根据列名判断）
sample_groups <- data.frame(
  Group = ifelse(grepl("young", colnames(expression_data)), "Young", "Aged"),
  row.names = colnames(expression_data)
)


pheatmap(
  mat = expression_data,
  scale = "row",          # 按行标准化（Z-score）
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),  # 颜色梯度
  cluster_rows = TRUE,    # 对代谢物聚类
  cluster_cols = TRUE,    # 对样本聚类
  show_rownames = FALSE,  # 不显示所有代谢物名称（太多）
  show_colnames = TRUE,   # 显示样本名称
  annotation_col = sample_groups,  # 添加分组注释
  annotation_colors = list(Group = c(Young = "#00AFBB", Aged = "#FC4E07")),  # 分组颜色
  main = "Heatmap of Mouse Ovary Metabolites (Young vs Aged)",
  fontsize_col = 8,       # 样本名称字体大小
  border_color = NA       # 去除单元格边框线
)

# 热图 @所有代谢物 ---------------------
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(dplyr)

# 数据准备与标准化
expr_matrix <- ICR_mouse_ovary %>% 
  select(`Metabolite ID`, matches("young-|Aged-")) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Metabolite ID") %>% 
  as.matrix()

expr_zscore <- t(scale(t(expr_matrix)))

# 设定样本顺序和分组
sample_order <- c(paste0("young-", 1:5), paste0("Aged-", 1:5))
expr_zscore_ordered <- expr_zscore[, sample_order]

sample_groups <- data.frame(
  Group = factor(ifelse(grepl("young", sample_order), "Young", "Aged"), 
                 levels = c("Young", "Aged")),
  row.names = sample_order
)

# 配色方案
group_colors <- c("Young" = "#1F78B4", "Aged" = "#E31A1C")
zscore_colors <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#4DAF4A", "white", "#FF7F00"))

# 热图绘制
ht <- Heatmap(
  expr_zscore_ordered,
  col = zscore_colors,
  name = "Z-score",
  
  # 行列设置
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  
  # 聚类设置
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  
  # 注释与分割
  top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
    Group = sample_groups$Group,
    col = list(Group = group_colors),
    annotation_name_side = "left"
  ),
  column_split = sample_groups$Group,
  
  # 图例设置
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_position = "leftcenter-rot",
    legend_width = unit(4, "cm")
  )
)

# 输出图形
draw(ht, padding = unit(c(2, 10, 2, 2), "mm"))



# 热图 @ 1018 差异代谢物 @q_value < 0.05 & VIP >1 ---------------
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(dplyr)

# 1. 筛选差异代谢物（DEMs）
DEMs <- ICR_mouse_ovary %>% 
  filter(qvalue < 0.05 & VIP > 1) %>%
  arrange(qvalue)  # 按显著性排序

# 2. 提取表达矩阵（跳过QC样本）
expr_matrix <- DEMs %>%
  select(`Metabolite ID`, matches("young-|Aged-")) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Metabolite ID") %>% 
  as.matrix()

# 3. Z-score标准化（按行）
expr_zscore <- t(scale(t(expr_matrix)))

# 4. 设定样本顺序和分组
sample_order <- c(paste0("young-", 1:5), paste0("Aged-", 1:5))
expr_zscore_ordered <- expr_zscore[, sample_order]

# 5. 分组颜色设置
group_colors <- c("Young" = "#1F78B4", "Aged" = "#E31A1C")
zscore_colors <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#4DAF4A", "white", "#FF7F00"))

# 6. 绘制核心热图
ht <- Heatmap(
  expr_zscore_ordered,
  name = "Z-score",
  col = zscore_colors,
  
  # 行列设置
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),  # 调大行名字体
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  show_row_names = ifelse(nrow(DEMs) <= 50, TRUE, FALSE),  # 自动决定是否显示行名
  
  # 聚类设置
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,  # 禁止列聚类以保持分组顺序
  
  # 分组注释
  top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
    Group = factor(ifelse(grepl("young", sample_order), "Young", "Aged")),
    col = list(Group = group_colors),
    simple_anno_size = unit(0.4, "cm")  # 缩小注释条高度
  ),
  
  # 分组分割线
  column_split = factor(ifelse(grepl("young", sample_order), "Young", "Aged"), 
                        levels = c("Young", "Aged")),
  
  # 图例设置
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_position = "leftcenter-rot",
    legend_width = unit(3, "cm")
  )
)

# 7. 输出图形（根据需要调整边距）
draw(ht, padding = unit(c(2, 8, 2, 2), "mm"))

# 8. 打印筛选结果摘要
message(paste("筛选结果：共", nrow(DEMs), "个差异代谢物"))
head(DEMs[, c("Metabolite ID", "Name", "VIP", "qvalue")], 10)  # 显示前10个


# 火山图 -----------
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)

# 0. 计算各组差异代谢物数量
DEM_counts <- ICR_mouse_ovary %>%
  mutate(
    DEM_type = case_when(
      qvalue < 0.05 & VIP > 1 & `Fold Change` > 1 ~ "Up-regulated",
      qvalue < 0.05 & VIP > 1 & `Fold Change` < 1 ~ "Down-regulated",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  ) %>% 
  filter(DEM_type != "Not significant") %>% 
  group_by(DEM_type) %>% 
  tally() %>% 
  mutate(
    legend_label = paste0(DEM_type, " (n=", n, ")")  # 创建带数量的标签
  )

# 1. 准备火山图数据
volcano_data <- ICR_mouse_ovary %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_q = -log10(qvalue),
    DEM_type = case_when(
      qvalue < 0.05 & VIP > 1 & `Fold Change` > 1 ~ DEM_counts$legend_label[DEM_counts$DEM_type == "Up-regulated"],
      qvalue < 0.05 & VIP > 1 & `Fold Change` < 1 ~ DEM_counts$legend_label[DEM_counts$DEM_type == "Down-regulated"],
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    ),
    is_label = ifelse(DEM_type != "Not significant" & 
                      rank(qvalue) <= 20, TRUE, FALSE)
  )

# 2. 绘制火山图
p <- ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = log2(`Fold Change`), 
                              y = neg_log10_q,
                              color = DEM_type)) +  # 移除size映射
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1) +  # 固定点大小
  
  # 3. 颜色映射（包含数量）
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,  # 移除图例标题
    values = c(
      setNames("#E41A1C", DEM_counts$legend_label[DEM_counts$DEM_type == "Up-regulated"]),
      setNames("#377EB8", DEM_counts$legend_label[DEM_counts$DEM_type == "Down-regulated"]),
      "Not significant" = "grey60"
    ),
    breaks = DEM_counts$legend_label  # 仅显示差异代谢物图例
  ) +
  
  # 4. 显著性阈值线
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-log2(1.2), log2(1.2)), 
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
  
  # 5. 标记显著代谢物（优化标签位置）
  # ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
  #   data = subset(volcano_data, is_label),
  #   aes(label = Name),
  #   size = 3.5,
  #   color = "black",
  #   max.overlaps = 30,
  #   min.segment.length = 0.2,
  #   segment.color = "grey50",
  #   seed = 123  # 保证可重复性
  # ) +
  
  # 6. 坐标轴和主题美化
  labs(
    x = expression(log[2]("Fold Change")),
    y = expression(-log[10]("q-value")),
    title = "Volcano Plot of Differential Metabolites"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",  # 图例放顶部节省空间
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.3, 'cm'),  # 图例项间距
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )

# 7. 显示图形
print(p)

# 8. 控制台输出统计
message("\n差异代谢物统计（已整合到图例中）：")
print(DEM_counts[, c("DEM_type", "n")])
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
  filter(VIP > 1) %>%                      # 筛选 VIP > 1 的变量
  mutate(log2FC = log2(`Fold Change`)) %>%   # 【关键】计算 log2(Fold Change)
  filter(abs(log2FC) > 0.5) %>%            # 筛选 |log2FC| > 0.5
  select(all_of(retained_columns))         # 选择需要的列


Down <- ICR_mouse_ovary %>%
  filter(State %in% c("Down")) %>%
  filter(qvalue < 0.05) %>%                # 筛选 qvalue < 0.05 的显著差异
  filter(VIP > 1) %>%                      # 筛选 VIP > 1 的变量
  mutate(log2FC = log2(`Fold Change`)) %>%   # 【关键】计算 log2(Fold Change)
  filter(abs(log2FC) > 0.5)



# 火山图 ----------------
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# 1. 计算 log2FC 并过滤无效值（避免 log2(0)）
ICR_filtered$log2FC <- log2(ICR_filtered$`Fold Change`)
ICR_filtered <- subset(ICR_filtered, is.finite(log2FC))  # 移除 Inf/-Inf 值

# 2. 定义差异代谢物状态（基于 qvalue < 0.05, VIP > 1 且 |log2FC| > 1）
ICR_filtered$State_new <- "Not significant"
ICR_filtered$State_new[ICR_filtered$qvalue < 0.05 & 
                       ICR_filtered$VIP > 1 & 
                       ICR_filtered$log2FC > 0.5] <- "Up"
ICR_filtered$State_new[ICR_filtered$qvalue < 0.05 & 
                       ICR_filtered$VIP > 1 & 
                       ICR_filtered$log2FC < -0.5] <- "Down"

# 3. 统计上下调代谢物数量
up_count <- sum(ICR_filtered$State_new == "Up", na.rm = TRUE)
down_count <- sum(ICR_filtered$State_new == "Down", na.rm = TRUE)

# 4. 绘制火山图
volcano_plot <- ggplot(ICR_filtered, aes(x = log2FC, 
                                        y = -log10(qvalue), 
                                        color = State_new)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("Up" = "red", "Down" = "blue", "Not significant" = "grey60"),
    # 确保 labels 顺序和 values 顺序一致！⚠️ 按 "Up", "Down", "Not significant" 排列
    labels = c(
      paste0("Up (", up_count, ")"),
      paste0("Down (", down_count, ")"),
      "Not significant"
    ),
    # 强制指定图例顺序（按 factor 水平）
    breaks = c("Up", "Down", "Not significant")
  ) +
  # 显著性阈值线
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Aged vs young",
    x = expression(log[2]("Fold Change")),
    y = expression(-log[10]("q-value"))
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(ICR_filtered, State_new %in% c("Up", "Down")),
    aes(label = Name),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 20,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    show.legend = FALSE
  )

print(volcano_plot)


# 输出统计结果
cat(
  "----------------------------------\n",
  "Differential metabolites summary:\n",
  "----------------------------------\n",
  "Up-regulated (log2FC > 0.5):      ", up_count, "\n",
  "Down-regulated (log2FC < -0.5):   ", down_count, "\n",
  "Total significant:              ", up_count + down_count, "\n"
)
```

# HE Follicle Count @ref m/z=760.5848
```{r,echo=TRUE,fig.width=8,fig.height=6}
# install.packages("ggsignif")  # 如果未安装
library(ggsignif)             # 加载包

# 创建数据框
data <- data.frame(
  Age = rep(c("2M", "9M"), each = 7),
  Follicle_Count = c(22, 19, 15, 18, 17, 16, 12,  # 2M
                     18, 10, 4, 21, 11, 9, 8)      # 9M
)

library(dplyr)

summary_data <- data %>%
  group_by(Age) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Follicle_Count),
    SEM = sd(Follicle_Count) / sqrt(n())
  )

t_test <- t.test(Follicle_Count ~ Age, data = data, var.equal = TRUE)
p_value <- t_test$p.value
p_value_rounded <- round(p_value, 3)  # 保留3位小数

library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)

plot <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = Age, y = Mean, fill = Age)) +
  # 柱状图
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  
  # 误差线
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Mean - SEM, ymax = Mean + SEM), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black") +
  
  # 散点（尺寸加大）
  geom_jitter(data = data, aes(y = Follicle_Count), width = 0.1, color = "black", alpha = 0.6, size = 3) +
  
  # 颜色填充
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("2M" = "skyblue", "9M" = "salmon")) +
  
  # 显著性标记（p值）
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("2M", "9M")),
    annotations = ifelse(
      p_value_rounded < 0.001,
      "p < 0.001",
      paste0("p = ", p_value_rounded)
    ),
    y_position = max(summary_data$Mean) + 3,
    vjust = -0.2,
    tip_length = 0.01,  # 调整显著性线头长度
    textsize = 4        # p值字体大小
  ) +
  
  # 标题和坐标轴标签
  labs(
    title = "Follicle Counts of Mouse Ovary (2M vs 9M)",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Follicle Counts"
  ) +
  
  # 主题调整
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),  # 坐标轴标签字体大小
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),   # 坐标轴刻度字体大小
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(plot)

ggsave("Follicle_Count_Comparison.png", plot, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)


```
