```{r,echo=TRUE}
# 自定义函数 --------------
library(readxl)
library(Cardinal)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

# load("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/Intensity_with_RMS_normalization_data.rda")

mz_comparison_of_whole_ovary <- function(Intensity_Data_of_14_Ovaries, mz_target) {
  # 1. 提取目标mz的数据
  target_data <- Intensity_Data_of_14_Ovaries %>%
    filter(mz == as.character(mz_target)) %>%
    select(-mz) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = everything(),
      names_to = "group",
      values_to = "intensity"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      age_group = ifelse(grepl("^y", group), "2M", "9M")
    )
  
  # 2. 执行t检验（方差齐性）
  t_test_result <- t.test(
    intensity ~ age_group,
    data = target_data,
    var.equal = TRUE
  )
  
  # 3. 格式化p值
  p_value <- format.pval(t_test_result$p.value, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)
  p_label <- paste("p =", p_value)
  
  # 4. 绘图
  plot <- ggplot(target_data, aes(x = age_group, y = intensity, fill = age_group)) +
    stat_summary(
      fun = mean, geom = "bar", width = 0.5,
      color = "black", alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      fun.data = mean_sdl, geom = "errorbar",
      width = 0.2, color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      size = 3, shape = 21, color = "black",
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0)
    ) +
    geom_signif(
      comparisons = list(c("2M", "9M")),
      annotations = p_label,
      y_position = max(target_data$intensity) * 1.15,
      tip_length = 0,
      textsize = 4,
      vjust = -0.5
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = c("2M", "9M")) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("m/z =", mz_target),
      x = "Age",
      y = "Relative Intensity"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("2M" = "#4E84C4", "9M" = "#D16103")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 20),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm")
    ) +
  # 限制y轴范围（确保p值显示完整）
  ylim(NA, max(target_data$intensity) * 1.25)
  
  # 返回图形和t检验结果（可选）
  return(list(plot = plot, t_test_result = t_test_result))
}

# 调用函数分析 mz=184.0738

  mz_target = "184.0738"
)

# 显示图形
```

# PC代偿性合成 @卵巢衰老早期
```{r,eval=FALSE}
# 1.PEMT途径 @磷脂酰乙醇胺甲基转移酶 ----------------------
PE → MMPE → DMPE → PC
均由PEMT酶催化

--------------------------------------------------------
缩写	名称	              结构	    命名规则
--------------------------------------------------------
PE	  磷脂酰乙醇胺	      –NH₂	    PE(FA1/FA2)
MMPE	单甲基磷脂酰乙醇胺	–NHCH₃	  PE-NMe(FA1/FA2)
DMPE	二甲基磷脂酰乙醇胺	–N(CH₃)₂	PE-NMe₂(FA1/FA2)
PC	  磷脂酰胆碱	        –N⁺(CH₃)₃	PC(FA1/FA2)
--------------------------------------------------------

# 2. CDP-胆碱途径（Kennedy途径） ------------------

胆碱 → CHKA → 磷酸胆碱 → PCYT1A → CDP-胆碱 → CHPT1 → PC

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
酶	                              功能	
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
胆碱激酶（CHKA/CHKB）	            催化胆碱→磷酸胆碱（ATP依赖）	
CTP:磷酸胆碱胞苷转移酶（PCYT1A）	合成CDP-胆碱（CTP + 磷酸胆碱→CDP-胆碱 + PPi）	
胆碱磷酸转移酶（CHPT1）	          催化CDP-胆碱 + DAG→PC（最后一步）
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  
```


## PEMT途径 @磷脂酰乙醇胺甲基转移酶
```{r,echo=TRUE}
# PEMT: phosphatidylethanolamine N-methyltransferase --------------

# 磷脂酰乙醇胺（PE）经三步甲基化生成磷脂酰胆碱（PC）的整个过程均由PEMT（磷脂酰乙醇胺N-甲基转移酶）催化完成。
# 
# PEMT催化PE→PC的全过程
# PEMT通过三步连续的甲基化反应，依次将PE的乙醇胺头部甲基化，最终形成PC：
# 
# 第一步：PE → MMPE（单甲基磷脂酰乙醇胺）
# 甲基化位点：乙醇胺的伯胺基（-NH₂ → -NH-CH₃）。
# 第二步：MMPE → DMPE（二甲基磷脂酰乙醇胺）
# 甲基化位点：仲胺基（-NH-CH₃ → -N(CH₃)₂）。
# 第三步：DMPE → PC（磷脂酰胆碱）
# 甲基化位点：叔胺基（-N(CH₃)₂ → -N⁺(CH₃)₃）。
# 共同特点：
# 
# 所有步骤均由同一PEMT酶催化，依赖S-腺苷甲硫氨酸（SAM）作为甲基供体。
# 三步反应的催化效率不同：第三步（DMPE→PC）速率通常最慢，可能导致中间产物（MMPE/DMPE）积累（尤其在PC需求升高时）。

# 1.表面上皮（Ovarian surface epithelium, OSE）：
# 覆盖卵巢外表面的单层立方或扁平上皮细胞，起源于胚胎期的体腔上皮（间皮）。
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
mouse_ovary@meta.data$cluster.names <- gsub(
  pattern = " [A-Z]$",  # 匹配末尾的空格 + 大写字母（A/B/C...）
  replacement = "",     # 替换为无（即去掉A/B/C）
  x = mouse_ovary@meta.data$cluster.names
)

unique(mouse_ovary@meta.data$cluster.names)

new_order <- c("Oocytes", "Luteal", "Theca",
               "Granulosa", "Stroma", "Endothelium", "Epithelium",
               "Phagocytes", "B-Lymphocytes","T-Lymphocytes")

mouse_ovary@meta.data$cluster.names <- factor(mouse_ovary@meta.data$cluster.names, levels = new_order)
table(mouse_ovary@meta.data$cluster.names)

mouse_ovary@meta.data$age <- factor(mouse_ovary@meta.data$age, levels = c("YOUNG", "OLD"))
table(mouse_ovary@meta.data$age)


DotPlot(mouse_ovary, 
        cols = c("#00A087", "#3C5488", "#7E6148"),
        features=c("Chka", "Chkb", "Pcyt1a", "Chpt1"),
        group.by = "cluster.names",
        split.by = "age") +
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(title = "C57BL/6 Mouse Ovary: GSE232309") +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) 

mouse_GC <- subset(mouse_ovary, cluster.names == "Granulosa")
mouse_Theca <- subset(mouse_ovary, cluster.names == "Theca")
mouse_Luteal <- subset(mouse_ovary, cluster.names == "Luteal")
mouse_Epithelium <- subset(mouse_ovary, cluster.names == "Epithelium")


DotPlot(mouse_GC, 
        features=c("Chka", "Chkb", "Pcyt1a", "Chpt1", "Amh"),
        group.by = "age") +
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(title = "C57BL/6 Mouse Ovary GC: GSE232309") +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) 

VlnPlot(mouse_GC, 
        features=c("Chka", "Chkb", "Pcyt1a", "Chpt1"),
        stack = T, flip = T, group.by = "age") + 
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(title = "C57BL/6 Mouse Ovary GC: GSE232309") +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) 

DotPlot(mouse_Theca, 
        features=c("Chka", "Chkb", "Pcyt1a", "Chpt1"),
        group.by = "age") + 
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(title = "C57BL/6 Mouse Ovary Theca: GSE232309") +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) 

DotPlot(mouse_Luteal, 
        features=c("Chka", "Chkb", "Pcyt1a", "Chpt1"),
        group.by = "age") + 
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(title = "C57BL/6 Mouse Ovary Luteal: GSE232309") +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) 

DotPlot(mouse_Epithelium, 
        features=c("Chka", "Chkb", "Pcyt1a", "Chpt1"),
        group.by = "age") + 
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(title = "C57BL/6 Mouse Ovary Epithelium: GSE232309") +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) 


# Highly expressed in theca, granulosa and epithelium cells(上皮细胞).
# PS: 内皮细胞（Endothelial cells）
# Only up regulated in aged-GC, but not in theca, luteal and epithelium.


# 在卵巢中，上皮细胞主要指：
# 1.表面上皮（Ovarian surface epithelium, OSE）：
# 覆盖卵巢外表面的单层立方或扁平上皮细胞，起源于胚胎期的体腔上皮（间皮）。
# 2.卵泡上皮细胞：
# 如颗粒细胞（Granulosa cells）和卵泡膜细胞（Theca cells），它们围绕卵母细胞形成功能单元。
# 
# 内皮细胞（Endothelial cells）: 存在于血管网络（如卵泡膜血管层）或卵巢间质血管中。
```

# ZP and TZP
```{r,echo=TRUE}
# ZP蛋白相关编码基因： ZP1, ZP2, ZP3, ZP4
# TZP相关编码基因：Gjc1（连接蛋白45）, Gja1（Connexin 43）和Gja4（Connexin 37）

# GJC1（Connexin 45）、GJA1（Connexin 43）和 GJA4（Connexin 37） 是 间隙连接蛋白（Connexins, Cx） 的重要成员，主要在 卵母细胞-卵丘细胞（Oocyte-Cumulus Complex, OCC）通讯 中发挥作用，而 TZP（Transient Zona Pellucida） 是受精后透明带（ZP）修饰的产物（主要是ZP2裂解）。
# TZP（ZP2裂解）的形成主要由卵母细胞内Ovastacin介导
# ASTL - astacin like metalloendopeptidase

# Ovastacin是一种皮质颗粒蛋白酶，可裂解透明带中的ZP2以防止多精
# ovastacin由单拷贝Astl基因编码，是金属内切蛋白酶astacin家族的卵母细胞特异性成员

# Human Ovary @GSE107746 ---------------------
library(Seurat)
follicle <- readRDS('/home/hsinyinteng/GSE107746_Folliculogenesis/follicle_tsne_240615.rds')

follicle$Stage_celltype <- factor(follicle$Stage_celltype, levels = c("Primordial_Oocyte", "Primary_Oocyte", "Secondary_Oocyte", "Antral_Oocyte","Preovulatory_Oocyte", "Primordial_GC", "Primary_GC", "Secondary_GC", "Antral_GC", "Preovulatory_GC"))
table(follicle$Stage_celltype)

# 生长分化因子（GDF） 9 是一种由卵母细胞产生的转化生长因子β（TGF-β）型生长因子
# SMAD信号通路，转导 TGF-β信号，调节体细胞中的Myo10 和Fscn1 水平
# RDX radixin [ Homo sapiens (human) ]: the oocyte microvilli-forming gene 

DotPlot(follicle, features=c("GJC1", "GJA1", "GJA4", #间隙连接蛋白
                             "ZP1", "ZP2", "ZP3", "ZP4", #ZP蛋白
                             # "FSCN1", "MYO10","ASTL", 
                             "RDX", "GDF9", "BMP15"), 
        # cols = c("#E64B35", "#4DBBD5", "#00A087", "#3C5488", "#F39B7F", "#8491B4", "#91D1C2", "#DC0000", "#7E6148", "#B09C85"),
        # split.by = "Stage_celltype",
        group.by = "celltype") + 
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(title = "Human Ovary: GSE107746") +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) 

DotPlot(follicle, features=c("GJC1", "GJA1", "GJA4", #间隙连接蛋白
                             "ZP1", "ZP2", "ZP3", "ZP4", #ZP蛋白
                             # "FSCN1", "MYO10","ASTL", 
                             "RDX", "GDF9", "BMP15"),
        group.by = "Stage_celltype") + 
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(title = "Human Ovary: GSE107746") +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
# scTenifoldKnk --------------
# scTenifoldKnk 是一个 R 包函数，用于 预测单细胞 RNA 测序数据中的基因扰动效应。

scTenifoldKnk(  
  countMatrix,           # 基因表达矩阵（细胞×基因），必须为稀疏矩阵或矩阵  
  qc = TRUE,             # 是否进行质量控制（默认TRUE）  
  gKO = NULL,            # 要敲除的基因名（可选，若NULL则进行全基因分析）  
  qc_mtThreshold = 0.1,  # 线粒体基因最大占比阈值（超过此值的细胞被过滤）  
  qc_minLSize = 1000,    # 细胞的最小文库大小（UMI总数低于此值的细胞被过滤）  
  nc_lambda = 0,         # 网络构建时边的权重调节参数（0~1）  
  nc_nNet = 10,          # 基于主成分回归生成的网络数量  
  nc_nCells = 500,       # 每次子采样用于生成网络的细胞数  
  nc_nComp = 3,          # PCA主成分数（必须>2且<总基因数）  
  nc_scaleScores = TRUE, # 是否归一化权重（最大绝对值为1）  
  nc_symmetric = FALSE,  # 是否返回对称权重矩阵  
 nc_q = 0.9,            # 保留前q%的强基因关系（0.9=保留前90%）  
 td_K = 3,              # 张量分解的秩（rank-one tensors数量）  
 td_maxIter = 1000,     # 张量分解的最大迭代次数  
 td_maxError = 1e-05,   # 张量分解的容错率  
 td_nDecimal = 3,       # 结果数值的小数位数  
 ma_nDim = 2,           # 非线性流形对齐的降维维度  
 nCores = parallel::detectCores() # 使用的CPU核心数（默认全部）  
)
```

## 衰老差异代谢物 @随机森林 @wilcox.test
```{r,echo=TRUE}
# 衰老差异代谢物筛选 ---------------------
library(randomForest)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

setwd("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113")

# 1. 提取列名中的前缀（Y 或 O）
group_labels <- ifelse(grepl("^y", colnames(intensity_df_49_follicles)), "2M", "9M")

# 转置数据，行是样本，列是代谢物
data <- t(intensity_df_49_follicles)
data <- data.frame(data, Group = group_labels)

# 删除列名中的 "X" 前缀
# colnames(data) <- sub("^X", "", colnames(data))

# 2. 初步筛选特征：保留组间显著性差异的代谢物（p < 0.05，FDR 校正）
p_values <- sapply(data[, -ncol(data)], function(x) wilcox.test(x ~ data$Group)$p.value)
p_values_adj <- p.adjust(p_values, method = "BH")  # FDR 校正
selected_features <- names(p_values_adj[p_values_adj < 0.1])

# 过滤数据，仅保留显著特征和 Group 列
data_filtered <- data[, c(selected_features, "Group")]


# 3. 确保 Group 是因子型
data_filtered$Group <- as.factor(data_filtered$Group)

# 4. 数据分割（训练集和测试集）
set.seed(42)
train_index <- createDataPartition(data_filtered$Group, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data <- data_filtered[train_index, ]
test_data <- data_filtered[-train_index, ]

# 5. 训练随机森林模型
set.seed(42)
rf_model <- randomForest(Group ~ ., data = train_data, ntree = 1000, importance = TRUE)

# 6. 交叉验证
cv <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5)  # 5-fold 交叉验证
rf_cv <- train(Group ~ ., data = data_filtered, method ="rf", trControl = cv, ntree = 1000)
print(rf_cv)  # 输出交叉验证结果

# 7. 提取特征重要性
importance_scores <- importance(rf_model, type = 2)
feature_ranking <- data.frame(
  Metabolite = sub("^X", "", rownames(importance_scores)), 
  Importance = importance_scores[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
)
feature_ranking <- feature_ranking[order(-feature_ranking$Importance), ]

# 删除行名中的 "X" 前缀
rownames(feature_ranking) <- sub("^X", "", rownames(feature_ranking))


# 8. 可视化重要性排名前20的代谢物
ggplot(feature_ranking[1:20, ], aes(x = Importance, y = reorder(Metabolite, Importance))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Top 20 Important Metabolites (Random Forest)", y = "Metabolite") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    # 修改主坐标轴文字大小
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    # 修改标题大小并居中
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    # 去除网格线
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    # 左侧和下侧坐标轴加粗
    axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 1),  # 下侧坐标轴加粗
    axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 1)   # 左侧坐标轴加粗
  )


# 9. 测试集评估模型性能
predictions <- predict(rf_model, test_data)
confusionMatrix(predictions, test_data$Group)

# 10. 筛选差异代谢物（示例：选择重要性>均值的代谢物）
threshold <- mean(feature_ranking$Importance)
final_selected_metabolites <- subset(feature_ranking, Importance > threshold)  # 125
cat(paste("筛选到", nrow(final_selected_metabolites), "个随机森林筛选的差异代谢物"))


final_selected_metabolites$Metabolite <- as.numeric(final_selected_metabolites$Metabolite)

# write.csv(final_selected_metabolites, file = "Follicle_DEMs.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 自定义函数 @散点箱线图 -----------------
#' 绘制代谢物分组箱线图（带统计检验）
#'
#' @param mz 字符型，代谢物的m/z值（必须存在于intensity_df的行名中）
#' @param intensity_df 数据框，行为代谢物，列为样本，列名格式为"y_"或"o_"开头
#' @param palette 颜色向量，长度为2，默认为c("#4DBBD5", "#E64B35")（2M和9M）
#' @param title 图的标题，默认显示为"m/z = xxx"
#' @param ylab y轴标签，默认为"Relative Intensity"
#' @param stat_method 统计检验方法，默认为"wilcox.test"（非参数检验）
#'
#' @return ggplot2对象
#' @export
#'
#' @examples
#' plot_metabolite_boxplot("162.1131", RMS_intensity_14_ovaries)
#' plot_metabolite_boxplot("522.5238", intensity_df_49_follicles)
Aging_DEMs_boxplot <- function(mz, 
                                   intensity_df, 
                                   palette = c("#4DBBD5", "#E64B35"),
                                   title = paste("m/z =", mz), 
                                   ylab = "Relative Intensity",
                                   stat_method = "wilcox.test") {
  # 检查输入有效性
  if (!mz %in% rownames(intensity_df)) {
    stop("Error: The m/z value '", mz, "' is not found in intensity_df row names.")
  }
  
  # 1. 数据预处理
  target_data <- intensity_df[rownames(intensity_df) == mz, ]
  groups <- ifelse(grepl("^y", names(target_data)), "2M", "9M")
  
  plot_data <- data.frame(
    Group = factor(groups, levels = c("2M", "9M")),
    Intensity = as.numeric(target_data)
  )
  
  # 2. 绘图（标题自动显示为"m/z = xxx"）
  p <- ggpubr::ggboxplot(
    plot_data,
    x = "Group",
    y = "Intensity",
    color = "Group",
    palette = palette,
    add = "jitter",
    width = 0.5,
    size = 0.8,
    add.params = list(size = 3)
  ) +
    ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = list(c("2M", "9M")),
      method = stat_method,
      label = "p.format",
      label.y = max(plot_data$Intensity) * 1.1,
      size = 4,
      family = "Arial",
      fontface = "plain"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,  # 直接使用修改后的参数
      x = "Group",
      y = ylab,
      color = NULL
    ) +
    ylim(NA, max(plot_data$Intensity) * 1.2) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(family = "Arial", face = "plain", 
                                hjust = 0.5, size = 20),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16, family = "Arial", face = "plain"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# 使用示例（标题将自动显示为"m/z = 522.5238"）
Aging_DEMs_boxplot("522.5238", intensity_df_49_follicles) # Cer(d18:0/16:0)
Aging_DEMs_boxplot("728.5201", intensity_df_49_follicles) # PE-NMe(16:0/16:0)
Aging_DEMs_boxplot("162.1131", intensity_df_49_follicles)
Aging_DEMs_boxplot("756.5530", intensity_df_49_follicles) # DPPC @PC(16:0/16:0)
```

## 发育差异代谢物 @随机森林 @wilcox.test
```{r,echo=TRUE}
# 发育差异代谢物筛选 ---------------------
library(randomForest)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
setwd("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113")

# 1. 提取列名中的前缀（Y 或 O）
# 定义分组标签：Secondary_Follicles 或 Antral_Follicles
group_labels <- ifelse(
  colnames(intensity_df_49_follicles) %in% c(
    # Secondary Follicles（次级卵泡）
    "y2_f3", "y2_f4",
    "y3_f1", "y3_f3", "y3_f5", "y3_f6", "y3_f7",
    "y4_f6",
    "y5_f1",
    "y6_f1", "y6_f2", "y6_f5",
    "y7_f8", "y7_f9",
    "o1_f4", "o1_f5", "o1_f6",
    "o2_f2", "o2_f6",
    "o3_f2",
    "o4_f2",
    "o5_f3", "o5_f5",
    "o6_f3"
  ),
  "Secondary_Follicles",
  "Antral_Follicles"
)

# 转换为因子并固定顺序（可选）
group_labels <- factor(group_labels, levels = c("Secondary_Follicles", "Antral_Follicles"))


# 转置数据，行是样本，列是代谢物
data <- t(intensity_df_49_follicles)
data <- data.frame(data, Group = group_labels)

# 删除列名中的 "X" 前缀
# colnames(data) <- sub("^X", "", colnames(data))

# 2. 初步筛选特征：保留组间显著性差异的代谢物（p < 0.05，FDR 校正）
p_values <- sapply(data[, -ncol(data)], function(x) wilcox.test(x ~ data$Group)$p.value)
p_values_adj <- p.adjust(p_values, method = "BH")  # FDR 校正
selected_features <- names(p_values_adj[p_values_adj < 0.1])

# 过滤数据，仅保留显著特征和 Group 列
data_filtered <- data[, c(selected_features, "Group")]


# 3. 确保 Group 是因子型
data_filtered$Group <- as.factor(data_filtered$Group)

# 4. 数据分割（训练集和测试集）
set.seed(42)
train_index <- createDataPartition(data_filtered$Group, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data <- data_filtered[train_index, ]
test_data <- data_filtered[-train_index, ]

# 5. 训练随机森林模型
set.seed(42)
rf_model <- randomForest(Group ~ ., data = train_data, ntree = 1000, importance = TRUE)

# 6. 交叉验证
cv <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5)  # 5-fold 交叉验证
rf_cv <- train(Group ~ ., data = data_filtered, method ="rf", trControl = cv, ntree = 1000)
print(rf_cv)  # 输出交叉验证结果

# 7. 提取特征重要性
importance_scores <- importance(rf_model, type = 2)
feature_ranking <- data.frame(
  Metabolite = sub("^X", "", rownames(importance_scores)), 
  Importance = importance_scores[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
)
feature_ranking <- feature_ranking[order(-feature_ranking$Importance), ]

# 删除行名中的 "X" 前缀
rownames(feature_ranking) <- sub("^X", "", rownames(feature_ranking))


# 8. 可视化重要性排名前20的代谢物
ggplot(feature_ranking[1:20, ], aes(x = Importance, y = reorder(Metabolite, Importance))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Top 20 Important Metabolites (Random Forest)", y = "Metabolite") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    # 修改主坐标轴文字大小
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    # 修改标题大小并居中
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    # 去除网格线
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    # 左侧和下侧坐标轴加粗
    axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 1),  # 下侧坐标轴加粗
    axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 1)   # 左侧坐标轴加粗
  )


# 9. 测试集评估模型性能
predictions <- predict(rf_model, test_data)
confusionMatrix(predictions, test_data$Group)

# 10. 筛选差异代谢物（示例：选择重要性>均值的代谢物）
threshold <- mean(feature_ranking$Importance)
final_selected_metabolites <- subset(feature_ranking, Importance > threshold)  # 125
cat(paste("筛选到", nrow(final_selected_metabolites), "个随机森林筛选的差异代谢物"))

# 首先将Precursor (Da)列转换为字符型以便匹配

# 一步完成匹配和列筛选

# 自定义函数 @散点箱线图 -----------------
#' 绘制代谢物分组箱线图（带统计检验）
#'
#' @param mz 字符型，代谢物的m/z值（必须存在于intensity_df的行名中）
#' @param intensity_df 数据框，行为代谢物，列为样本，列名格式为"y_"或"o_"开头
#' @param palette 颜色向量，长度为2，默认为c("#4DBBD5", "#E64B35")（2M和9M）
#' @param title 图的标题，默认显示为"m/z = xxx"
#' @param ylab y轴标签，默认为"Relative Intensity"
#' @param stat_method 统计检验方法，默认为"wilcox.test"（非参数检验）
#'
#' @return ggplot2对象
#' @export
#'
#' @examples
#' plot_metabolite_boxplot("162.1131", RMS_intensity_14_ovaries)
#' plot_metabolite_boxplot("522.5238", intensity_df_49_follicles)
Developing_DEMs_boxplot <- function(mz, 
                                   intensity_df, 
                                   palette = c("#4DBBD5", "#E64B35"),
                                   title = paste("m/z =", mz), 
                                   ylab = "Relative Intensity",
                                   stat_method = "wilcox.test") {
  # 检查输入有效性
  if (!mz %in% rownames(intensity_df)) {
    stop("Error: The m/z value '", mz, "' is not found in intensity_df row names.")
  }
  
  # 1. 数据预处理
  target_data <- intensity_df[rownames(intensity_df) == mz, ]
  groups <- ifelse(colnames(intensity_df_49_follicles) %in% c(
    # Secondary Follicles（次级卵泡）
    "y2_f3", "y2_f4",
    "y3_f1", "y3_f3", "y3_f5", "y3_f6", "y3_f7",
    "y4_f6",
    "y5_f1",
    "y6_f1", "y6_f2", "y6_f5",
    "y7_f8", "y7_f9",
    "o1_f4", "o1_f5", "o1_f6",
    "o2_f2", "o2_f6",
    "o3_f2",
    "o4_f2",
    "o5_f3", "o5_f5",
    "o6_f3"),
  "Secondary_Follicles",
  "Antral_Follicles"
)

  
  plot_data <- data.frame(
    Group = factor(groups, levels = c("Secondary_Follicles", "Antral_Follicles")),
    Intensity = as.numeric(target_data)
  )
  
  # 2. 绘图（标题自动显示为"m/z = xxx"）
  p <- ggpubr::ggboxplot(
    plot_data,
    x = "Group",
    y = "Intensity",
    color = "Group",
    palette = palette,
    add = "jitter",
    width = 0.5,
    size = 0.8,
    add.params = list(size = 3)
  ) +
    ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = list(c("Secondary_Follicles", "Antral_Follicles")),
      method = stat_method,
      label = "p.format",
      label.y = max(plot_data$Intensity) * 1.1,
      size = 4,
      family = "Arial",
      fontface = "plain"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,  # 直接使用修改后的参数
      x = "Group",
      y = ylab,
      color = NULL
    ) +
    ylim(NA, max(plot_data$Intensity) * 1.2) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(family = "Arial", face = "plain", 
                                hjust = 0.5, size = 20),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16, family = "Arial", face = "plain"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r,eval=FALSE}
# 组间差异 @failed ----------------------
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
Human_Follicular_Fluid <- read_excel("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/Human_Follicular_Fluid/Diff_inte1202_human_follicular_fluid.xlsx") %>%
  dplyr::select(,-1) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    matches("^Con_"),
    matches("^DOR_"),
    !matches("^(Con_|DOR_)")
  )

Human_Follicular_Fluid_GP <- subset(Human_Follicular_Fluid, `Class I` == "GP")


library(dplyr)
library(stats)
raw_data <- Human_Follicular_Fluid_GP[, 1:219]
compounds <- Human_Follicular_Fluid_GP$Compounds  # 单独保存化合物名称

log_data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), NA, log2(. + 1))))
log_data <- cbind(Compounds = compounds, log_data)

con_cols <- grep("^Con_", colnames(log_data), value = TRUE)
dor_cols <- grep("^DOR_", colnames(log_data), value = TRUE)

result <- log_data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # 计算原始数据均值（直接从raw_data按位置提取）
    mean_Con_raw = mean(unlist(raw_data[cur_group_id(), con_cols]), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_DOR_raw = mean(unlist(raw_data[cur_group_id(), dor_cols]), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # 计算FC/log2FC（跳过无效值）
    FC = ifelse(mean_DOR_raw == 0 || is.na(mean_DOR_raw), 
                NA, 
                mean_Con_raw / mean_DOR_raw),
    log2FC = ifelse(mean_Con_raw == 0 || is.na(mean_Con_raw) || 
                    mean_DOR_raw == 0 || is.na(mean_DOR_raw),
                    NA, 
                    log2(FC)),
    
    # t检验（基于标准化数据）
    p_val = {
      con_data <- as.numeric(c_across(all_of(con_cols)))
      dor_data <- as.numeric(c_across(all_of(dor_cols)))
      
      # 移除NA
      con_data <- con_data[!is.na(con_data)]
      dor_data <- dor_data[!is.na(dor_data)]
      
      # 检查样本量
      if (length(con_data) < 2 || length(dor_data) < 2) {
        NA
      } else {
        t.test(con_data, dor_data, var.equal = FALSE)$p.value
      }
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(q_val = p.adjust(p_val, method = "BH")) %>%
  select(Compounds, mean_Con_raw, mean_DOR_raw, FC, log2FC, p_val, q_val, everything())

result %>%
  select(Compounds, mean_Con_raw, mean_DOR_raw, FC, log2FC, p_val, q_val) %>%
  head()
```

```{r,echo=TRUE}
library(tidyverse)

# 选取第一个代谢物
first_metabolite <- Human_Follicular_Fluid_GP$Compounds[1]

# 整理数据
plot_data <- Human_Follicular_Fluid_GP %>%
  filter(Compounds == first_metabolite) %>%
  select(matches("Con|DOR"), Compounds, Pvalue) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Compounds, Pvalue),
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = ifelse(str_detect(Sample, "Con"), "Con", "DOR")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value))  # 去除NA值

ggboxplot(
  data = plot_data,
  x = "Group",         # 分组变量（Con / DOR）
  y = "Value",         # 代谢物浓度
  fill = "Group",      # 颜色填充
  palette = c("skyblue", "salmon"),
  add = "jitter",      # 添加抖动散点
  add.params = list(size = 3, alpha = 0.6, jitter = 0.2),
  bxp.errorbar = TRUE  # 显示误差线
) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("Con", "DOR")),
    method = "t.test",  # t检验（Wilcoxon检验可改用 "wilcox.test"）
    label = "p.signif", # 显示星号而不是P值（如 "*", "***"）
    tip.length = 0.01,  # 连接线短横线长度
    hide.ns = TRUE      # 不显示NS（不显著）
  ) +
  labs(
    title = first_metabolite,  # 使用第一个代谢物名称作为标题
    x = "",
    y = "Relative Intensity"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))


# 单个代谢物 @Con vs DOR @柱状散点图 @自定义函数 ------------------------
# LPC(15:0/0:0)  LPC(22:5/0:0)  LPE(0:0/22:6)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

plot_metabolite_comparison <- function(data, metabolite, 
                                      con_prefix = "Con", 
                                      dor_prefix = "DOR") {
  
  # 检查代谢物是否存在
  if (!metabolite %in% data$Compounds) {
    stop(paste("Metabolite", metabolite, "not found in data$Compounds"))
  }
  
  # 整理数据（确保Pvalue是数值）
  plot_data <- data %>%
    filter(Compounds == metabolite) %>%
    select(matches(paste0(con_prefix, "|", dor_prefix)), Compounds, Pvalue) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(Compounds, Pvalue),
      names_to = "Sample",
      values_to = "Value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Group = ifelse(str_detect(Sample, con_prefix), "Con", "DOR"),
      Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Con", "DOR")),
      Pvalue = as.numeric(Pvalue)  # 强制转换为数值
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Value))
  
  # 绘图（修复fill美学冲突）
  p <- ggboxplot(
    data = plot_data,
    x = "Group",
    y = "Value",
    fill = "Group",  # 填充颜色按分组
    palette = c("skyblue", "salmon"),
    add = "jitter",
    add.params = list(size = 3, alpha = 0.6, jitter = 0.2),
    bxp.errorbar = TRUE
  ) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = list(c("Con", "DOR")),
      method = "t.test",
      label = "p.format",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      size = 4  # 增大统计检验字体
    ) +
    labs(
      title = metabolite,
      x = "",
      y = "Relative Intensity"
    ) +
    theme(
      # --- 1. 主面板加边框 ---
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      
      # --- 2. 修改字体大小 ---
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),  # 标题：16pt加粗居中
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),                            # Y轴标签：14pt
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),                               # 坐标轴刻度：12pt
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
Human_Follicular_Fluid <- read_excel("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/Human_Follicular_Fluid/Diff_inte1202_human_follicular_fluid.xlsx") %>%

  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Compounds, Pvalue),
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = ifelse(str_detect(Sample, "Con"), "Con", "DOR"),

      Pvalue < 0.001 ~ "***",

      TRUE ~ ""
    )

  ) +

    color = "black"
  ) +

    ),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  geom_text(

    ),

print(p)
```

## 热图 @GP
```{r,echo=TRUE,fig.width=8,fig.height=6}
# 热图 @GP -----------------------
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
Human_Follicular_Fluid <- read_excel("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/Human_Follicular_Fluid/Diff_inte1202_human_follicular_fluid.xlsx") %>%
  dplyr::select(,-1) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    matches("^Con_"),
    matches("^DOR_"),
    !matches("^(Con_|DOR_)")
  )

Human_Follicular_Fluid_GP <- subset(Human_Follicular_Fluid, `Class I` == "GP")


library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)  # 用于颜色映射

con_cols <- grep("Con", colnames(Human_Follicular_Fluid_GP), value = TRUE)
dor_cols <- grep("DOR", colnames(Human_Follicular_Fluid_GP), value = TRUE)

# 提取代谢物名称和两组的数值列
heatmap_data <- Human_Follicular_Fluid_GP %>%
  select(Compounds, all_of(c(con_cols, dor_cols))) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "Compounds") %>%
  as.matrix()

# 按行标准化（代谢物级别）
heatmap_data_scaled <- t(scale(t(heatmap_data)))

# 定义分组注释
ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = factor(c(rep("Con", length(con_cols)), rep("DOR", length(dor_cols)))),
  col = list(Group = c("Con" = "blue", "DOR" = "red"))
)

# 绘制热图
Heatmap(
  heatmap_data_scaled,
  name = "Z-score",
  top_annotation = ha,
  col = colorRampPalette(c("#4DBBD5","white","#DC0000"))(100),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = F,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  column_split = factor(c(rep("Con", length(con_cols)), rep("DOR", length(dor_cols))))
)


# 热图 @GP均值 @先取均值再scale --------------------
library(dplyr)

# 计算分组均值（Con和DOR）
heatmap_data_mean <- Human_Follicular_Fluid_GP %>%
  select(Compounds, matches("Con_|DOR_")) %>%
  mutate(
    Con_mean = rowMeans(select(., matches("Con_")), na.rm = TRUE),
    DOR_mean = rowMeans(select(., matches("DOR_")), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  select(Compounds, Con_mean, DOR_mean) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "Compounds") %>%
  as.matrix()

# 为了使不同代谢物的数据可比，对每组均值进行按行标准化
heatmap_data_mean_scaled <- t(scale(t(heatmap_data_mean)))

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

# 定义分组注释（只有两列：Con_mean 和 DOR_mean）
ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = c("Con", "DOR"),
  col = list(Group = c("Con" = "blue", "DOR" = "red"))
)

# 绘制热图（只需2列）
Heatmap(
  heatmap_data_mean_scaled,
  name = "Z-score",
  top_annotation = ha,
  col = colorRampPalette(c("#4DBBD5","white","#DC0000"))(100),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,  # 现在只有两列，可以显示
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE    # 数据是Con和DOR的均值，不需聚类列
)



# 热图 @GP均值 @先scale再取均值 --------------
# 先对每个代谢物的所有样本值进行标准化 (scale)，再按 Con/DOR 组计算均值。这样可以确保标准化是在样本级别进行的，而均值是组级别的。

library(dplyr)

# 1. 提取数据并标准化
heatmap_scaled <- Human_Follicular_Fluid_GP %>%
  select(Compounds, matches("Con_|DOR_")) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Compounds") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  t() %>% scale() %>% t()  # 行标准化

# 2. 计算组均值（直接生成矩阵）
heatmap_mean_scaled <- cbind(
  Con_mean = rowMeans(heatmap_scaled[, grep("Con_", colnames(heatmap_scaled))], na.rm = TRUE),
  DOR_mean = rowMeans(heatmap_scaled[, grep("DOR_", colnames(heatmap_scaled))], na.rm = TRUE)
)
rownames(heatmap_mean_scaled) <- rownames(heatmap_scaled)

# 3. 绘图
ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  heatmap_mean_scaled,
  name = "Z-score",
  col = colorRampPalette(c("#4DBBD5","white","#DC0000"))(100),
  top_annotation = ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
    Group = c("Con", "DOR"),
    col = list(Group = c("Con" = "blue", "DOR" = "red"))
  )
)


# -------------------
# 从原始数据中提取代谢物名称和P值（假设列名是 "P_value"）
p_value_data <- Human_Follicular_Fluid_GP %>%
  select(Compounds, Pvalue) %>%
  arrange(desc(Pvalue))  # 降序排列

# 获取排序后的代谢物顺序（用于后续热图）
sorted_metabolites <- p_value_data$Compounds

heatmap_scaled <- Human_Follicular_Fluid_GP %>%
  select(Compounds, matches("Con_|DOR_")) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Compounds") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  t() %>% scale() %>% t()

heatmap_mean_scaled <- cbind(
  Con_mean = rowMeans(heatmap_scaled[, grep("Con_", colnames(heatmap_scaled))], na.rm = TRUE),
  DOR_mean = rowMeans(heatmap_scaled[, grep("DOR_", colnames(heatmap_scaled))], na.rm = TRUE)
)
rownames(heatmap_mean_scaled) <- rownames(heatmap_scaled)

# **按照P值顺序重新排列**
heatmap_mean_scaled <- heatmap_mean_scaled[sorted_metabolites, ]

library(ComplexHeatmap)

# 定义列注释（Con vs DOR）
ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = c("Con", "DOR"),
  col = list(Group = c("Con" = "blue", "DOR" = "red"))
)

# 绘制热图，禁止行聚类
Heatmap(
  heatmap_mean_scaled,
  name = "Z-score",
  col = colorRampPalette(c("#4DBBD5","white","#DC0000"))(100),
  top_annotation = ha,
  row_order = rownames(heatmap_mean_scaled),  # 强制按P值顺序排列
  cluster_rows = FALSE,                       # 禁用行聚类
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  show_column_names = TRUE,

)
```

```{r,eval=FALSE}
# 热图 @Pvalue < 0.05 ----------------------
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)

# 1. 提取表达矩阵（数值型）
exp_mat <- Human_Follicular_Fluid %>%
  select(starts_with("Con_"), starts_with("DOR_")) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  apply(2, as.numeric)  # 确保所有值为数值
rownames(exp_mat) <- Human_Follicular_Fluid$Compounds

# 2. 标准化前移除零方差代谢物
exp_mat <- exp_mat[apply(exp_mat, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, ]
exp_mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(exp_mat)))  # 按行Z-score标准化

# 3. 构建列注释（样本分组：Con/DOR）
col_annotation <- data.frame(
  Group = factor(ifelse(str_detect(colnames(exp_mat_scaled), "^Con_"), "Con", "DOR")),
  row.names = colnames(exp_mat_scaled)
)

# 4. 按分组排序样本（先Con后DOR，再按Pregnancy_Outcome）
col_order <- col_annotation %>%
  rownames()
exp_mat_scaled <- exp_mat_scaled[, col_order]

# 5. 构建行注释（代谢物分组：Failure/Success）
# 假设 Failure/Success 对应 Pregnancy_Outcome
row_annotation <- data.frame(
  Pregnancy_Outcome = ifelse(Human_Follicular_Fluid$group[match(rownames(exp_mat_scaled), Human_Follicular_Fluid$Compounds)] == "Failure", "Failure", "Success"),
  row.names = rownames(exp_mat_scaled)
)

pheatmap(
  exp_mat_scaled,
  cluster_rows = T,  # 不聚类行（按Failure/Success分组）
  cluster_cols = FALSE,  # 不聚类列（按Con/DOR分组）
  annotation_col = col_annotation,
  annotation_row = row_annotation,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  main = "Metabolite Heatmap (Grouped by Pregnancy Outcome)",
  annotation_colors = list(
    Group = c("Con" = "#1F77B4", "DOR" = "#FF7F0E"),
    Pregnancy_Outcome = c("Failure" = "red", "Success" = "green")
  ),
  fontsize_row = 6
)


# 先Class I，再生殖结局 --------------------------
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

# 1. 加载并预处理数据
data_clean <- Human_Follicular_Fluid %>%
  mutate(
    Pregnancy_Outcome = ifelse(group == "Failure", "Failure", "Success"),
    Class_I = `Class I`
  ) %>%
  # 计算每个Class_I的出现频率用于排序
  group_by(Class_I) %>%
  mutate(Class_Freq = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2. 表达矩阵标准化
exp_mat <- data_clean %>%
  select(starts_with("Con_"), starts_with("DOR_")) %>%
  as.matrix()
rownames(exp_mat) <- data_clean$Compounds

# 过滤零方差行并标准化
exp_mat <- exp_mat[apply(exp_mat, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, ]
exp_mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(exp_mat)))

# 3. 行排序（关键步骤！）
row_order <- data_clean %>%
  filter(Compounds %in% rownames(exp_mat_scaled)) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(Class_Freq),  # Class I数量多的组在前
    Class_I,           # 组内按类名排序（可选）
    desc(Pregnancy_Outcome)  # Failure在上，Success在下
  ) %>%
  pull(Compounds)

# 应用排序
exp_mat_scaled <- exp_mat_scaled[row_order, ]

# 4. 列排序（Con在前）
col_order <- c(
  grep("^Con_", colnames(exp_mat_scaled)),
  grep("^DOR_", colnames(exp_mat_scaled))
)
exp_mat_scaled <- exp_mat_scaled[, col_order]

# 5. 构建注释
row_annotation <- data_clean %>%
  filter(Compounds %in% rownames(exp_mat_scaled)) %>%
  select(Compounds, Pregnancy_Outcome, Class_I) %>%
  mutate(Class_I = factor(Class_I, levels = unique(Class_I))) %>%  # 保持排序后的levels
  column_to_rownames("Compounds")

col_annotation <- data.frame(
  Group = ifelse(grepl("^Con_", colnames(exp_mat_scaled)), "Con", "DOR"),
  row.names = colnames(exp_mat_scaled)
)

# 6. 自动生成可区分颜色
set.seed(123)
class_colors <- paletteer::paletteer_d("ggsci::category20_d3")[1:nlevels(row_annotation$Class_I)]
names(class_colors) <- levels(row_annotation$Class_I)

# 7. 绘制热图
pheatmap(
  exp_mat_scaled,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,  # 禁止行聚类
  cluster_cols = FALSE,  # 禁止列聚类
  annotation_col = col_annotation,
  annotation_row = row_annotation,
  annotation_colors = list(
    Group = c("Con" = "#1F77B4", "DOR" = "#FF7F0E"),
    Pregnancy_Outcome = c("Failure" = "#E41A1C", "Success" = "#4DAF4A"),
    Class_I = class_colors
  ),
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  fontsize_row = 2,  # 调大代谢物名称字号
  main = "Metabolite Abundance by Class",
  gaps_col = sum(col_annotation$Group == "Con"),  # 组间分隔线
  # gaps_row = cumsum(rle(as.character(row_annotation$Class_I))$lengths),  # 类间分隔线
  gaps_row = NULL,            # 关键！去除所有行间隔
  border_color = NA,
  treeheight_row = 0,  # 完全隐藏行聚类树
  cellheight = 2,             # 行高
  cellwidth = NA              # 列宽
)


# 先生殖结局，再Class I ------------------------------------
row_order <- order(
  row_annotation$Pregnancy_Outcome != "Success",  # Success first (FALSE < TRUE)
  row_annotation$Class_I                          # Then by Class_I
)
exp_mat_ordered <- exp_mat_scaled[row_order, ]
row_annotation_ordered <- row_annotation[row_order, ]


library(ComplexHeatmap)
Heatmap(
  exp_mat_ordered,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),      # 行名字体大小（默认4pt）
  row_split = NULL,                       # 禁用行分组（避免出现间隔线）
  row_gap = unit(0.1, "mm"),             # 行间距（可设为0完全紧凑）
  cluster_rows = FALSE,                   # 保持手动排序
  column_split = column_groups,           # 列分组变量（Con和DOR）
  column_gap = unit(2, "mm"),             # 列组间间隔
  cluster_columns = FALSE,                # 禁止列聚类
  show_column_names = FALSE,  # 隐藏列名
  top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
    Group = column_groups,
    col = list(Group = col_group_colors),
    show_legend = TRUE
  ),
  left_annotation = rowAnnotation(
    Pregnancy_Outcome = row_annotation_ordered$Pregnancy_Outcome,
    Class_I = row_annotation_ordered$Class_I,
    col = list(
      Pregnancy_Outcome = c("Failure" = "#E41A1C", "Success" = "#4DAF4A"),
      Class_I = class_colors)
    ),
  border = FALSE,                         # 无边框
  name = "Expression"                     # 图例标题
)
```

```{r,echo=TRUE,fig.height=3,fig.width=12}
# 自定义函数 @ 卵巢整体 --------------
library(readxl)
library(Cardinal)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

# load("/home/hsinyinteng/Spatial_Metabolomics/mouse_ovary/continuous_result_20241113/Intensity_with_RMS_normalization_data.rda")

mz_comparison_of_whole_ovary <- function(Intensity_Data_of_14_Ovaries, mz_target) {
  # 1. 提取目标mz的数据
  target_data <- Intensity_Data_of_14_Ovaries %>%
    filter(mz == as.character(mz_target)) %>%
    select(-mz) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = everything(),
      names_to = "group",
      values_to = "intensity"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      age_group = ifelse(grepl("^y", group), "2M", "9M")
    )
  
  # 2. 执行t检验（方差齐性）
  t_test_result <- t.test(
    intensity ~ age_group,
    data = target_data,
    var.equal = TRUE
  )
  
  # 3. 格式化p值
  p_value <- format.pval(t_test_result$p.value, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)
  p_label <- paste("p =", p_value)
  
  # 4. 绘图
  plot <- ggplot(target_data, aes(x = age_group, y = intensity, fill = age_group)) +
    stat_summary(
      fun = mean, geom = "bar", width = 0.5,
      color = "black", alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      fun.data = mean_sdl, geom = "errorbar",
      width = 0.2, color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      size = 3, shape = 21, color = "black",
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0)
    ) +
    geom_signif(
      comparisons = list(c("2M", "9M")),
      annotations = p_label,
      y_position = max(target_data$intensity) * 1.15,
      tip_length = 0,
      textsize = 4,
      vjust = -0.5
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = c("2M", "9M")) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("m/z =", mz_target),
      x = "Age",
      y = "Relative Intensity"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("2M" = "#4E84C4", "9M" = "#D16103")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 20),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm")
    ) +
  # 限制y轴范围（确保p值显示完整）
  ylim(NA, max(target_data$intensity) * 1.25)
  
  # 返回图形和t检验结果（可选）
  return(list(plot = plot, t_test_result = t_test_result))
}
```
